const WIDTH = 600;
const HEIGHT = 150;
const FPS = 60;

const CFG = {
  ACCELERATION: 0.001, BOTTOM_PAD: 10, CLEAR_TIME: 3000, GAMEOVER_CLEAR_TIME: 750, GAP_COEFFICIENT: 0.6,
  MAX_OBSTACLE_DUPLICATION: 2, MAX_SPEED: 13, SPEED: 6,
};
const TREX = {
  DROP_VELOCITY: -5, GRAVITY: 0.6, HEIGHT: 47, INIITAL_JUMP_VELOCITY: -10, INTRO_DURATION: 1500,
  MAX_JUMP_HEIGHT: 30, MIN_JUMP_HEIGHT: 30, SPEED_DROP_COEFFICIENT: 3, START_X_POS: 50, WIDTH: 44,
};
// ms per animation frame of each status; the jump physics divides the frame time by it
const MS_PER_FRAME = { WAITING: 1000 / 3, RUNNING: 1000 / 12, CRASHED: 1000 / 60, JUMPING: 1000 / 60, DUCKING: 1000 / 8 };

const box = (x, y, width, height) => ({ x, y, width, height });
const TREX_BOXES = {
  DUCKING: [box(1, 18, 55, 25)],
  RUNNING: [box(22, 0, 17, 16), box(1, 18, 30, 9), box(10, 35, 14, 8), box(1, 24, 29, 5), box(5, 30, 21, 4), box(9, 34, 15, 4)],
};
const OBSTACLE_TYPES = [
  { type: "CACTUS_SMALL", width: 17, height: 35, yPos: 105, multipleSpeed: 4, minGap: 120, minSpeed: 0,
    boxes: [box(0, 7, 5, 27), box(4, 0, 6, 34), box(10, 4, 7, 14)] },
  { type: "CACTUS_LARGE", width: 25, height: 50, yPos: 90, multipleSpeed: 7, minGap: 120, minSpeed: 0,
    boxes: [box(0, 12, 7, 38), box(8, 0, 7, 49), box(13, 10, 10, 38)] },
  { type: "PTERODACTYL", width: 46, height: 40, yPos: [100, 75, 50], multipleSpeed: 999, minSpeed: 8.5, minGap: 150,
    speedOffset: 0.8,
    boxes: [box(15, 15, 16, 5), box(18, 21, 24, 6), box(2, 14, 4, 3), box(6, 10, 4, 7), box(10, 8, 6, 9)] },
];
const MAX_GAP_COEFFICIENT = 1.5;
const MAX_OBSTACLE_LENGTH = 3;

const boxCompare = (a, b) => a.x < b.x + b.width && a.x + a.width > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.height && a.height + a.y > b.y;
const adjusted = (b, by) => box(b.x + by.x, b.y + by.y, b.width, b.height);

class Obstacle {
  constructor(rng, type, speed, xOffset) {
    this.typeConfig = type;
    this.size = getRandomNum(rng, 1, MAX_OBSTACLE_LENGTH);
    this.remove = false;
    this.xPos = WIDTH + (xOffset || 0);
    this.yPos = 0;
    this.width = 0;
    this.gap = 0;
    this.speedOffset = 0;
    this.followingObstacleCreated = false;
    this.boxes = type.boxes.map((b) => box(b.x, b.y, b.width, b.height));
    // only allow groups when the speed is high enough
    if (this.size > 1 && type.multipleSpeed > speed) this.size = 1;
    this.width = type.width * this.size;
    if (Array.isArray(type.yPos)) this.yPos = type.yPos[getRandomNum(rng, 0, type.yPos.length - 1)];
    else this.yPos = type.yPos;
    // the middle box grows with the group, the last one moves to the end
    if (this.size > 1) {
      this.boxes[1].width = this.width - this.boxes[0].width - this.boxes[2].width;
      this.boxes[2].x = this.width - this.boxes[2].width;
    }
    if (type.speedOffset) this.speedOffset = rng() > 0.5 ? type.speedOffset : -type.speedOffset;
    const minGap = Math.round(this.width * speed + type.minGap * CFG.GAP_COEFFICIENT);
    const maxGap = Math.round(minGap * MAX_GAP_COEFFICIENT);
    this.gap = getRandomNum(rng, minGap, maxGap);
  }

  update(deltaTime, speed) {
    if (!this.remove) {
      if (this.typeConfig.speedOffset) speed += this.speedOffset;
      this.xPos -= Math.floor((speed * FPS / 1000) * deltaTime);
      if (!this.isVisible()) this.remove = true;
    }
  }

  isVisible() { return this.xPos + this.width > 0; }
}

function getRandomNum(rng, min, max) { return Math.floor(rng() * (max - min + 1)) + min; }

class Trex {
  constructor() {
    this.xPos = 0;
    this.groundYPos = HEIGHT - TREX.HEIGHT - CFG.BOTTOM_PAD;
    this.yPos = this.groundYPos;
    this.minJumpHeight = this.groundYPos - TREX.MIN_JUMP_HEIGHT;
    this.status = "WAITING";
    this.jumping = false;
    this.ducking = false;
    this.jumpVelocity = 0;
    this.reachedMinHeight = false;
    this.speedDrop = false;
    this.jumpCount = 0;
    this.playingIntro = false;
  }

  update(deltaTime, status) {
    if (status) this.status = status;
    // the intro slides the dino in from the left
    if (this.playingIntro && this.xPos < TREX.START_X_POS) this.xPos += Math.round((TREX.START_X_POS / TREX.INTRO_DURATION) * deltaTime);
    // the original's draw() shifts a crashed, ducking dino one pixel (it draws the standing sprite)
    if (this.status === "CRASHED" && this.ducking) this.xPos++;
    // a speed drop turns into a duck once the dino is on the ground
    if (this.speedDrop && this.yPos == this.groundYPos) {
      this.speedDrop = false;
      this.setDuck(true);
    }
  }

  startJump(speed) {
    if (!this.jumping) {
      this.update(0, "JUMPING");
      this.jumpVelocity = TREX.INIITAL_JUMP_VELOCITY - speed / 10;
      this.jumping = true;
      this.reachedMinHeight = false;
      this.speedDrop = false;
    }
  }

  endJump() {
    if (this.reachedMinHeight && this.jumpVelocity < TREX.DROP_VELOCITY) this.jumpVelocity = TREX.DROP_VELOCITY;
  }

  updateJump(deltaTime) {
    const msPerFrame = MS_PER_FRAME[this.status];
    const framesElapsed = deltaTime / msPerFrame;
    if (this.speedDrop) this.yPos += Math.round(this.jumpVelocity * TREX.SPEED_DROP_COEFFICIENT * framesElapsed);
    else this.yPos += Math.round(this.jumpVelocity * framesElapsed);
    this.jumpVelocity += TREX.GRAVITY * framesElapsed;
    if (this.yPos < this.minJumpHeight || this.speedDrop) this.reachedMinHeight = true;
    if (this.yPos < TREX.MAX_JUMP_HEIGHT || this.speedDrop) this.endJump();
    if (this.yPos > this.groundYPos) {
      this.reset();
      this.jumpCount++;
    }
    this.update(deltaTime);
  }

  setSpeedDrop() {
    this.speedDrop = true;
    this.jumpVelocity = 1;
  }

  setDuck(isDucking) {
    if (isDucking && this.status != "DUCKING") {
      this.update(0, "DUCKING");
      this.ducking = true;
    } else if (this.status == "DUCKING") {
      this.update(0, "RUNNING");
      this.ducking = false;
    }
  }

  reset() {
    this.yPos = this.groundYPos;
    this.jumpVelocity = 0;
    this.jumping = false;
    this.ducking = false;
    this.update(0, "RUNNING");
    this.speedDrop = false;
    this.jumpCount = 0;
  }
}

function checkForCollision(obstacle, tRex) {
  const tRexBox = box(tRex.xPos + 1, tRex.yPos + 1, TREX.WIDTH - 2, TREX.HEIGHT - 2);
  const obstacleBox = box(obstacle.xPos + 1, obstacle.yPos + 1, obstacle.typeConfig.width * obstacle.size - 2, obstacle.typeConfig.height - 2);
  if (boxCompare(tRexBox, obstacleBox)) {
    const tBoxes = tRex.ducking ? TREX_BOXES.DUCKING : TREX_BOXES.RUNNING;
    for (let t = 0; t < tBoxes.length; t++) {
      for (let i = 0; i < obstacle.boxes.length; i++) {
        if (boxCompare(adjusted(tBoxes[t], tRexBox), adjusted(obstacle.boxes[i], obstacleBox))) return true;
      }
    }
  }
  return false;
}

class Dino {
  constructor({ rng, clock0 = 1000 }) {
    this.rng = rng;
    this.now = clock0;
    this.tRex = new Trex();
    this.obstacles = [];
    this.obstacleHistory = [];
    this.distanceRan = 0;
    this.highestScore = 0;
    this.time = 0;
    this.runningTime = 0;
    this.msPerFrame = 1000 / FPS;
    this.currentSpeed = CFG.SPEED;
    this.activated = false;
    this.playing = false;
    this.crashed = false;
    this.paused = false;
    this.playingIntro = false;
    this.playCount = 0;
    this.introListener = false;
    // requestAnimationFrame bookkeeping: pending callbacks, the frame being run, last id handed out
    this.queue = [];
    this.running = null;
    this.nextId = 1;
    this.raqId = 0;
    this.updatePending = false;
    // Runner.init ends with one update(): it starts the waiting-for-input loop
    this.update();
  }

  // ---- requestAnimationFrame ------------------------------------------------------------
  requestFrame() {
    const id = this.nextId++;
    this.queue.push({ id });
    return id;
  }
  cancelFrame(id) {
    this.queue = this.queue.filter((q) => q.id !== id);
    if (this.running) for (const q of this.running) if (q.id === id) q.cancelled = true;
  }
  scheduleNextUpdate() {
    if (!this.updatePending) {
      this.updatePending = true;
      this.raqId = this.requestFrame();
    }
  }

  // ---- one frame ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  step(input) {
    this.now = this.now + input.dt;
    if (input.jump) this.keyDown("jump");
    if (input.duck) this.keyDown("duck");
    if (input.jumpUp) this.keyUp("jump");
    if (input.duckUp) this.keyUp("duck");
    if (input.enter) this.keyUp("enter");
    if (input.animEnd && this.introListener) this.startGame();
    this.running = this.queue;
    this.queue = [];
    for (const q of this.running) if (!q.cancelled) this.update();
    this.running = null;
  }

  // ---- Runner ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  update() {
    this.updatePending = false;
    const now = this.now;
    let deltaTime = now - (this.time || now);
    this.time = now;

    if (this.playing) {
      if (this.tRex.jumping) this.tRex.updateJump(deltaTime);
      this.runningTime += deltaTime;
      const hasObstacles = this.runningTime > CFG.CLEAR_TIME;

      // the first landing starts the intro
      if (this.tRex.jumpCount == 1 && !this.playingIntro) this.playIntro();

      // the horizon does not move until the intro is over
      if (this.playingIntro) {
        this.updateHorizon(0, this.currentSpeed, hasObstacles);
      } else {
        deltaTime = !this.activated ? 0 : deltaTime;
        this.updateHorizon(deltaTime, this.currentSpeed, hasObstacles);
      }

      const collision = hasObstacles && checkForCollision(this.obstacles[0], this.tRex);
      if (!collision) {
        this.distanceRan += this.currentSpeed * deltaTime / this.msPerFrame;
        if (this.currentSpeed < CFG.MAX_SPEED) this.currentSpeed += CFG.ACCELERATION;
      } else {
        this.gameOver();
      }
    }

    // (the original also keeps this loop alive while !activated && blinkCount < 3; the port
    // assumes fewer than 3 blinks happen before the first key, which the recording checks)
    if (this.playing || !this.activated) {
      this.tRex.update(deltaTime);
      this.scheduleNextUpdate();
    }
  }

  playIntro() {
    if (!this.activated && !this.crashed) {
      this.playingIntro = true;
      this.tRex.playingIntro = true;
      this.introListener = true;
      this.playing = true;
      this.activated = true;
    } else if (this.crashed) {
      this.restart();
    }
  }

  startGame() {
    this.runningTime = 0;
    this.playingIntro = false;
    this.tRex.playingIntro = false;
    this.playCount++;
  }

  gameOver() {
    this.stop();
    this.crashed = true;
    this.tRex.update(100, "CRASHED");
    if (this.distanceRan > this.highestScore) this.highestScore = Math.ceil(this.distanceRan);
    this.time = this.now;
  }

  stop() {
    this.playing = false;
    this.paused = true;
    this.cancelFrame(this.raqId);
    this.raqId = 0;
  }

  play() {
    if (!this.crashed) {
      this.playing = true;
      this.paused = false;
      this.tRex.update(0, "RUNNING");
      this.time = this.now;
      this.update();
    }
  }

  restart() {
    if (!this.raqId) {
      this.playCount++;
      this.runningTime = 0;
      this.playing = true;
      this.crashed = false;
      this.distanceRan = 0;
      this.currentSpeed = CFG.SPEED; // setSpeed(SPEED) at width 600
      this.time = this.now;
      this.obstacles = []; // Horizon.reset (obstacleHistory is kept)
      this.tRex.reset();
      this.update();
    }
  }

  isRunning() { return !!this.raqId; }

  // ---- keys -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  keyDown(which) {
    if (which === "jump" && !this.crashed) {
      if (!this.playing) {
        this.playing = true;
        this.update();
      }
      if (!this.tRex.jumping && !this.tRex.ducking) this.tRex.startJump(this.currentSpeed);
    }
    if (which === "duck" && this.playing && !this.crashed) {
      if (this.tRex.jumping) this.tRex.setSpeedDrop();
      else if (!this.tRex.jumping && !this.tRex.ducking) this.tRex.setDuck(true);
    }
  }

  keyUp(which) {
    const isJumpKey = which === "jump";
    if (this.isRunning() && isJumpKey) {
      this.tRex.endJump();
    } else if (which === "duck") {
      this.tRex.speedDrop = false;
      this.tRex.setDuck(false);
    } else if (this.crashed) {
      const deltaTime = this.now - this.time;
      if (which === "enter" || (deltaTime >= CFG.GAMEOVER_CLEAR_TIME && isJumpKey)) this.restart();
    } else if (this.paused && isJumpKey) {
      this.tRex.reset();
      this.play();
    }
  }

  // ---- Horizon --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  updateHorizon(deltaTime, currentSpeed, updateObstacles) {
    if (updateObstacles) this.updateObstacles(deltaTime, currentSpeed);
  }

  updateObstacles(deltaTime, currentSpeed) {
    const updated = this.obstacles.slice(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < this.obstacles.length; i++) {
      const obstacle = this.obstacles[i];
      obstacle.update(deltaTime, currentSpeed);
      if (obstacle.remove) updated.shift();
    }
    this.obstacles = updated;
    if (this.obstacles.length > 0) {
      const last = this.obstacles[this.obstacles.length - 1];
      if (last && !last.followingObstacleCreated && last.isVisible() && (last.xPos + last.width + last.gap) < WIDTH) {
        this.addNewObstacle(currentSpeed);
        last.followingObstacleCreated = true;
      }
    } else {
      this.addNewObstacle(currentSpeed);
    }
  }

  addNewObstacle(currentSpeed) {
    const type = OBSTACLE_TYPES[getRandomNum(this.rng, 0, OBSTACLE_TYPES.length - 1)];
    if (this.duplicateObstacleCheck(type.type) || currentSpeed < type.minSpeed) {
      this.addNewObstacle(currentSpeed);
    } else {
      this.obstacles.push(new Obstacle(this.rng, type, currentSpeed, type.width));
      this.obstacleHistory.unshift(type.type);
      if (this.obstacleHistory.length > 1) this.obstacleHistory.splice(CFG.MAX_OBSTACLE_DUPLICATION);
    }
  }

  duplicateObstacleCheck(next) {
    let count = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.obstacleHistory.length; i++) count = this.obstacleHistory[i] == next ? count + 1 : 0;
    return count >= CFG.MAX_OBSTACLE_DUPLICATION;
  }

  // ---- what the recording compares ------------------------------------------------------
  snapshot() {
    const x = this.tRex;
    const d = Math.ceil(this.distanceRan);
    return {
      playing: this.playing,
      crashed: this.crashed,
      activated: this.activated,
      playingIntro: !!this.playingIntro,
      paused: this.paused,
      currentSpeed: this.currentSpeed,
      distanceRan: this.distanceRan,
      score: d ? Math.round(d * 0.025) : 0,
      highestScore: this.highestScore,
      runningTime: this.runningTime,
      playCount: this.playCount,
      time: this.time,
      running: !!this.raqId,
      rafPending: this.queue.length,
      tRex: {
        xPos: x.xPos, yPos: x.yPos, jumping: x.jumping, ducking: x.ducking, speedDrop: x.speedDrop,
        jumpVelocity: x.jumpVelocity, jumpCount: x.jumpCount, status: x.status, reachedMinHeight: x.reachedMinHeight,
      },
      obstacleHistory: this.obstacleHistory.slice(),
      obstacles: this.obstacles.map((o) => ({
        type: o.typeConfig.type, xPos: o.xPos, yPos: o.yPos, size: o.size, width: o.width, gap: o.gap,
        speedOffset: o.speedOffset, followed: o.followingObstacleCreated,
      })),
    };
  }
}

return { WIDTH, HEIGHT, Dino };
})();

const { Dino } = __mod0;
(function main() {
  const STEP = 1000 / 60;      // the rules are stepped at 60 Hz whatever the screen does
  const INTRO_MS = 400;        // length of the intro animation, as in the recording
  const W = 600, H = 150, GROUND = 127;
  const cv = document.getElementById("c");
  const ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
  const rootStyle = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);

  // ---- canvas size: crisp on high density screens
  function fit() {
    const dpr = Math.max(1, Math.min(3, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));
    const cssW = cv.getBoundingClientRect().width || W;
    cv.width = Math.round(cssW * dpr);
    cv.height = Math.round(cssW * dpr * H / W);
    ctx.setTransform(cv.width / W, 0, 0, cv.width / W, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", fit);
  fit();

  // ---- game
  let best = 0;
  try { best = Number(localStorage.getItem("rea-dino-best")) || 0; } catch (e) { /* private mode */ }
  // DEMO HOOK (scripts/demo-dino.mjs): when window.__tape is set, the game draws its random numbers from that
  // recorded tape, the driver steps it with the case's dt, and window.__rea exposes snapshot(). Without it
  // nothing below changes.
  const TAPE = Array.isArray(window.__tape) ? window.__tape : null;
  let tapeUsed = 0;
  const rng = TAPE ? () => { if (tapeUsed >= TAPE.length) throw new Error("tape used up"); return TAPE[tapeUsed++]; } : Math.random;
  const game = new Dino({ rng, clock0: TAPE ? 1000 : performance.now() });
  let introT = 0, queue = [], acc = 0, last = null, ticks = 0, crashTicks = 0;
  const clouds = [{ x: 380, y: 40 }, { x: 120, y: 62 }];
  let scoreOf = () => { const d = Math.ceil(game.distanceRan); return d ? Math.round(d * 0.025) : 0; };

  // ---- input
  const push = (k) => queue.push(k);
  addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "ArrowUp") { e.preventDefault(); push({ jump: true }); }
    else if (e.code === "ArrowDown") { e.preventDefault(); push({ duck: true }); }
  });
  addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
    if (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "ArrowUp") { e.preventDefault(); push({ jumpUp: true }); }
    else if (e.code === "ArrowDown") { e.preventDefault(); push({ duckUp: true }); }
    else if (e.code === "Enter") push({ enter: true });
  });
  const wrap = document.getElementById("wrap");
  wrap.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); push({ jump: true }); });
  const lift = () => push({ jumpUp: true });
  wrap.addEventListener("pointerup", lift);
  wrap.addEventListener("pointercancel", lift);
  const duckBtn = document.getElementById("duck");
  duckBtn.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); push({ duck: true }); });
  for (const t of ["pointerup", "pointercancel", "pointerleave"]) duckBtn.addEventListener(t, () => push({ duckUp: true }));
  addEventListener("blur", () => { push({ jumpUp: true }); push({ duckUp: true }); });

  // ---- simulation
  function tick(dt = STEP) {
    const inp = queue.length ? queue.shift() : {};
    inp.dt = dt;
    if (game.playingIntro) { introT += dt; if (introT >= INTRO_MS) { inp.animEnd = true; introT = 0; } } else introT = 0;
    const wasCrashed = game.crashed;
    game.step(inp);
    ticks++;
    crashTicks = game.crashed ? crashTicks + 1 : 0;
    if (!wasCrashed && game.crashed) {
      const s = scoreOf();
      if (s > best) { best = s; try { localStorage.setItem("rea-dino-best", String(best)); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }
    }
    // drifting clouds (looks only)
    const v = game.activated && !game.crashed ? game.currentSpeed * 0.2 : 0;
    for (const c of clouds) { c.x -= v * 0.6; if (c.x < -50) { c.x = W + Math.random() * 200; c.y = 25 + Math.random() * 45; } }
  }

  // ---- drawing (all shapes are rectangles drawn here, nothing is loaded)
  const pal = (night) => night
    ? { sky: "#202124", ink: "#e8e8e8", dim: "#6b6e75", eye: "#202124" }
    : { sky: "#f7f7f7", ink: "#535353", dim: "#c8c8c8", eye: "#f7f7f7" };
  function rects(list, ox, oy, color) { ctx.fillStyle = color; for (const [x, y, w, h] of list) ctx.fillRect(ox + x, oy + y, w, h); }

  function drawDino(g, p) {
    const t = g.tRex, ox = t.xPos, oy = t.yPos;
    const dead = g.crashed;
    const leg = !t.jumping && g.activated && !dead && Math.floor(ticks / 5) % 2 === 0;
    if (t.ducking && !dead) {
      rects([[1, 28, 40, 15], [34, 20, 22, 14], [48, 22, 9, 4], [0, 30, 6, 6], [8, 41, 5, 4], [26, 41, 5, 4]], ox, oy, p.ink);
      rects([[48, 23, 3, 3]], ox, oy, p.eye);
      if (!leg) rects([[8, 43, 5, 2]], ox, oy, p.ink);
      return;
    }
    rects([
      [22, 0, 17, 15], [30, 13, 9, 4],        // head and jaw
      [10, 14, 20, 20],                       // chest
      [4, 22, 8, 10], [0, 26, 6, 6],          // tail
      [26, 24, 8, 3],                         // little arm
      [12, 33, 12, 3],
    ], ox, oy, p.ink);
    // legs: one forward, one back, swap while running
    const a = leg ? 36 : 42, b = leg ? 42 : 36;
    rects([[12, 34, 5, a - 34 + 5], [20, 34, 5, b - 34 + 5]], ox, oy, p.ink);
    rects([[12, 40 + (a === 42 ? 3 : 0), 8, 3]], ox, oy, p.ink);
    if (dead) { rects([[31, 3, 2, 2], [35, 3, 2, 2], [33, 5, 2, 2], [31, 7, 2, 2], [35, 7, 2, 2]], ox, oy, p.eye); }
    else rects([[32, 3, 4, 4]], ox, oy, p.eye);
    rects([[34, 14, 4, 2]], ox, oy, p.eye); // mouth
  }

  function drawCactus(o, p) {
    const small = o.typeConfig.type === "CACTUS_SMALL";
    const uw = o.typeConfig.width, h = o.typeConfig.height;
    for (let i = 0; i < o.size; i++) {
      const x = o.xPos + i * uw, y = o.yPos;
      const stem = small ? 6 : 8, sx = x + Math.round((uw - stem) / 2);
      const arm = small ? [[x, y + 12, 4, 10, 3], [x + uw - 4, y + 6, 4, 12, 3]] : [[x + 1, y + 20, 5, 14, 5], [x + uw - 6, y + 12, 5, 16, 5]];
      ctx.fillStyle = p.ink;
      ctx.fillRect(sx, y, stem, h);
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 1, y - 1, stem - 2, 1);
      for (const [ax, ay, aw, ah, reach] of arm) {
        ctx.fillRect(ax, ay + ah - 4, aw + reach, 4);                       // elbow joined to the stem
        ctx.fillRect(ax, ay, aw, ah);                                       // arm going up
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = p.dim;
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 2, y + 4, 1, h - 10);
    }
  }

  function drawPtero(o, p) {
    const x = o.xPos, y = o.yPos, up = Math.floor(ticks / 9) % 2 === 0;
    rects([[0, 16, 14, 4], [4, 14, 6, 3], [12, 14, 26, 12], [36, 17, 10, 5]], x, y, p.ink);
    if (up) rects([[16, 3, 6, 11], [20, 0, 10, 6]], x, y, p.ink);
    else rects([[16, 26, 6, 10], [20, 33, 10, 6]], x, y, p.ink);
    rects([[8, 15, 2, 2]], x, y, p.eye);
  }

  function drawGround(g, p) {
    ctx.fillStyle = p.ink; ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND, W, 1);
    const scroll = Math.floor(g.distanceRan * 0.9) % 4096;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.dim;
    for (let i = -2; i < W / 9 + 2; i++) {
      const k = Math.floor((i * 9 + scroll) / 9);
      const h = (k * 2654435761 >>> 0) % 7;
      const x = i * 9 - (scroll % 9);
      if (h === 0) ctx.fillRect(x, GROUND + 5, 6, 1);
      else if (h === 1) ctx.fillRect(x, GROUND + 9, 3, 1);
      else if (h === 2) ctx.fillRect(x, GROUND + 3, 2, 2);
    }
  }

  function digits(n, len) { return String(n).padStart(len, "0"); }

  function draw() {
    const night = Math.floor(scoreOf() / 700) % 2 === 1;
    const p = pal(night);
    cv.style.background = p.sky;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.sky; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    // moon and clouds
    if (night) { ctx.fillStyle = p.ink; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(520, 38, 11, 0, 7); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = p.sky; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(526, 35, 10, 0, 7); ctx.fill(); }
    ctx.fillStyle = p.dim;
    for (const c of clouds) { ctx.fillRect(c.x + 6, c.y, 30, 4); ctx.fillRect(c.x, c.y + 4, 46, 5); ctx.fillRect(c.x + 12, c.y - 4, 14, 4); }
    drawGround(game, p);
    for (const o of game.obstacles) { if (o.typeConfig.type === "PTERODACTYL") drawPtero(o, p); else drawCactus(o, p); }
    drawDino(game, p);
    // score
    ctx.font = "bold 13px ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "right"; ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    ctx.fillStyle = p.ink; ctx.fillText(digits(scoreOf(), 5), W - 10, 8);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.dim; ctx.fillText("HI " + digits(best, 5), W - 70, 8);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    if (!game.activated && !game.playing) { ctx.fillStyle = p.ink; ctx.font = "bold 14px system-ui, sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("PRESS SPACE OR TAP TO START", W / 2, 58); }
    if (game.crashed) {
      ctx.fillStyle = p.ink; ctx.font = "bold 17px ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace";
      ctx.fillText("G A M E   O V E R", W / 2, 38);
      // restart arrow
      ctx.strokeStyle = p.ink; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W / 2, 80, 11, 0.5, 5.5); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = p.ink; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(W / 2 + 14, 70); ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + 4, 69); ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + 12, 80); ctx.fill();
      if (crashTicks * STEP >= 750) { ctx.fillStyle = p.dim; ctx.font = "12px system-ui, sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("space / tap / enter", W / 2, 104); }
    }
  }

  // ---- frame loop
  function frame(ts) {
    if (last === null) last = ts;
    acc += Math.min(ts - last, 100);
    last = ts;
    if (!TAPE) while (acc >= STEP) { tick(); acc -= STEP; }
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  if (TAPE) window.__rea = {
    // one frame of the recorded case: the key events dispatched since the last call are merged into one input
    step(dt) { const inp = Object.assign({}, ...queue); queue = []; queue.push(inp); tick(dt); draw(); return game.snapshot(); },
    snapshot: () => game.snapshot(),
    tapeUsed: () => tapeUsed,
  };
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => { last = null; });
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

```

`docs/releases/v1.0.0.md`:

```md
# v1.0.0: rea-games is out

Reverse-engineer any game, rebuild it in any engine, and prove the rebuild plays the same.

rea-games runs the original game with its clock and random numbers controlled from outside, records the inputs, every random number it draws and the game state after each step, and checks any rebuild against that recording. A rebuild only passes when every recorded state matches and it uses exactly the recorded random numbers.

## In this release

- **Three games, verified:** 2048 (19 cases), Chrome's offline Dino (29 cases) and Canvas Bird (30 cases), 155,453 recorded inputs in all.
- **Three engines:** web ports for all three games, plus Rust and Godot 4.4 ports of 2048, each checked by the same `verify` runner.
- **A check that can fail:** every port was broken on purpose (a constant, a collision offset, a timing gate) to make sure `verify` catches it.
- **Agent skill:** a Claude Code and Codex plugin that runs the loop for you: record, write the behavior spec (`GAME.md`), build the port, verify, and report what it could not cover.
- **CLI:** `list`, `new`, `record`, `verify` and `pack`.

## Try it

```bash
npx rea-games list
npx rea-games verify 2048 --port web
```

In Claude Code:

```text
claude plugin marketplace add erkamyaman/rea-games
claude plugin install rea-games@rea-games
```

Then ask: *"rea this game: <link to an open-source game>, rebuild it in Godot."*

Needs Node 22 or newer. Recording browser games also needs Playwright with Chromium.

```

`games/2048/GAME.md`:

```md
# 2048: behavior spec

Original: [gabrielecirulli/2048](https://github.com/gabrielecirulli/2048) (MIT), vendored unmodified in
`originals/2048/src` (the rules live in `game_manager.js`, `grid.js`, `tile.js`). Both ports in this folder
were written from this page, not by translating those files.

## What was recorded

`record.mjs` runs the original `GameManager` unmodified inside a Node `vm`. Only the browser parts are replaced:
the input manager, the actuator, the storage, and `Math.random`, whose every value is saved in the case as `tape`.
After each input the case stores a snapshot: the 4x4 grid (`grid[x][y]`, 0 = empty, x is the column), `score`, `over`,
`won`, `terminated` and `best`. A port must reproduce every snapshot and use exactly the recorded random numbers.

19 cases, 24,044 inputs: 6 random games, 6 "corner" games (mostly left and down, like a human), 2 games with random
restarts, 3 late-game boards full of big tiles, one saved game one merge from the win (covers `won`, `terminated`,
`keepPlaying`) and one that ends because the board fills (covers `over`).

## Rules

- 4x4 grid. A move slides every tile as far as it goes toward the wall. Tiles that touch with the same value merge
  into one of double value, **once per move per tile**, and the pair nearest the wall merges first (`[2,2,2,2]` slides
  to `[4,4,0,0]`, `[2,2,2,0]` to `[4,2,0,0]`).
- Score grows by the value of each merged tile. A merge that makes 2048 sets `won`.
- A move that changes nothing is ignored: no new tile, no actuate, score unchanged.
- After a move that changed the grid, one tile appears. **The random numbers are drawn in this order**: first the value
  (`r < 0.9` gives 2, otherwise 4), then the place (`floor(r * free)` into the free cells listed column by column,
  top to bottom within a column, `x` outer, `y` inner).
- If no cell is free and no two neighbours are equal, `over` is set.
- `terminated = over || (won && !keepPlaying)`. Moves are ignored while terminated.
- `keepPlaying` clears the won overlay only; it does not change the grid or draw a tile. `restart` clears the
  saved game, then sets up a new one with two start tiles (two value+place pairs from the tape).
- `best` is the highest score seen since the page loaded and survives `restart`.

## Quirks worth knowing

- The original replaces its own `keepPlaying` method with a boolean on first use (`this.keepPlaying = true`). It works
  because the handler was already bound, and the port keeps the same behavior with a plain flag.
- `terminated` is not part of what the actuator receives after `keepPlaying`, because that path never calls it. The
  recording reads it from the manager instead, which is what the page shows.
- A fixture bug found while recording: a saved game whose tile `position` fields disagree with their place in the grid
  makes the original misbehave (it moves tiles by their own coordinates). Fixtures set `position` to the cell.

## Not covered

Animations, the tile-merge "pop", touch handling, local storage of best score between page loads, and sizes other
than 4 (the original accepts any, the ports are fixed at 4).

```

`games/2048/ports/bevy/core/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
//! 2048 rules. The random numbers come from a closure: the runner feeds the recorded tape,
//! the game feeds a live generator.

pub const SIZE: usize = 4;
const DIRS: [(i32, i32); 4] = [(0, -1), (1, 0), (0, 1), (-1, 0)];

/// A saved game, as the original's `serialize` gives it.
pub struct Saved {
    pub cells: [[u32; SIZE]; SIZE], // cells[x][y]
    pub score: u64,
    pub over: bool,
    pub won: bool,
    pub kept: bool,
}

pub struct Game {
    pub cells: [[u32; SIZE]; SIZE], // cells[x][y]
    pub score: u64,
    pub best: u64,
    pub over: bool,
    pub won: bool,
    pub kept: bool,
    rng: Box<dyn FnMut() -> f64>,
    used: usize,
}

impl Game {
    /// A new game (two tiles drawn) or, with `saved`, one restored from a saved state.
    pub fn new(rng: Box<dyn FnMut() -> f64>, saved: Option<Saved>) -> Self {
        let mut g = Game {
            cells: [[0; SIZE]; SIZE],
            score: 0,
            best: 0,
            over: false,
            won: false,
            kept: false,
            rng,
            used: 0,
        };
        g.load(saved);
        g
    }

    /// How many random numbers have been drawn.
    pub fn used(&self) -> usize {
        self.used
    }

    fn rng(&mut self) -> f64 {
        self.used += 1;
        (self.rng)()
    }

    /// Start over (None) or restore a saved state; `best` is kept.
    pub fn load(&mut self, saved: Option<Saved>) {
        self.cells = [[0; SIZE]; SIZE];
        if let Some(s) = saved {
            self.cells = s.cells;
            self.score = s.score;
            self.over = s.over;
            self.won = s.won;
            self.kept = s.kept;
        } else {
            self.score = 0;
            self.over = false;
            self.won = false;
            self.kept = false;
            self.add_tile();
            self.add_tile();
        }
        self.best = self.best.max(self.score);
    }

    pub fn restart(&mut self) {
        self.load(None);
    }

    pub fn keep_playing(&mut self) {
        self.kept = true;
    }

    pub fn terminated(&self) -> bool {
        self.over || (self.won && !self.kept)
    }

    fn add_tile(&mut self) {
        let free: Vec<(usize, usize)> = (0..SIZE)
            .flat_map(|x| (0..SIZE).map(move |y| (x, y)))
            .filter(|&(x, y)| self.cells[x][y] == 0)
            .collect();
        if free.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let value = if self.rng() < 0.9 { 2 } else { 4 }; // the value is drawn before the place
        let (x, y) = free[(self.rng() * free.len() as f64).floor() as usize];
        self.cells[x][y] = value;
    }

    fn slide(&mut self, line: [u32; SIZE]) -> ([u32; SIZE], u64) {
        let tiles: Vec<u32> = line.iter().copied().filter(|&v| v != 0).collect();
        let mut out = [0u32; SIZE];
        let (mut n, mut gained, mut i) = (0, 0u64, 0);
        while i < tiles.len() {
            if i + 1 < tiles.len() && tiles[i] == tiles[i + 1] {
                out[n] = tiles[i] * 2;
                gained += out[n] as u64;
                if out[n] == 2048 {
                    self.won = true;
                }
                i += 2;
            } else {
                out[n] = tiles[i];
                i += 1;
            }
            n += 1;
        }
        (out, gained)
    }

    /// Move in direction 0 up, 1 right, 2 down, 3 left.
    pub fn mv(&mut self, dir: usize) {
        if self.terminated() {
            return;
        }
        let (dx, dy) = DIRS[dir];
        let mut moved = false;
        for k in 0..SIZE {
            let coords: Vec<(usize, usize)> = (0..SIZE)
                .map(|i| {
                    let j = if dx + dy > 0 { SIZE - 1 - i } else { i };
                    if dx != 0 {
                        (j, k)
                    } else {
                        (k, j)
                    }
                })
                .collect();
            let mut line = [0u32; SIZE];
            for (i, &(x, y)) in coords.iter().enumerate() {
                line[i] = self.cells[x][y];
            }
            let (out, gained) = self.slide(line);
            for (i, &(x, y)) in coords.iter().enumerate() {
                if self.cells[x][y] != out[i] {
                    moved = true;
                }
                self.cells[x][y] = out[i];
            }
            self.score += gained;
        }
        if !moved {
            return;
        }
        self.add_tile();
        if !self.has_moves() {
            self.over = true;
        }
        self.best = self.best.max(self.score);
    }

    pub fn has_moves(&self) -> bool {
        for x in 0..SIZE {
            for y in 0..SIZE {
                let v = self.cells[x][y];
                if v == 0
                    || (x + 1 < SIZE && self.cells[x + 1][y] == v)
                    || (y + 1 < SIZE && self.cells[x][y + 1] == v)
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        false
    }
}

`games/2048/ports/bevy/game/src/main.rs`:

```rs
//! Playable 2048: game2048-core runs the rules, Bevy draws coloured rectangles with the tile values.
//! Arrow keys or WASD move, R restarts, K keeps playing after 2048. Swipe with the mouse or a touch.
use bevy::prelude::*;
use game2048_core::{Game, SIZE};

const CELL: f32 = 100.0;
const GAP: f32 = 10.0;

/// A small xorshift64* generator, seeded from the clock, for the live game's random numbers.
struct Prng(u64);
impl Prng {
    fn from_clock() -> Prng {
        let n = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map(|d| d.as_nanos() as u64)
            .unwrap_or(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15);
        Prng(n | 1)
    }
    /// Next number in [0, 1).
    fn next(&mut self) -> f64 {
        self.0 ^= self.0 >> 12;
        self.0 ^= self.0 << 25;
        self.0 ^= self.0 >> 27;
        let v = self.0.wrapping_mul(0x2545_F491_4F6C_DD1D);
        (v >> 11) as f64 / (1u64 << 53) as f64
    }
}

struct Live {
    game: Game,
    swipe_start: Option<Vec2>,
}

#[derive(Component)]
struct Drawn;

fn main() {
    let mut p = Prng::from_clock();
    let game = Game::new(Box::new(move || p.next()), None);
    App::new()
        .add_plugins(DefaultPlugins.set(WindowPlugin {
            primary_window: Some(Window {
                title: "2048".into(),
                resolution: (520u32, 600u32).into(),
                ..default()
            }),
            ..default()
        }))
        .insert_resource(ClearColor(Color::srgb_u8(0x14, 0x16, 0x1c)))
        .insert_non_send(Live {
            game,
            swipe_start: None,
        })
        .add_systems(Startup, |mut commands: Commands| {
            commands.spawn(Camera2d);
        })
        .add_systems(Update, (input, draw).chain())
        .run();
}

fn swipe_dir(d: Vec2) -> Option<usize> {
    if d.length() < 30.0 {
        return None;
    }
    // screen y grows downwards
    Some(if d.x.abs() > d.y.abs() {
        if d.x > 0.0 {
            1
        } else {
            3
        }
    } else if d.y > 0.0 {
        2
    } else {
        0
    })
}

fn input(
    keys: Res<ButtonInput<KeyCode>>,
    mouse: Res<ButtonInput<MouseButton>>,
    touches: Res<Touches>,
    windows: Query<&Window>,
    mut live: NonSendMut<Live>,
) {
    let mut dir = None;
    for (k, d) in [
        (KeyCode::ArrowUp, 0),
        (KeyCode::KeyW, 0),
        (KeyCode::ArrowRight, 1),
        (KeyCode::KeyD, 1),
        (KeyCode::ArrowDown, 2),
        (KeyCode::KeyS, 2),
        (KeyCode::ArrowLeft, 3),
        (KeyCode::KeyA, 3),
    ] {
        if keys.just_pressed(k) {
            dir = Some(d);
        }
    }
    // swipe: mouse drag or touch
    if mouse.just_pressed(MouseButton::Left) {
        live.swipe_start = windows.iter().next().and_then(|w| w.cursor_position());
    }
    if mouse.just_released(MouseButton::Left) {
        if let (Some(a), Some(b)) = (
            live.swipe_start.take(),
            windows.iter().next().and_then(|w| w.cursor_position()),
        ) {
            dir = dir.or(swipe_dir(b - a));
        }
    }
    for t in touches.iter_just_released() {
        dir = dir.or(swipe_dir(t.position() - t.start_position()));
    }
    let g = &mut live.game;
    if let Some(d) = dir {
        g.mv(d);
    }
    if keys.just_pressed(KeyCode::KeyR) {
        g.restart();
    }
    if keys.just_pressed(KeyCode::KeyK) && g.won {
        g.keep_playing();
    }
}

fn tile_color(v: u32) -> Color {
    match v {
        0 => Color::srgb_u8(0x2b, 0x30, 0x3c),
        2 => Color::srgb_u8(0x3b, 0x42, 0x52),
        4 => Color::srgb_u8(0x43, 0x4c, 0x5e),
        8 => Color::srgb_u8(0xd0, 0x87, 0x70),
        16 => Color::srgb_u8(0xd9, 0x77, 0x4f),
        32 => Color::srgb_u8(0xe0, 0x61, 0x3b),
        64 => Color::srgb_u8(0xe8, 0x4a, 0x2c),
        128 => Color::srgb_u8(0xeb, 0xcb, 0x8b),
        256 => Color::srgb_u8(0xe8, 0xc2, 0x6a),
        512 => Color::srgb_u8(0xe6, 0xb8, 0x4a),
        1024 => Color::srgb_u8(0xa3, 0xbe, 0x8c),
        2048 => Color::srgb_u8(0x88, 0xc0, 0xd0),
        _ => Color::srgb_u8(0xb4, 0x8e, 0xad),
    }
}

fn draw(
    mut commands: Commands,
    old: Query<Entity, With<Drawn>>,
    live: NonSend<Live>,
    mut windows: Query<&mut Window>,
) {
    for e in &old {
        commands.entity(e).despawn();
    }
    let g = &live.game;
    let board = SIZE as f32 * CELL + (SIZE as f32 + 1.0) * GAP;
    let origin = Vec2::new(0.0, -40.0);
    commands.spawn((
        Sprite::from_color(Color::srgb_u8(0x20, 0x24, 0x2e), Vec2::splat(board)),
        Transform::from_xyz(origin.x, origin.y, 0.0),
        Drawn,
    ));
    for x in 0..SIZE {
        for y in 0..SIZE {
            let v = g.cells[x][y];
            let cx = origin.x + (x as f32 - 1.5) * (CELL + GAP);
            let cy = origin.y + (1.5 - y as f32) * (CELL + GAP);
            commands.spawn((
                Sprite::from_color(tile_color(v), Vec2::splat(CELL)),
                Transform::from_xyz(cx, cy, 1.0),
                Drawn,
            ));
            if v != 0 {
                let ink = if v <= 4 {
                    Color::srgb_u8(0xe8, 0xea, 0xf0)
                } else if v <= 64 || v > 2048 {
                    Color::WHITE
                } else {
                    Color::srgb_u8(0x22, 0x22, 0x22)
                };
                let size = if v < 100 {
                    48.0
                } else if v < 1000 {
                    40.0
                } else {
                    32.0
                };
                commands.spawn((
                    Text2d::new(v.to_string()),
                    TextFont {
                        font_size: FontSize::Px(size),
                        ..default()
                    },
                    TextColor(ink),
                    Transform::from_xyz(cx, cy, 2.0),
                    Drawn,
                ));
            }
        }
    }
    let status = if g.over {
        "  GAME OVER (R)"
    } else if g.won && !g.kept {
        "  YOU WIN! (K keep playing, R restart)"
    } else {
        ""
    };
    if let Some(mut w) = windows.iter_mut().next() {
        w.title = format!("2048  score {}  best {}{}", g.score, g.best, status);
    }
}

`games/2048/ports/bevy/runner/src/main.rs`:

```rs
//! Runner protocol: a case on stdin, the port's trace on stdout.
use game2048_core::{Game, Saved, SIZE};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::io::Read;
use std::rc::Rc;

fn saved(v: &Value) -> Option<Saved> {
    if !v.is_object() {
        return None;
    }
    let mut cells = [[0; SIZE]; SIZE];
    for (x, col) in v["grid"]["cells"].as_array().unwrap().iter().enumerate() {
        for (y, t) in col.as_array().unwrap().iter().enumerate() {
            cells[x][y] = t["value"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as u32;
        }
    }
    Some(Saved {
        cells,
        score: v["score"].as_u64().unwrap(),
        over: v["over"].as_bool().unwrap(),
        won: v["won"].as_bool().unwrap(),
        kept: v["keepPlaying"].as_bool().unwrap(),
    })
}

fn snapshot(g: &Game) -> Value {
    json!({ "grid": g.cells, "score": g.score, "over": g.over, "won": g.won, "terminated": g.terminated(), "best": g.best })
}

fn main() {
    let mut s = String::new();
    std::io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut s).unwrap();
    let c: Value = serde_json::from_str(&s).unwrap();
    let tape: Rc<Vec<f64>> = Rc::new(
        c["tape"]
            .as_array()
            .unwrap()
            .iter()
            .map(|v| v.as_f64().unwrap())
            .collect(),
    );
    let mut pos = 0;
    let t = tape.clone();
    let rng = Box::new(move || {
        let v = t[pos];
        pos += 1;
        v
    });
    let mut g = Game::new(rng, saved(&c["initial"]));
    let mut trace = vec![snapshot(&g)];
    for i in c["inputs"].as_array().unwrap() {
        match i["t"].as_str().unwrap() {
            "move" => g.mv(i["d"].as_u64().unwrap() as usize),
            "restart" => g.restart(),
            "keep" => g.keep_playing(),
            other => panic!("unknown input {other}"),
        }
        trace.push(snapshot(&g));
    }
    println!("{}", json!({ "trace": trace, "tapeUsed": g.used() }));
}

```

`games/2048/ports/godot/game2048.gd`:

```gd
# 2048, written from games/2048/GAME.md. cells[x][y], column first, like the recording.
extends RefCounted

const SIZE := 4
const DIRS := [[0, -1], [1, 0], [0, 1], [-1, 0]] # up, right, down, left as (dx, dy)

var cells: Array = []
var score := 0
var best := 0
var over := false
var won := false
var kept := false
var tape: Array = []
var used := 0
var live := false # play mode: draw from the engine's generator instead of a recorded tape

func _init(p_tape: Array, initial, p_live := false) -> void:
	tape = p_tape
	live = p_live
	load_state(initial)

func rng() -> float:
	if live:
		return randf()
	var v: float = tape[used]
	used += 1
	return v

func load_state(saved) -> void:
	cells = []
	for x in SIZE:
		var col := []
		col.resize(SIZE)
		col.fill(0)
		cells.append(col)
	if saved is Dictionary:
		var cols: Array = saved["grid"]["cells"]
		for x in SIZE:
			for y in SIZE:
				var t = cols[x][y]
				cells[x][y] = int(t["value"]) if t != null else 0
		score = int(saved["score"])
		over = saved["over"]
		won = saved["won"]
		kept = saved["keepPlaying"]
	else:
		score = 0
		over = false
		won = false
		kept = false
		add_tile()
		add_tile()
	best = maxi(best, score)

func terminated() -> bool:
	return over or (won and not kept)

func restart() -> void:
	load_state(null)

func keep_playing() -> void:
	kept = true

func add_tile() -> void:
	var free := []
	for x in SIZE:
		for y in SIZE:
			if cells[x][y] == 0:
				free.append([x, y])
	if free.is_empty():
		return
	var value := 2 if rng() < 0.9 else 4 # the value is drawn before the place
	var pick: Array = free[int(floor(rng() * free.size()))]
	cells[pick[0]][pick[1]] = value

# Slide one line toward its start; a tile merges at most once, the pair nearest the wall first.
func slide(line: Array) -> Array:
	var tiles := []
	for v in line:
		if v != 0:
			tiles.append(v)
	var out := []
	var gained := 0
	var i := 0
	while i < tiles.size():
		if i + 1 < tiles.size() and tiles[i] == tiles[i + 1]:
			var m: int = tiles[i] * 2
			out.append(m)
			gained += m
			if m == 2048:
				won = true
			i += 2
		else:
			out.append(tiles[i])
			i += 1
	while out.size() < SIZE:
		out.append(0)
	return [out, gained]

func move(dir: int) -> void:
	if terminated():
		return
	var dx: int = DIRS[dir][0]
	var dy: int = DIRS[dir][1]
	var moved := false
	for k in SIZE:
		var coords := []
		for i in SIZE:
			var j: int = (SIZE - 1 - i) if (dx + dy > 0) else i
			coords.append([j, k] if dx != 0 else [k, j])
		var line := []
		for c in coords:
			line.append(cells[c[0]][c[1]])
		var res := slide(line)
		var out: Array = res[0]
		for i in SIZE:
			var c: Array = coords[i]
			if cells[c[0]][c[1]] != out[i]:
				moved = true
			cells[c[0]][c[1]] = out[i]
		score += res[1]
	if not moved:
		return
	add_tile()
	if not has_moves():
		over = true
	best = maxi(best, score)

func has_moves() -> bool:
	for x in SIZE:
		for y in SIZE:
			var v: int = cells[x][y]
			if v == 0:
				return true
			if x + 1 < SIZE and cells[x + 1][y] == v:
				return true
			if y + 1 < SIZE and cells[x][y + 1] == v:
				return true
	return false

func snapshot() -> Dictionary:
	var g := []
	for x in SIZE:
		g.append(cells[x].duplicate())
	return {"grid": g, "score": score, "over": over, "won": won, "terminated": terminated(), "best": best}

```

# Playable 2048 in Godot: arrow keys / WASD, R restarts. The rules are game2048.gd, the same file the check runs.
extends Control

const Game := preload("res://game2048.gd")
const COLORS := {0: Color("2b303c"), 2: Color("3b4252"), 4: Color("434c5e"), 8: Color("d08770"), 16: Color("d9774f"),
	32: Color("e0613b"), 64: Color("e84a2c"), 128: Color("ebcb8b"), 256: Color("e8c26a"), 512: Color("e6b84a"),
	1024: Color("a3be8c"), 2048: Color("88c0d0")}

var game

func _ready() -> void:
	randomize()
	game = Game.new([], null, true)
	queue_redraw()

func _unhandled_input(e: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not (e is InputEventKey and e.pressed):
		return
	var dir := -1
	match e.keycode:
		KEY_UP, KEY_W: dir = 0
		KEY_RIGHT, KEY_D: dir = 1
		KEY_DOWN, KEY_S: dir = 2
		KEY_LEFT, KEY_A: dir = 3
		KEY_R: game.restart()
		KEY_K: game.keep_playing()
	if dir >= 0:
		game.move(dir)
	queue_redraw()

func _draw() -> void:
	var s: Dictionary = game.snapshot()
	var side := minf(size.x, size.y) * 0.9
	var origin := (size - Vector2(side, side)) / 2.0
	draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), Color("14161c"))
	draw_rect(Rect2(origin, Vector2(side, side)), Color("20242e"))
	var cell := side / 4.0
	var font := ThemeDB.fallback_font
	for x in 4:
		for y in 4:
			var v: int = s["grid"][x][y]
			var r := Rect2(origin + Vector2(x, y) * cell + Vector2(6, 6), Vector2(cell - 12, cell - 12))
			draw_rect(r, COLORS.get(v, Color("b48ead")))
			if v > 0:
				draw_string(font, r.position + Vector2(0, r.size.y * 0.62), str(v), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, r.size.x, int(cell * 0.32))
	draw_string(font, Vector2(origin.x, origin.y - 12), "score %d   best %d" % [s["score"], s["best"]], HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 22)
	if s["terminated"]:
		draw_rect(Rect2(origin, Vector2(side, side)), Color(0.08, 0.09, 0.11, 0.82))
		draw_string(font, origin + Vector2(0, side * 0.5), "Game over" if s["over"] else "2048! K keeps playing, R restarts", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, side, 30)

# Runner protocol: a case on stdin, {trace, tapeUsed} on stdout.
# godot --headless --quiet --path ports/godot --script runner.gd < case.json
extends SceneTree

const Game := preload("res://game2048.gd")

func _init() -> void:
	# one line of JSON, as the runner protocol sends it (a pipe cannot be opened as a file here)
	var text := OS.read_string_from_stdin(1 << 25)
	var c = JSON.parse_string(text)
	if c == null:
		printerr("runner: no case on stdin")
		quit(1) # a script error would leave the engine running forever
		return
	var g = Game.new(c["tape"], c["initial"])
	var trace := [g.snapshot()]
	for i in c["inputs"]:
		match i["t"]:
			"move": g.move(int(i["d"]))
			"restart": g.restart()
			"keep": g.keep_playing()
		trace.append(g.snapshot())
	print(JSON.stringify({"trace": trace, "tapeUsed": g.used}))
	quit()

`games/2048/ports/web/game2048.mjs`:

```mjs
// 2048, written from games/2048/GAME.md. Cells are stored as cells[x][y] (column first),
// the same layout the recording uses, so snapshots compare directly.
export const SIZE = 4;
const DIRS = [[0, -1], [1, 0], [0, 1], [-1, 0]]; // up, right, down, left as (dx, dy)

export class Game2048 {
  constructor({ rng = Math.random, initial = null } = {}) {
    this.rng = rng;
    this.best = 0;
    this.load(initial);
  }

  load(saved) {
    if (saved) {
      this.cells = saved.grid.cells.map((col) => col.map((t) => (t ? t.value : 0)));
      ({ score: this.score, over: this.over, won: this.won, keepPlaying: this.kept } = saved);
    } else {
      this.cells = Array.from({ length: SIZE }, () => Array(SIZE).fill(0));
      this.score = 0;
      this.over = this.won = this.kept = false;
      this.addTile();
      this.addTile();
    }
    this.best = Math.max(this.best, this.score);
  }

  get terminated() { return this.over || (this.won && !this.kept); }

  restart() { this.load(null); }
  keepPlaying() { this.kept = true; }

  empty() {
    const out = [];
    for (let x = 0; x < SIZE; x++) for (let y = 0; y < SIZE; y++) if (!this.cells[x][y]) out.push([x, y]);
    return out;
  }

  addTile() {
    const free = this.empty();
    if (!free.length) return;
    const value = this.rng() < 0.9 ? 2 : 4; // the value is drawn before the place
    const [x, y] = free[Math.floor(this.rng() * free.length)];
    this.cells[x][y] = value;
  }

  // Slide one line toward its start. A tile merges at most once per move, and the pair
  // nearest the wall merges first.
  slide(line) {
    const tiles = line.filter(Boolean);
    const out = [];
    let gained = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < tiles.length; i++) {
      if (tiles[i] === tiles[i + 1]) {
        out.push(tiles[i] * 2);
        gained += tiles[i] * 2;
        if (tiles[i] * 2 === 2048) this.won = true;
        i++;
      } else out.push(tiles[i]);
    }
    while (out.length < SIZE) out.push(0);
    return { out, gained };
  }

  move(dir) {
    if (this.terminated) return false;
    const [dx, dy] = DIRS[dir];
    let moved = false;
    for (let k = 0; k < SIZE; k++) {
      // the k-th line, listed from the wall the tiles move toward
      const coords = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < SIZE; i++) {
        const j = dx + dy > 0 ? SIZE - 1 - i : i; // moving right or down: the wall is at the end
        coords.push(dx !== 0 ? [j, k] : [k, j]);
      }
      const { out, gained } = this.slide(coords.map(([x, y]) => this.cells[x][y]));
      coords.forEach(([x, y], i) => {
        if (this.cells[x][y] !== out[i]) moved = true;
        this.cells[x][y] = out[i];
      });
      this.score += gained;
    }
    if (!moved) return false;
    this.addTile();
    if (!this.hasMoves()) this.over = true;
    this.best = Math.max(this.best, this.score);
    return true;
  }

  hasMoves() {
    if (this.empty().length) return true;
    for (let x = 0; x < SIZE; x++) for (let y = 0; y < SIZE; y++) {
      const v = this.cells[x][y];
      if ((x + 1 < SIZE && this.cells[x + 1][y] === v) || (y + 1 < SIZE && this.cells[x][y + 1] === v)) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  snapshot() {
    return {
      grid: this.cells.map((c) => c.slice()),
      score: this.score, over: this.over, won: this.won, terminated: this.terminated, best: this.best,
    };
  }
}

```

  button { background:var(--accent); color:#fff; border:0; border-radius:8px; padding:10px 18px; font:inherit; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; }
  p { color:var(--muted); font-size:14px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main>
  <header>
    <h1>2048</h1>
    <div class="scores"><div class="box"><small>score</small><b id="score">0</b></div><div class="box"><small>best</small><b id="best">0</b></div></div>
  </header>
  <div id="board"><div id="msg"><h2 id="msgtitle"></h2><div><button id="keep">Keep playing</button> <button id="again">New game</button></div></div></div>

import { Game2048, SIZE } from "./game2048.mjs";
const game = new Game2048();
const board = document.getElementById("board");
const cells = [];
for (let y = 0; y < SIZE; y++) for (let x = 0; x < SIZE; x++) { const c = document.createElement("div"); c.className = "cell"; board.append(c); cells.push([x, y, c]); }
function draw() {
  const s = game.snapshot();
  for (const [x, y, c] of cells) { const v = s.grid[x][y]; c.textContent = v || ""; c.className = "cell" + (v ? " " + (v <= 2048 ? "v" + v : "vbig") : ""); }
  score.textContent = s.score; best.textContent = s.best;

  msgtitle.textContent = s.over ? "Game over" : "You made 2048";

}

  if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) < 24) return;
  game.move(Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) ? (dx > 0 ? 1 : 3) : (dy > 0 ? 2 : 0)); draw();
});

// Runner protocol: a case on stdin, the port's trace on stdout.
import { Game2048 } from "./game2048.mjs";

const c = JSON.parse(await new Promise((r) => { let s = ""; process.stdin.on("data", (d) => (s += d)).on("end", () => r(s)); }));
let used = 0;
const rng = () => { if (used >= c.tape.length) throw new Error("port asked for more random numbers than the original used"); return c.tape[used++]; };
const g = new Game2048({ rng, initial: c.initial });
const trace = [g.snapshot()];
for (const i of c.inputs) {
  if (i.t === "move") g.move(i.d);
  else if (i.t === "restart") g.restart();
  else if (i.t === "keep") g.keepPlaying();
  trace.push(g.snapshot());
}
process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ trace, tapeUsed: used }));

`games/2048/record.mjs`:

```mjs
// Records the ORIGINAL 2048 (originals/2048/src, MIT) into replayable cases.
// The original is run unmodified inside a vm. Only its inputs are replaced:
// Math.random (a tape records every value it hands out), the input manager,
// the actuator and the storage, which are the browser parts of the game.
import vm from "node:vm";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { mulberry32 } from "../../lib/rng.mjs";

const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const src = path.join(here, "../../originals/2048/src");
const load = (f) => fs.readFileSync(path.join(src, f), "utf8");

export function runOriginal({ seed, initial, inputs }) {
  const rand = mulberry32(seed);
  const tape = [];
  const handlers = {};
  let last = null;
  let best = 0;
  let saved = initial ?? null;

  const ctx = vm.createContext({});
  vm.runInContext("Math.random = __rand;", Object.assign(ctx, { __rand: () => { const v = rand(); tape.push(v); return v; } }));
  ctx.InputManager = function () { this.on = (e, cb) => { handlers[e] = cb; }; };
  ctx.Actuator = function () {
    this.actuate = (grid, meta) => {
      last = {
        grid: grid.cells.map((col) => col.map((t) => (t ? t.value : 0))),
        score: meta.score, over: meta.over, won: meta.won, terminated: meta.terminated, best: meta.bestScore,
      };
    };
    this.continueGame = () => {};
  };
  ctx.StorageManager = function () {
    this.getBestScore = () => best;
    this.setBestScore = (s) => { best = s; };
    this.getGameState = () => saved;
    this.setGameState = (s) => { saved = s; };
    this.clearGameState = () => { saved = null; };
  };
  for (const f of ["tile.js", "grid.js", "game_manager.js"]) vm.runInContext(load(f), ctx);
  const gm = vm.runInContext("new GameManager(4, InputManager, Actuator, StorageManager);", ctx);
  // keepPlaying() does not actuate, so "terminated" is read from the manager, as the page does
  const snap = () => ({ ...JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(last)), terminated: gm.isGameTerminated() });

  const trace = [snap()];
  for (const i of inputs) {
    if (i.t === "move") handlers.move(i.d);
    else if (i.t === "restart") handlers.restart();
    else if (i.t === "keep") handlers.keepPlaying();
    trace.push(snap());
  }
  return { tape, trace };
}

function makeInputs(kind, seed, n) {
  const r = mulberry32(seed * 7919 + 13);
  const out = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    if (kind === "random") out.push({ t: "move", d: Math.floor(r() * 4) });
    else if (kind === "corner") {
      // left/down most of the time, sometimes right or up, as a human would
      const x = r();
      out.push({ t: "move", d: x < 0.45 ? 3 : x < 0.9 ? 2 : x < 0.97 ? 1 : 0 });
    } else if (kind === "restarts") {
      out.push(r() < 0.02 ? { t: "restart" } : { t: "move", d: Math.floor(r() * 4) });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

const winGrid = (rows) => ({
  grid: { size: 4, cells: rows.map((col, x) => col.map((v, y) => (v ? { position: { x, y }, value: v } : null))) },
  score: 20000, over: false, won: false, keepPlaying: false,
});

export function buildCases() {
  const cases = [];
  for (let s = 1; s <= 6; s++) cases.push({ name: `random-${s}`, seed: s, kind: "random", n: 600 });
  for (let s = 1; s <= 6; s++) cases.push({ name: `corner-${s}`, seed: 100 + s, kind: "corner", n: 3000 });
  for (let s = 1; s <= 2; s++) cases.push({ name: `restarts-${s}`, seed: 200 + s, kind: "restarts", n: 800 });
  // a saved game one merge from the win, to cover won / terminated / keepPlaying
  const near = winGrid([[1024, 1024, 0, 0], [2, 4, 8, 16], [32, 64, 128, 256], [0, 0, 0, 0]]);
  cases.push({
    name: "win-then-keep-playing", seed: 301, initial: near,
    inputs: [{ t: "move", d: 0 }, { t: "move", d: 1 }, { t: "move", d: 3 }, { t: "keep" }, { t: "move", d: 1 }, { t: "move", d: 2 }, { t: "move", d: 3 }, { t: "restart" }, { t: "move", d: 0 }],
  });
  // a saved game with no moves left: the game must end on the move that fills the board
  const full = winGrid([[2, 4, 2, 4], [4, 2, 4, 2], [2, 4, 2, 4], [4, 2, 4, 0]]);
  // which seed ends it depends on the value the new tile gets, so take the first seed that does
  const fillInputs = [{ t: "move", d: 2 }, { t: "move", d: 0 }, { t: "move", d: 1 }, { t: "restart" }, { t: "move", d: 3 }];
  let fillSeed = 302;
  while (!runOriginal({ seed: fillSeed, initial: full, inputs: fillInputs }).trace.some((t) => t.over)) fillSeed++;
  cases.push({ name: "board-fills-then-over", seed: fillSeed, initial: full, inputs: fillInputs });
  // late-game boards: big tiles everywhere, random play, so merges of every size are covered
  const late = [
    [[512, 256, 128, 64], [32, 16, 8, 4], [0, 0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0, 0]],
    [[1024, 512, 0, 0], [256, 256, 0, 0], [128, 128, 64, 64], [2, 2, 4, 4]],
    [[2, 0, 0, 2], [0, 1024, 1024, 0], [0, 0, 0, 0], [4, 0, 0, 4]],
  ];
  late.forEach((rows, i) => cases.push({ name: `late-game-${i + 1}`, seed: 400 + i, kind: "random", n: i === 2 ? 30 : 400, initial: winGrid(rows) }));
  return cases;
}

export function record() {
  const outDir = path.join(here, "cases");
  fs.mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true });
  let total = 0;
  for (const c of buildCases()) {
    const inputs = c.inputs ?? makeInputs(c.kind, c.seed, c.n);
    const { tape, trace } = runOriginal({ seed: c.seed, initial: c.initial, inputs });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, `${c.name}.json`), JSON.stringify({ game: "2048", name: c.name, initial: c.initial ?? null, tape, inputs, trace }));
    total += inputs.length;
  }
  return { cases: buildCases().length, inputs: total };
}

if (process.argv[1] === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) console.log(record());

```

`games/blocks/GAME.md`:

```md
# Blocks: behavior spec

Original: a falling-blocks puzzle (MIT), vendored unmodified in `originals/blocks` (`index.html`, about 250 lines of
game code inline; `stats.js` is an FPS widget, `texture.jpg` a CSS background). The port in `ports/web/blocks.mjs`
was written from this page and from reading the original's rules, not by translating them line by line.

## What was recorded and how

The page runs unmodified in headless Chrome (`driver.mjs`). Its state lives in top-level `var`s, so it is read from
the live page after every frame: `blocks`, `current`, `next`, `pieces` (the bag), `score`, `vscore`, `rows`, `step`,
`dt`, `playing`, `actions`. Only its inputs are replaced:

- **Clock.** `Date.now`, `new Date()` (the page reads time with `new Date().getTime()`), `performance.now`,
  `requestAnimationFrame` and `cancelAnimationFrame` are faked. The page advances only when the driver calls
  `step({dt, keys})`: the key events are dispatched in order, the clock moves by `dt` ms (it starts at 1000000 and
  accumulates the float values), then the queued animation callback runs once. The page sees `floor(t)`.
- **Random.** `Math.random` is a seeded generator; every value handed out is saved as `tape`.
- The start link's href is `javascript:play();`. Following a link runs that in a later task, so the key `"play"` calls
  `play()` directly inside the frame (the same function the link calls).

A case is `{game, name, seed, clock0, tape, inputs: [{dt, keys}], trace}`; `keys` is an ordered list of
`left right up down esc space play`. `trace[0]` is the state after load, `trace[i]` the state after `inputs[i-1]`.
A state is `{grid: 20 strings of 10 chars ('.' or piece letter), current: {type, x, y, dir}, next: {...}, bag: letters
left in the bag in splice order, score, vscore, rows, step, dt (the gravity accumulator), playing, actions
(queued actions: 0 up/rotate, 1 right, 2 down, 3 left)}`. Numbers are compared exactly (`lib/compare.mjs`).
The inputs come from scripted players and bots that look only at the previous state (`record.mjs`).

## Constants

| | |
|---|---|
| court | 10 columns x 20 rows, cell `[x][y]` holds the piece type that locked there |
| pieces | `i j l o s t z`, a 4x4 bitmask per rotation, `0x8000` is the top-left cell, rows left to right |
| masks | i `0F00 2222 00F0 4444`, j `44C0 8E00 6440 0E20`, l `4460 0E80 C440 2E00`, o `CC00` x4, s `06C0 8C40 6C00 4620`, t `0E40 4C40 4E00 4640`, z `0C60 4C80 C600 2640` |
| sizes | i 4, j l s t z 3, o 2 (used for the spawn column only) |
| gravity | `step = max(0.1, 0.6 - 0.005 * rows)` seconds per row; 0.6 at 0 rows, 0.1 from 100 rows |
| dir | 0 spawn, then +1 per rotation (clockwise), wraps 3 -> 0 |

## Randomness (the tape order)

`random(a, b) = a + Math.random() * (b - a)` is a float, and `randomChoice` is not used by the pieces. A piece is made
by `randomPiece()`:

1. If the bag is empty, refill it with four of each type, in the order i j l o s t z (28 pieces).
2. `Math.random()` number 1: the bag index is `random(0, len - 1)` and `splice` truncates it, so the index is
   `floor(r * (len - 1))`: **the last piece in the bag can never be drawn until it is the only one left.**
3. `Math.random()` number 2: the spawn column `x = Math.round(r * (10 - size))`, `y = 0`, `dir = 0`.

Two numbers per piece, always in that order. The bag is a global that survives a game over and a restart. At load
`reset()` draws `current` then `next` (4 numbers). Every start (`play()` runs `reset()`) moves `next` to `current`
and draws one new `next` (2 numbers). Every lock draws one new `next` (2 numbers).

## Order of operations in one rendered frame

A step is: the key events (in order), then the animation callback `frame()`: `now = floor(t)`,
`update(min(1, (now - last) / 1000))`, `last = now`. `update(idt)`:

1. If not `playing`: nothing happens (the game does not run, `dt` and the queue stay as they were).
2. If `vscore < score`: `vscore += 1`.
3. `handle(actions.shift())`: at most ONE queued action per frame (left, right: move one cell if the cells are
   free; up: rotate; down: `drop()`).
4. `dt += idt`; if `dt > step` (strictly): `dt -= step` and `drop()`. At most one gravity drop per frame, so a frame
   longer than two steps leaves the rest in `dt`; `dt` is not reset by a lock.

Step 4 runs even when step 3 locked a piece or ended the game (see quirks).

**Keys** (`keydown`): while playing, left/right/up/down push `DIR.LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN` on `actions` (no limit: the
queue can hold hundreds when keys come faster than one per frame), Escape calls `lose()`, every other key does
nothing. While not playing, Space calls `play()`, everything else (arrows, Escape) is ignored. `play()` itself
(`reset()` then `playing = true`) works whatever the state: it is also the start link.

**`reset()`**: `dt = 0`, queue emptied, court emptied, `rows = 0` (so `step = 0.6`), `score = 0`, `vscore = 0`,
`current = next` (a new piece only at load), `next = randomPiece()`.

**Move / rotate.** A move checks all four cells of the piece at the new place: outside the court (`x < 0`,
`x >= 10`, `y < 0`, `y >= 20`) or on an occupied cell blocks it, and a blocked move changes nothing. Rotation turns in
place to `dir + 1`; **there are no wall kicks**, a rotation that would hit a wall, the floor or a block is dropped.

**`drop()`** (gravity, and the down key): if the piece can move one row down, it does. Otherwise it locks:
1. `score += 10`;
2. its four cells are written into the court;
3. `removeLines()` (below);
4. `current = next`, `next = randomPiece()` (2 numbers), `actions` emptied;
5. if the new `current` already overlaps something: `lose()`.

**`removeLines()`**: scans rows 19 down to 1 (row 20 does not exist, **row 0 is never examined**). A full row is removed
by copying every row above it down by one and emptying row 0, then the same row index is looked at again. After the
scan, if `n > 0` rows went: `rows += n` (which recomputes `step`), then `score += 100 * 2^(n-1)`: 100, 200, 400, 800.
`vscore` is not touched.

**`lose()`**: `vscore = score`, `playing = false`. The court, the pieces and the queue stay; the next `play()` clears
them.

## What is traced but does not affect play

`vscore` is the displayed score: it catches up to `score` one point per frame while playing. Nothing reads it for
play, but it is in the trace and compared exactly, so the port has it.

## What is NOT modelled, and why that is safe

- **Rendering** (`draw`, `drawCourt`, `drawNext`, `drawBlock`, the `invalid*` flags, `resize`, `dx`/`dy`): they only
  read the game variables and write to the canvases and two text nodes. None of them writes a game variable.
- **The stats widget** (`stats.js`, `stats.update()`): it reads the clock and draws into its own canvases.
- **The start link's visibility and the texture**: CSS and the `visibility` style of one element.
- **Window resize**: changes only pixel sizes.
- **Real key events beyond `keyCode`**: the page reads only `keyCode` from `keydown`; repeats arrive as more
  `keydown` events, which the cases model as more `keys` entries.

## Quirks (kept on purpose, all in the recording)

- The bag's last piece is skipped until it is alone (index `floor(r * (len - 1))`). With one piece left the index is 0.
- `Math.round` on the spawn column: `round(r * (10 - size))`, so a size-4 piece spawns in columns 0..6 and columns 0 and
  6 are drawn about half as often as the others.
- One queued action per frame: holding a key faster than 60 Hz builds a queue that drains slowly. A lock empties it.
- **After a lock that ends the game by an action**, step 4 can still run: `dt > step` then calls `drop()` on the piece that
  overlaps the stack. That piece may move down (if the cells below it are free), or lock again (`score += 10`, more
  cells written, `next` replaced, one more pair of random numbers) while `playing` is already false. Seen in the
  recordings (3 frames), and the port repeats it because it keeps the same order.
- `vscore` stops catching up while the game is over (`update` does nothing), and `lose()` sets it to `score` at once.
- The step is `max(0.1, 0.6 - 0.005 * rows)`; the float result is what is compared (the recordings hold 0.595, 0.596 ... down to 0.1), the port computes the same
  expression, so equal bits.
- A frame's `idt` is computed from whole milliseconds: with `dt = 16.666...` the page sees 16 or 17 ms per frame, never
  16.667. The port keeps the clock as a float and reads `floor(t)` the same way, so `dt` (the accumulator) matches bit for
  bit. `idt` is capped at 1 s.
- Row 0 is never checked for a full line, so a full top row would stay (not reachable in play: a piece that fills it ends
  the game first; the recording never reaches it).
- Escape while playing ends the game with no points added; there is no pause.

## Coverage of the recordings

Read off the traces by `analyze()` in `record.mjs` (independent of the port). 36 cases, 104,208 inputs, 104,244 states,
created by `rea-games record blocks` (cases are stored gzipped, 1.2 MB):

| | |
|---|---|
| games started / restarted after a loss | 142 / 106 (109 losses: 71 by stacking out, 38 by Escape) |
| pieces locked | 3,271, every type 451-476 times |
| line clears | 1 row: 461, 2 rows: 79, 3 rows: 23, 4 rows: 20 |
| most rows / score in one case | 131 rows (step reaches its floor 0.1), 17,690 points |
| rotations tried | 8,361; every type reaches every direction (28 type x direction pairs, 114-503 times each) |
| rotations dropped | 560 by a wall or the floor, 433 by a block; 869 of them would have turned with a one-cell kick |
| moves tried / blocked | 12,674 / 1,240 |
| soft drops (down key handled) / gravity drops | 38,873 / 2,630 |
| frames with keys while stopped | 35 (arrows, Escape; Space and the start link also while playing) |
| longest action queue | 177 |
| queue emptied by a lock | 204 |
| frames where a lose was followed by a second drop (quirk above) | 3 |
| dt values | 16.667 mostly, also 8, 20, 33, 50, 100 ms (fixed per case and mixed per frame) |

The analyzer's own prediction of every handled rotation (turns or not, from the previous grid) agreed with the
original in all cases (0 mismatches), which checks the bots' copy of the shapes and the reading of the queue.

```

`games/blocks/driver.mjs`:

```mjs
// Runs the ORIGINAL "blocks" page (originals/blocks, MIT, vendored unmodified) in headless Chrome and
// reads its state from the live page globals. Only its inputs are replaced: a fake clock (Date.now,
// performance.now, requestAnimationFrame, cancelAnimationFrame) and a seeded Math.random whose every value
// goes to a tape. The page's own stats widget (stats.js) and CSS texture are left alone: they only draw
// into their own elements and never touch the game's variables.
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
export const ORIGINAL = path.join(here, "../../originals/blocks/index.html");
export const T0 = 1000000; // the fake clock's start, in ms (the port uses the same)
export const KEYCODES = { esc: 27, space: 32, left: 37, up: 38, right: 39, down: 40 };

function loadPlaywright() {
  const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);
  const tries = ["playwright", process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH, "/opt/node22/lib/node_modules/playwright", "/opt/node-tools/node_modules/playwright"].filter(Boolean);
  for (const t of tries) { try { return require(t); } catch {} }
  throw new Error("playwright not found; set PLAYWRIGHT_PATH");
}

// runs in the page before any of its scripts
function install({ seed, T0, KEYCODES }) {
  let t = T0;
  const queue = [];
  const tape = [];
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  Math.random = () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let x = a;
    x = Math.imul(x ^ (x >>> 15), x | 1);
    x ^= x + Math.imul(x ^ (x >>> 7), x | 61);
    const v = ((x ^ (x >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    tape.push(v);
    return v;
  };
  // the page reads the time with `new Date().getTime()`, so the Date constructor is replaced as well
  const RealDate = Date;
  const FakeDate = function (...args) { return args.length ? new RealDate(...args) : new RealDate(Math.floor(t)); };
  FakeDate.prototype = RealDate.prototype;
  FakeDate.now = () => Math.floor(t);
  FakeDate.UTC = RealDate.UTC; FakeDate.parse = RealDate.parse;
  window.Date = FakeDate;
  performance.now = () => t - T0;
  window.requestAnimationFrame = (cb) => { queue.push(cb); return queue.length; };
  window.cancelAnimationFrame = () => {};
  const letter = (type) => (type ? "ijlostz"["ijlostz".split("").findIndex((l) => window[l] === type)] : null);
  const piece = (p) => (p ? { type: letter(p.type), x: p.x, y: p.y, dir: p.dir } : null);
  window.__blocks = {
    // the state read from the page's globals (declared with var at the top level of its script)
    state() {
      const rows = [];
      for (let y = 0; y < ny; y++) {
        let r = "";
        for (let x = 0; x < nx; x++) r += (blocks[x] && blocks[x][y] ? letter(blocks[x][y]) : ".");
        rows.push(r);
      }
      return {
        grid: rows,
        current: piece(current),
        next: piece(next),
        bag: pieces.map(letter).join(""),
        score, vscore, rows: window.rows, step, dt: window.dt,
        playing: !!playing,
        actions: actions.slice(),
      };
    },
    // one rendered frame: key events first (in order), then the clock moves and the animation callbacks run
    step(dtMs, keys) {
      for (const k of keys) {
        // the start link's href is `javascript:play();`; following a link runs that in a later task, so the
        // driver calls the same function directly to keep it inside this frame
        if (k === "play") { window.play(); continue; }
        const ev = new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { keyCode: KEYCODES[k], bubbles: true, cancelable: true });
        document.dispatchEvent(ev);
      }
      t += dtMs;
      const cbs = queue.splice(0);
      for (const cb of cbs) cb(t);
    },
    tape: () => tape.slice(),
  };
}

export async function openOriginal({ seed = 1, headless = true } = {}) {
  const { chromium } = loadPlaywright();
  let browser;
  try { browser = await chromium.launch({ headless }); }
  catch { browser = await chromium.launch({ headless, channel: "chrome" }); }
  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 700, height: 700 } });
  await page.addInitScript(install, { seed, T0, KEYCODES });
  await page.goto(pathToFileURL(ORIGINAL).href, { waitUntil: "load" });
  return {
    page,
    initial: await page.evaluate(() => window.__blocks.state()), // the state window.onload's run() leaves
    // the original draws on every frame; the state after it is what the port must reproduce
    step: async ({ dt, keys = [] }) => page.evaluate(([d, k]) => { window.__blocks.step(d, k); return window.__blocks.state(); }, [dt, keys]),
    shot: (file) => page.screenshot({ path: file }),
    tape: () => page.evaluate(() => window.__blocks.tape()),
    close: () => browser.close(),
  };
}

```
