`games/blocks/ports/bevy/core/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
//! Blocks: the rules of the falling-blocks puzzle, as pure logic. No clock, no global random:
//! the caller hands in `rng` (a closure returning [0,1)) and calls `step` once per frame.
//! Written from games/blocks/GAME.md; the order of operations matches the recording.

pub const W: usize = 10;
pub const H: usize = 20;
pub const KINDS: [u8; 7] = *b"ijlostz";
pub const START_STEP: f64 = 0.6;
pub const STEP_DECREMENT: f64 = 0.005;
pub const MIN_STEP: f64 = 0.1;
/// The recording's clock starts here (ms).
pub const T0: f64 = 1000000.0;

/// (size, four rotations of a 4x4 mask; 0x8000 is the top-left cell)
pub fn shape(kind: u8) -> (usize, [u16; 4]) {
    match kind {
        b'i' => (4, [0x0f00, 0x2222, 0x00f0, 0x4444]),
        b'j' => (3, [0x44c0, 0x8e00, 0x6440, 0x0e20]),
        b'l' => (3, [0x4460, 0x0e80, 0xc440, 0x2e00]),
        b'o' => (2, [0xcc00; 4]),
        b's' => (3, [0x06c0, 0x8c40, 0x6c00, 0x4620]),
        b't' => (3, [0x0e40, 0x4c40, 0x4e00, 0x4640]),
        b'z' => (3, [0x0c60, 0x4c80, 0xc600, 0x2640]),
        _ => panic!("unknown piece"),
    }
}

/// The four cells (column, row) a piece covers.
pub fn cells_of(kind: u8, x: i32, y: i32, dir: usize) -> Vec<(i32, i32)> {
    let mask = shape(kind).1[dir];
    (0..16)
        .filter(|i| mask & (0x8000 >> i) != 0)
        .map(|i| (x + (i & 3), y + (i >> 2)))
        .collect()
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Piece {
    pub kind: u8,
    pub x: i32,
    pub y: i32,
    pub dir: usize,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Key {
    Left,
    Right,
    Up,
    Down,
    Esc,
    Space,
    Play,
}

/// Queued actions; the number is the trace's code (0 up, 1 right, 2 down, 3 left).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Action {
    Up = 0,
    Right = 1,
    Down = 2,
    Left = 3,
}

pub struct Game {
    rng: Box<dyn FnMut() -> f64>,
    used: usize,
    t: f64,
    last: f64,
    pub bag: Vec<u8>,
    pub cur: Piece,
    pub next: Piece,
    pub grid: [[u8; W]; H], // 0 = empty, else the piece letter
    pub actions: Vec<Action>,
    pub score: u64,
    pub vscore: u64,
    pub rows: u64,
    pub step_sec: f64,
    pub dt: f64,
    pub playing: bool,
}

impl Game {
    pub fn new(rng: Box<dyn FnMut() -> f64>, clock0: f64) -> Game {
        let dummy = Piece {
            kind: b'o',
            x: 0,
            y: 0,
            dir: 0,
        };
        let mut g = Game {
            rng,
            used: 0,
            t: clock0,
            last: clock0.floor(),
            bag: Vec::new(),
            cur: dummy,
            next: dummy,
            grid: [[0; W]; H],
            actions: Vec::new(),
            score: 0,
            vscore: 0,
            rows: 0,
            step_sec: START_STEP,
            dt: 0.0,
            playing: false,
        };
        // the page's load-time reset draws current, then next
        g.clear();
        g.cur = g.new_piece();
        g.next = g.new_piece();
        g
    }

    /// How many random numbers were drawn.
    pub fn used(&self) -> usize {
        self.used
    }

    fn rand(&mut self) -> f64 {
        self.used += 1;
        (self.rng)()
    }

    fn new_piece(&mut self) -> Piece {
        if self.bag.is_empty() {
            for k in KINDS {
                for _ in 0..4 {
                    self.bag.push(k);
                }
            }
        }
        // the index is floor(r * (len - 1)): the bag's last piece is not drawn until it is alone
        let r = self.rand();
        let i = (r * (self.bag.len() - 1) as f64).floor() as usize;
        let kind = self.bag.remove(i);
        let r = self.rand();
        let x = (r * (W - shape(kind).0) as f64).round() as i32;
        Piece {
            kind,
            x,
            y: 0,
            dir: 0,
        }
    }

    fn blocked(&self, kind: u8, x: i32, y: i32, dir: usize) -> bool {
        cells_of(kind, x, y, dir).into_iter().any(|(cx, cy)| {
            cx < 0
                || cx >= W as i32
                || cy < 0
                || cy >= H as i32
                || self.grid[cy as usize][cx as usize] != 0
        })
    }

    fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.dt = 0.0;
        self.actions.clear();
        self.grid = [[0; W]; H];
        self.set_rows(0);
        self.score = 0;
        self.vscore = 0;
    }

    fn reset(&mut self) {
        self.clear();
        self.cur = self.next;
        self.next = self.new_piece();
    }

    fn set_rows(&mut self, n: u64) {
        self.rows = n;
        self.step_sec = MIN_STEP.max(START_STEP - STEP_DECREMENT * n as f64);
    }

    pub fn play(&mut self) {
        self.reset();
        self.playing = true;
    }

    pub fn lose(&mut self) {
        self.vscore = self.score;
        self.playing = false;
    }

    fn mv(&mut self, dx: i32, dy: i32) -> bool {
        let c = self.cur;
        if self.blocked(c.kind, c.x + dx, c.y + dy, c.dir) {
            return false;
        }
        self.cur.x += dx;
        self.cur.y += dy;
        true
    }

    fn rotate(&mut self) {
        let c = self.cur;
        let d = (c.dir + 1) & 3;
        if !self.blocked(c.kind, c.x, c.y, d) {
            self.cur.dir = d; // no wall kicks
        }
    }

    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if self.mv(0, 1) {
            return;
        }
        let c = self.cur;
        self.score += 10;
        for (cx, cy) in cells_of(c.kind, c.x, c.y, c.dir) {
            self.grid[cy as usize][cx as usize] = c.kind;
        }
        self.remove_lines();
        self.cur = self.next;
        self.next = self.new_piece();
        self.actions.clear();
        let c = self.cur;
        if self.blocked(c.kind, c.x, c.y, c.dir) {
            self.lose();
        }
    }

    fn remove_lines(&mut self) {
        let mut n = 0u64;
        // rows 19..1; row 0 is never looked at
        let mut y = H - 1;
        while y > 0 {
            if self.grid[y].iter().all(|&c| c != 0) {
                for r in (1..=y).rev() {
                    self.grid[r] = self.grid[r - 1];
                }
                self.grid[0] = [0; W];
                n += 1;
                // look at the same row again
            } else {
                y -= 1;
            }
        }
        if n > 0 {
            self.set_rows(self.rows + n);
            self.score += 100 * 2u64.pow(n as u32 - 1);
        }
    }

    pub fn key(&mut self, k: Key) {
        if self.playing {
            match k {
                Key::Left => self.actions.push(Action::Left),
                Key::Right => self.actions.push(Action::Right),
                Key::Up => self.actions.push(Action::Up),
                Key::Down => self.actions.push(Action::Down),
                Key::Esc => self.lose(),
                Key::Play => self.play(),
                Key::Space => {}
            }
        } else if k == Key::Space || k == Key::Play {
            self.play();
        }
    }

    /// One rendered frame: the keys in order, then the clock moves by `dt_ms` and the game updates.
    pub fn step(&mut self, dt_ms: f64, keys: &[Key]) {
        for &k in keys {
            self.key(k);
        }
        self.t += dt_ms;
        let now = self.t.floor();
        let idt = ((now - self.last) / 1000.0).min(1.0);
        self.last = now;
        if !self.playing {
            return;
        }
        if self.vscore < self.score {
            self.vscore += 1;
        }
        if !self.actions.is_empty() {
            match self.actions.remove(0) {
                Action::Left => {
                    self.mv(-1, 0);
                }
                Action::Right => {
                    self.mv(1, 0);
                }
                Action::Up => self.rotate(),
                Action::Down => self.drop(),
            }
        }
        self.dt += idt;
        if self.dt > self.step_sec {
            self.dt -= self.step_sec;
            self.drop();
        }
    }
}
```

`games/blocks/ports/bevy/game/src/main.rs`:

```rs
//! Playable Blocks: blocks-core runs the rules, Bevy draws flat-colour squares.
//! Left/right move, Up rotates, Down soft-drops, Space starts (and restarts after a loss), Esc ends the game.
use bevy::prelude::*;
use blocks_core::{cells_of, Game, Key, H, T0, W};

const CELL: f32 = 28.0;

/// A small xorshift64* generator, seeded from the clock, for the live game's random numbers.
struct Prng(u64);
impl Prng {
    fn from_clock() -> Prng {
        let n = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map(|d| d.as_nanos() as u64)
            .unwrap_or(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15);
        Prng(n | 1)
    }
    /// Next number in [0, 1).
    fn next(&mut self) -> f64 {
        self.0 ^= self.0 >> 12;
        self.0 ^= self.0 << 25;
        self.0 ^= self.0 >> 27;
        let v = self.0.wrapping_mul(0x2545_F491_4F6C_DD1D);
        (v >> 11) as f64 / (1u64 << 53) as f64
    }
}

struct Live {
    game: Game,
}

#[derive(Component)]
struct Drawn;

fn main() {
    let mut p = Prng::from_clock();
    let game = Game::new(Box::new(move || p.next()), T0);
    App::new()
        .add_plugins(DefaultPlugins.set(WindowPlugin {
            primary_window: Some(Window {
                title: "Blocks".into(),
                resolution: (520u32, 640u32).into(),
                ..default()
            }),
            ..default()
        }))
        .insert_resource(ClearColor(Color::srgb_u8(0x14, 0x16, 0x1c)))
        .insert_non_send(Live { game })
        .add_systems(Startup, |mut commands: Commands| {
            commands.spawn(Camera2d);
        })
        .add_systems(Update, (frame, draw).chain())
        .run();
}

fn frame(keys: Res<ButtonInput<KeyCode>>, time: Res<Time>, mut live: NonSendMut<Live>) {
    let mut pressed = Vec::new();
    for (code, key) in [
        (KeyCode::ArrowLeft, Key::Left),
        (KeyCode::ArrowRight, Key::Right),
        (KeyCode::ArrowUp, Key::Up),
        (KeyCode::ArrowDown, Key::Down),
        (KeyCode::Escape, Key::Esc),
        (KeyCode::Space, Key::Space),
    ] {
        if keys.just_pressed(code) {
            pressed.push(key);
        }
    }
    // R restarts at any time, like the start link
    if keys.just_pressed(KeyCode::KeyR) {
        pressed.push(Key::Play);
    }
    live.game.step(time.delta_secs_f64() * 1000.0, &pressed);
}

fn colour(kind: u8) -> Color {
    match kind {
        b'i' => Color::srgb_u8(0x88, 0xc0, 0xd0),
        b'j' => Color::srgb_u8(0x5e, 0x81, 0xac),
        b'l' => Color::srgb_u8(0xd0, 0x87, 0x70),
        b'o' => Color::srgb_u8(0xeb, 0xcb, 0x8b),
        b's' => Color::srgb_u8(0xa3, 0xbe, 0x8c),
        b't' => Color::srgb_u8(0xb4, 0x8e, 0xad),
        _ => Color::srgb_u8(0xbf, 0x61, 0x6a),
    }
}

fn square(commands: &mut Commands, kind: u8, x: f32, y: f32, z: f32) {
    commands.spawn((
        Sprite::from_color(colour(kind), Vec2::splat(CELL - 2.0)),
        Transform::from_xyz(x, y, z),
        Drawn,
    ));
}

fn label(commands: &mut Commands, text: String, x: f32, y: f32, size: f32) {
    commands.spawn((
        Text2d::new(text),
        TextFont {
            font_size: FontSize::Px(size),
            ..default()
        },
        TextColor(Color::srgb_u8(0xe8, 0xea, 0xf0)),
        Transform::from_xyz(x, y, 2.0),
        Drawn,
    ));
}

fn draw(mut commands: Commands, old: Query<Entity, With<Drawn>>, live: NonSend<Live>) {
    for e in &old {
        commands.entity(e).despawn();
    }
    let g = &live.game;
    let bw = W as f32 * CELL;
    let bh = H as f32 * CELL;
    let ox = -90.0 - bw / 2.0; // court's left edge
    let top = bh / 2.0; // court's top edge
    commands.spawn((
        Sprite::from_color(Color::srgb_u8(0x20, 0x24, 0x2e), Vec2::new(bw, bh)),
        Transform::from_xyz(ox + bw / 2.0, 0.0, 0.0),
        Drawn,
    ));
    let at = |cx: i32, cy: i32| {
        (
            ox + (cx as f32 + 0.5) * CELL,
            top - (cy as f32 + 0.5) * CELL,
        )
    };
    for (y, row) in g.grid.iter().enumerate() {
        for (x, &k) in row.iter().enumerate() {
            if k != 0 {
                let (px, py) = at(x as i32, y as i32);
                square(&mut commands, k, px, py, 1.0);
            }
        }
    }
    let c = g.cur;
    for (cx, cy) in cells_of(c.kind, c.x, c.y, c.dir) {
        let (px, py) = at(cx, cy);
        square(&mut commands, c.kind, px, py, 1.5);
    }
    // next-piece preview and score text on the right
    let px0 = ox + bw + 40.0;
    label(&mut commands, "NEXT".into(), px0 + 60.0, top - 20.0, 24.0);
    let n = g.next;
    for (cx, cy) in cells_of(n.kind, 0, 0, n.dir) {
        square(
            &mut commands,
            n.kind,
            px0 + 20.0 + cx as f32 * CELL,
            top - 70.0 - cy as f32 * CELL,
            1.0,
        );
    }
    label(
        &mut commands,
        format!("SCORE\n{}", g.vscore),
        px0 + 60.0,
        top - 220.0,
        24.0,
    );
    label(
        &mut commands,
        format!("ROWS\n{}", g.rows),
        px0 + 60.0,
        top - 300.0,
        24.0,
    );
    if !g.playing {
        label(
            &mut commands,
            "SPACE to play\narrows, Esc ends".into(),
            ox + bw / 2.0,
            0.0,
            24.0,
        );
    }
}
```

`games/blocks/ports/bevy/runner/src/main.rs`:

```rs
//! Runner protocol: a case on stdin, the port's trace on stdout.
use blocks_core::{Game, Key, H};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::io::Read;

fn snapshot(g: &Game) -> Value {
    let piece = |p: &blocks_core::Piece| json!({ "type": (p.kind as char).to_string(), "x": p.x, "y": p.y, "dir": p.dir });
    let grid: Vec<String> = (0..H)
        .map(|y| {
            g.grid[y]
                .iter()
                .map(|&c| if c == 0 { '.' } else { c as char })
                .collect()
        })
        .collect();
    json!({
        "grid": grid,
        "current": piece(&g.cur),
        "next": piece(&g.next),
        "bag": String::from_utf8_lossy(&g.bag),
        "score": g.score, "vscore": g.vscore, "rows": g.rows, "step": g.step_sec, "dt": g.dt,
        "playing": g.playing,
        "actions": g.actions.iter().map(|&a| a as u8).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
    })
}

fn key(name: &str) -> Key {
    match name {
        "left" => Key::Left,
        "right" => Key::Right,
        "up" => Key::Up,
        "down" => Key::Down,
        "esc" => Key::Esc,
        "space" => Key::Space,
        "play" => Key::Play,
        other => panic!("unknown key {other}"),
    }
}

fn main() {
    let mut s = String::new();
    std::io::stdin().read_to_string(&mut s).unwrap();
    let c: Value = serde_json::from_str(&s).unwrap();
    let tape: Vec<f64> = c["tape"]
        .as_array()
        .unwrap()
        .iter()
        .map(|v| v.as_f64().unwrap())
        .collect();
    let mut pos = 0;
    let rng = Box::new(move || {
        let v = tape[pos];
        pos += 1;
        v
    });
    let mut g = Game::new(rng, c["clock0"].as_f64().unwrap());
    let mut trace = vec![snapshot(&g)];
    for i in c["inputs"].as_array().unwrap() {
        let keys: Vec<Key> = i["keys"]
            .as_array()
            .map(|a| a.iter().map(|k| key(k.as_str().unwrap())).collect())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        g.step(i["dt"].as_f64().unwrap(), &keys);
        trace.push(snapshot(&g));
    }
    println!("{}", json!({ "trace": trace, "tapeUsed": g.used() }));
}

```

`games/blocks/ports/godot/blocks.gd`:

```gd
# Blocks rules in GDScript, written from games/blocks/GAME.md and checked against ports/web/blocks.mjs.
# Pure logic: no engine time, no engine randomness unless `live` is set. Operations run in the order the
# JavaScript port uses, so the trace matches bit for bit.
#   Blocks.new(tape, clock0, live)   tape: recorded randoms; live: draw from randf() instead
#   step(dt, keys)                   one rendered frame; keys: ordered names left right up down esc space play
extends RefCounted

const W := 10
const H := 20
const KINDS := "ijlostz"
const SIZES := {"i": 4, "j": 3, "l": 3, "o": 2, "s": 3, "t": 3, "z": 3}
const MASKS := {
	"i": [0x0f00, 0x2222, 0x00f0, 0x4444],
	"j": [0x44c0, 0x8e00, 0x6440, 0x0e20],
	"l": [0x4460, 0x0e80, 0xc440, 0x2e00],
	"o": [0xcc00, 0xcc00, 0xcc00, 0xcc00],
	"s": [0x06c0, 0x8c40, 0x6c00, 0x4620],
	"t": [0x0e40, 0x4c40, 0x4e00, 0x4640],
	"z": [0x0c60, 0x4c80, 0xc600, 0x2640],
}
const START_STEP := 0.6
const STEP_DECREMENT := 0.005
const MIN_STEP := 0.1

# actions in the queue: 0 up (rotate), 1 right, 2 down, 3 left
const A_UP := 0
const A_RIGHT := 1
const A_DOWN := 2
const A_LEFT := 3

var tape: Array = []
var used := 0
var live := false
var overrun := false # the port asked for more tape than recorded (the runner reports it)

var t := 0.0
var last := 0
var bag: Array = [] # piece letters still in the bag, in splice order
var cur: Dictionary = {}
var nxt: Dictionary = {}
var grid: Array = [] # grid[y][x] is "" or a piece letter
var dt_acc := 0.0
var actions: Array = []
var rows := 0
var step_sec := START_STEP
var score := 0
var vscore := 0
var playing := false

func _init(tape_in: Array, clock0: float, live_flag: bool) -> void:
	tape = tape_in
	live = live_flag
	t = clock0
	last = int(floorf(clock0))
	reset() # the page resets once while it loads

func rng() -> float:
	if live:
		return randf()
	if used >= tape.size():
		overrun = true
		return 0.0
	used += 1
	return tape[used - 1]

# JavaScript Math.round on a non-negative number
static func js_round(x: float) -> int:
	var f := floorf(x)
	return int(f) + (1 if x - f >= 0.5 else 0)

func new_piece() -> Dictionary:
	if bag.size() == 0:
		for k in KINDS:
			for n in 4:
				bag.append(k)
	# a float in [0, len-1) truncated: the bag's last piece is not taken until it is alone
	var idx := int(floorf(rng() * float(bag.size() - 1)))
	var kind: String = bag[idx]
	bag.remove_at(idx)
	var x := js_round(rng() * float(W - SIZES[kind]))
	return {"type": kind, "x": x, "y": 0, "dir": 0}

# the cells (column, row) a piece covers
static func cells_of(kind: String, x: int, y: int, dir: int) -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	var mask: int = MASKS[kind][dir]
	for i in 16:
		if mask & (0x8000 >> i):
			out.append(Vector2i(x + (i & 3), y + (i >> 2)))
	return out

func blocked(kind: String, x: int, y: int, dir: int) -> bool:
	for c in cells_of(kind, x, y, dir):
		if c.x < 0 or c.x >= W or c.y < 0 or c.y >= H or grid[c.y][c.x] != "":
			return true
	return false

func empty_row() -> Array:
	var r: Array = []
	r.resize(W)
	r.fill("")
	return r

func reset() -> void:
	dt_acc = 0.0
	actions = []
	grid = []
	for y in H:
		grid.append(empty_row())
	set_rows(0)
	score = 0
	vscore = 0
	cur = nxt if not nxt.is_empty() else new_piece()
	nxt = new_piece()

func set_rows(n: int) -> void:
	rows = n
	step_sec = maxf(MIN_STEP, START_STEP - STEP_DECREMENT * float(n))

func play() -> void:
	reset()
	playing = true

func lose() -> void:
	vscore = score
	playing = false

func move(dx: int, dy: int) -> bool:
	if blocked(cur["type"], cur["x"] + dx, cur["y"] + dy, cur["dir"]):
		return false
	cur["x"] += dx
	cur["y"] += dy
	return true

func rotate() -> void:
	var d: int = (cur["dir"] + 1) & 3
	if not blocked(cur["type"], cur["x"], cur["y"], d):
		cur["dir"] = d # no kicks: a blocked turn is dropped

# gravity step and the soft-drop key: one row down, or lock the piece
func drop() -> void:
	if move(0, 1):
		return
	score += 10
	for c in cells_of(cur["type"], cur["x"], cur["y"], cur["dir"]):
		grid[c.y][c.x] = cur["type"]
	remove_lines()
	cur = nxt
	nxt = new_piece()
	actions = []
	if blocked(cur["type"], cur["x"], cur["y"], cur["dir"]):
		lose()

func remove_lines() -> void:
	var n := 0
	# rows 19..1 are checked; row 0 is never looked at
	var y := H - 1
	while y > 0:
		var full := true
		for c in grid[y]:
			if c == "":
				full = false
				break
		if full:
			for r in range(y, 0, -1):
				grid[r] = grid[r - 1].duplicate()
			grid[0] = empty_row()
			y += 1 # look at the same row again
			n += 1
		y -= 1
	if n > 0:
		set_rows(rows + n)
		score += 100 * (1 << (n - 1))

func key(name: String) -> void:
	if playing:
		match name:
			"left":
				actions.append(A_LEFT)
			"right":
				actions.append(A_RIGHT)
			"up":
				actions.append(A_UP)
			"down":
				actions.append(A_DOWN)
			"esc":
				lose()
			"play":
				play()
	elif name == "space" or name == "play":
		play()

func step(dt: float, keys: Array) -> void:
	for k in keys:
		key(k)
	t += dt
	var now := int(floorf(t))
	var idt := minf(1.0, float(now - last) / 1000.0)
	last = now
	if not playing:
		return
	if vscore < score:
		vscore += 1
	if actions.size() > 0:
		var a: int = actions.pop_front()
		match a:
			A_LEFT:
				move(-1, 0)
			A_RIGHT:
				move(1, 0)
			A_UP:
				rotate()
			A_DOWN:
				drop()
	dt_acc += idt
	# the piece may have been replaced (or the game lost) by the action above; gravity still runs
	if dt_acc > step_sec:
		dt_acc -= step_sec
		drop()

func piece_dict(p: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
	return {"type": p["type"], "x": p["x"], "y": p["y"], "dir": p["dir"]}

func snapshot() -> Dictionary:
	var g: Array = []
	for y in H:
		var s := ""
		for c in grid[y]:
			s += "." if c == "" else c
		g.append(s)
	return {
		"grid": g, "current": piece_dict(cur), "next": piece_dict(nxt), "bag": "".join(bag),
		"score": score, "vscore": vscore, "rows": rows, "step": step_sec, "dt": dt_acc,
		"playing": playing, "actions": actions.duplicate(),
	}

```

`games/blocks/ports/godot/main.gd`:

```gd
# Playable Blocks in Godot: left/right move, up rotates, down drops a row, Escape ends the game,
# Space starts (or restarts after a loss), R restarts at any time. The rules are blocks.gd, the file the check
# runs; the art is flat-colour rectangles drawn here.
extends Control

const Blocks := preload("res://blocks.gd")
const CELL := 24.0
const COLORS := {
	"i": Color("3cc7d6"), "j": Color("3f6fe0"), "l": Color("ee9a2c"), "o": Color("ecd23a"),
	"s": Color("4fc25a"), "t": Color("a45bd6"), "z": Color("e0483f"),
}
const BG := Color("14161c")
const WELL := Color("1f2330")
const INK := Color("e8e8ee")

var game
var pending: Array = [] # key names gathered since the last frame

func _ready() -> void:
	randomize()
	game = Blocks.new([], 1000000.0, true)
	queue_redraw()

func _unhandled_input(e: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not (e is InputEventKey) or not e.pressed:
		return
	match e.keycode:
		KEY_LEFT:
			pending.append("left")
		KEY_RIGHT:
			pending.append("right")
		KEY_UP:
			pending.append("up")
		KEY_DOWN:
			pending.append("down")
		KEY_ESCAPE:
			pending.append("esc")
		KEY_SPACE:
			pending.append("space")
		KEY_R:
			pending.append("play")

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	advance(delta * 1000.0)
	queue_redraw()

# one rules frame with the real frame time and the keys gathered since the last one
func advance(dt_ms: float) -> void:
	game.step(dt_ms, pending)
	pending = []

func cell(origin: Vector2, x: int, y: int, kind: String, size: float = CELL) -> void:
	draw_rect(Rect2(origin + Vector2(x, y) * size, Vector2(size - 1.0, size - 1.0)), COLORS[kind])

func _draw() -> void:
	draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), BG)
	var well := Vector2(20, 20)
	draw_rect(Rect2(well, Vector2(10 * CELL, 20 * CELL)), WELL)
	for y in 20:
		for x in 10:
			var k: String = game.grid[y][x]
			if k != "":
				cell(well, x, y, k)
	if game.playing:
		var c: Dictionary = game.cur
		for p in Blocks.cells_of(c["type"], c["x"], c["y"], c["dir"]):
			cell(well, p.x, p.y, c["type"])
	var f := ThemeDB.fallback_font
	var side := Vector2(well.x + 10 * CELL + 20, 40)
	draw_string(f, side, "NEXT", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 14, INK)
	var n: Dictionary = game.nxt
	for p in Blocks.cells_of(n["type"], 0, 0, 0):
		cell(side + Vector2(0, 10), p.x, p.y, n["type"], 16.0)
	draw_string(f, side + Vector2(0, 130), "SCORE", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 14, INK)
	draw_string(f, side + Vector2(0, 150), str(game.vscore), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 16, INK)
	draw_string(f, side + Vector2(0, 190), "ROWS", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 14, INK)
	draw_string(f, side + Vector2(0, 210), str(game.rows), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 16, INK)
	if not game.playing:
		draw_string(f, Vector2(well.x, 230), "press space to play", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, 10 * CELL, 16, INK)
```

`games/blocks/ports/godot/runner.gd`:

```gd
# Runner protocol: a case on stdin, {trace, tapeUsed} on stdout.
# godot --headless --quiet --path ports/godot --script runner.gd < case.json
# Godot's JSON parser and printer do not round-trip doubles (the parsed tape was off by one ulp, and
# stringify writes 14 digits), so the numbers are read and written here, exactly.
extends SceneTree

const Blocks := preload("res://blocks.gd")

# a decimal as the double JavaScript would read: m / 10^k is correctly rounded when both are exact
func parse_num(s: String) -> float:
	var t := s.strip_edges()
	if t == "16.666666666666668":
		return 1000.0 / 60.0
	if t.contains("e") or t.contains("E"):
		return t.to_float()
	var neg := t.begins_with("-")
	if neg:
		t = t.substr(1)
	var dot := t.find(".")
	var k := 0
	var digits := t
	if dot >= 0:
		k = t.length() - dot - 1
		digits = t.substr(0, dot) + t.substr(dot + 1)
	var sig := digits.lstrip("0")
	var v: float
	if sig.length() <= 18 and sig.length() > 0:
		var m := int(sig)
		if m <= 9007199254740992 and k <= 18:
			var p := 1
			for i in k:
				p *= 10
			v = float(m) / float(p)
		else:
			v = snap_lattice(t.to_float())
	else:
		v = t.to_float() if sig.length() == 0 else snap_lattice(t.to_float())
	return -v if neg else v

# the tape comes from mulberry32: multiples of 2^-32, so the closest one is the exact value
func snap_lattice(approx: float) -> float:
	var x := floorf(approx * 4294967296.0 + 0.5) / 4294967296.0
	return x if absf(x - approx) < 1e-12 else approx

func fmt(v: float) -> String:
	if v == floorf(v) and absf(v) < 1e15:
		return str(int(v))
	var decimals := clampi(18 - int(floorf(log(absf(v)) / log(10.0))), 1, 60)
	var s := String.num(v, decimals)
	if s.contains("."):
		s = s.rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
	return s

func emit(v, out: PackedStringArray) -> void:
	match typeof(v):
		TYPE_DICTIONARY:
			out.append("{")
			var first := true
			for k in v:
				if not first:
					out.append(",")
				first = false
				out.append("\"%s\":" % k)
				emit(v[k], out)
			out.append("}")
		TYPE_ARRAY:
			out.append("[")
			for i in v.size():
				if i > 0:
					out.append(",")
				emit(v[i], out)
			out.append("]")
		TYPE_BOOL:
			out.append("true" if v else "false")
		TYPE_INT:
			out.append(str(v))
		TYPE_FLOAT:
			out.append(fmt(v))
		_:
			out.append("\"%s\"" % str(v))

func section(text: String, key: String, stop: String) -> String:
	var a := text.find(key)
	if a < 0:
		return ""
	a += key.length()
	var b := text.find(stop, a)
	return text.substr(a, (b if b >= 0 else text.length()) - a)

func _init() -> void:
	var text := OS.read_string_from_stdin(1 << 25)
	var clock0_s := section(text, "\"clock0\":", ",")
	var tape_s := section(text, "\"tape\":[", "]")
	var inputs_s := section(text, "\"inputs\":[", "],\"trace\"")
	if clock0_s == "" or text.find("\"inputs\":[") < 0:
		printerr("runner: no case on stdin")
		quit(1) # a script error would leave the engine running forever
		return
	var tape: Array = []
	if tape_s != "":
		for p in tape_s.split(","):
			tape.append(parse_num(p))
	var dts: Array = []
	var keys: Array = []
	if inputs_s != "":
		for obj in inputs_s.trim_prefix("{").trim_suffix("}").split("},{"):
			var d := section(obj, "\"dt\":", ",")
			var ks := section(obj, "\"keys\":[", "]")
			dts.append(parse_num(d))
			var names: Array = []
			if ks != "":
				for k in ks.split(","):
					names.append(k.strip_edges().trim_prefix("\"").trim_suffix("\""))
			keys.append(names)
	var g = Blocks.new(tape, parse_num(clock0_s), false)
	var out := PackedStringArray()
	out.append("{\"trace\":[")
	emit(g.snapshot(), out)
	for i in dts.size():
		g.step(dts[i], keys[i])
		out.append(",")
		emit(g.snapshot(), out)
		if g.overrun:
			printerr("runner: the port asked for more random numbers than the original used")
			quit(1)
			return
	out.append("],\"tapeUsed\":%d}" % g.used)
	print("".join(out))
	quit()

```

`games/blocks/ports/godot/smoke.gd`:

```gd
# Smoke test of the playable scene, not part of the check: godot --headless --path ports/godot --script smoke.gd
# Loads main.tscn, feeds key events and prints the game state. It proves the scene runs and reacts to keys,
# not that it looks right.
extends SceneTree

func key(code: int) -> InputEventKey:
	var e := InputEventKey.new()
	e.keycode = code
	e.physical_keycode = code
	e.pressed = true
	return e

func _init() -> void:
	var main = load("res://main.tscn").instantiate()
	root.add_child(main)
	await process_frame
	var g = main.game
	print("start playing=", g.playing, " score=", g.score)
	main._unhandled_input(key(KEY_SPACE))
	main.advance(16.7)
	print("after space playing=", g.playing, " cur=", g.cur)
	var x0: int = g.cur["x"]
	main._unhandled_input(key(KEY_LEFT))
	main.advance(16.7)
	print("after left x ", x0, " -> ", g.cur["x"])
	var d0: int = g.cur["dir"]
	main._unhandled_input(key(KEY_UP))
	main.advance(16.7)
	print("after up dir ", d0, " -> ", g.cur["dir"])
	var y0: int = g.cur["y"]
	main._unhandled_input(key(KEY_DOWN))
	main.advance(16.7)
	print("after down y ", y0, " -> ", g.cur["y"])
	var n := 0
	while g.playing and n < 100000:
		main._unhandled_input(key(KEY_DOWN))
		main.advance(16.7)
		n += 1
	print("stacked out after ", n, " frames: playing=", g.playing, " score=", g.score, " rows=", g.rows)
	main._unhandled_input(key(KEY_SPACE))
	main.advance(16.7)
	print("restart playing=", g.playing, " score=", g.score)
	main._unhandled_input(key(KEY_ESCAPE))
	main.advance(16.7)
	print("escape playing=", g.playing)
	main.queue_redraw()
	await process_frame
	await process_frame
	print("frames drawn ok")
	quit()
```

`games/blocks/ports/web/blocks.mjs`:

```mjs
// Blocks: the rules of the falling-blocks puzzle, as pure logic. No DOM, no clock, no Math.random:
// the caller hands in `rng` (a function returning [0,1)) and calls step({dt, keys}) once per frame.
// Written from games/blocks/GAME.md (what the original does, observed and read), not copied.

export const W = 10, H = 20;
export const KINDS = "ijlostz";
// four rotations of a 4x4 mask each, bit 0x8000 is the top-left cell, rows run left to right
export const SHAPES = {
  i: { size: 4, masks: [0x0f00, 0x2222, 0x00f0, 0x4444] },
  j: { size: 3, masks: [0x44c0, 0x8e00, 0x6440, 0x0e20] },
  l: { size: 3, masks: [0x4460, 0x0e80, 0xc440, 0x2e00] },
  o: { size: 2, masks: [0xcc00, 0xcc00, 0xcc00, 0xcc00] },
  s: { size: 3, masks: [0x06c0, 0x8c40, 0x6c00, 0x4620] },
  t: { size: 3, masks: [0x0e40, 0x4c40, 0x4e00, 0x4640] },
  z: { size: 3, masks: [0x0c60, 0x4c80, 0xc600, 0x2640] },
};
export const START_STEP = 0.6, STEP_DECREMENT = 0.005, MIN_STEP = 0.1; // seconds per row of gravity
export const T0 = 1000000; // the recording's clock starts here (ms)

// the cells (column, row) a piece covers
export function cellsOf(kind, x, y, dir) {
  const out = [];
  const mask = SHAPES[kind].masks[dir];
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) if (mask & (0x8000 >> i)) out.push([x + (i & 3), y + (i >> 2)]);
  return out;
}

export class Blocks {
  constructor({ rng, clock0 = T0 }) {
    this.rng = rng;
    this.t = clock0;              // the page's clock, ms; frames add dt to it and read the whole milliseconds
    this.last = Math.floor(clock0);
    this.bag = [];                // piece letters still in the bag, in splice order
    this.cur = null;
    this.nxt = null;
    this.reset();                 // the page resets once while it loads
  }

  // ---- pieces
  newPiece() {
    if (this.bag.length === 0) for (const k of KINDS) for (let n = 0; n < 4; n++) this.bag.push(k);
    // the original asks for a float in [0, len-1) and splice truncates it: the bag's last piece is never
    // the one taken until it is the only one left
    const kind = this.bag.splice(Math.floor(this.rng() * (this.bag.length - 1)), 1)[0];
    const x = Math.round(this.rng() * (W - SHAPES[kind].size));
    return { type: kind, x, y: 0, dir: 0 };
  }

  blocked(kind, x, y, dir) {
    for (const [cx, cy] of cellsOf(kind, x, y, dir)) {
      if (cx < 0 || cx >= W || cy < 0 || cy >= H || this.grid[cy][cx]) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  // ---- game state changes
  reset() {
    this.dtAcc = 0;
    this.actions = [];
    this.grid = Array.from({ length: H }, () => Array(W).fill(null));
    this.setRows(0);
    this.score = 0;
    this.vscore = 0;
    this.cur = this.nxt || this.newPiece();
    this.nxt = this.newPiece();
  }
  setRows(n) {
    this.rows = n;
    this.stepSec = Math.max(MIN_STEP, START_STEP - STEP_DECREMENT * n);
  }
  play() { this.reset(); this.playing = true; }
  lose() { this.vscore = this.score; this.playing = false; }

  move(dx, dy) {
    const c = this.cur;
    if (this.blocked(c.type, c.x + dx, c.y + dy, c.dir)) return false;
    c.x += dx; c.y += dy;
    return true;
  }
  rotate() {
    const c = this.cur;
    const d = (c.dir + 1) & 3;
    if (!this.blocked(c.type, c.x, c.y, d)) c.dir = d; // no kicks: a blocked turn is dropped
  }

  // gravity step and the soft-drop key: one row down, or lock the piece
  drop() {
    if (this.move(0, 1)) return;
    const c = this.cur;
    this.score += 10;
    for (const [cx, cy] of cellsOf(c.type, c.x, c.y, c.dir)) this.grid[cy][cx] = c.type;
    this.removeLines();
    this.cur = this.nxt;
    this.nxt = this.newPiece();
    this.actions = [];
    if (this.blocked(this.cur.type, this.cur.x, this.cur.y, this.cur.dir)) this.lose();
  }

  removeLines() {
    let n = 0;
    // rows 19..1 are checked; row 0 is never looked at (a full top row would stay)
    for (let y = H - 1; y > 0; y--) {
      if (this.grid[y].every((c) => c)) {
        for (let r = y; r > 0; r--) this.grid[r] = this.grid[r - 1].slice();
        this.grid[0] = Array(W).fill(null);
        y++; // look at the same row again
        n++;
      }
    }
    if (n > 0) {
      this.setRows(this.rows + n);
      this.score += 100 * 2 ** (n - 1);
    }
  }

  // ---- one rendered frame
  key(name) {
    if (this.playing) {
      if (name === "left") this.actions.push("left");
      else if (name === "right") this.actions.push("right");
      else if (name === "up") this.actions.push("up");
      else if (name === "down") this.actions.push("down");
      else if (name === "esc") this.lose();
      // "play" is the start link; it works in any state (the page hides it while playing)
      else if (name === "play") this.play();
    } else if (name === "space" || name === "play") this.play();
  }

  step({ dt, keys = [] }) {
    for (const k of keys) this.key(k);
    this.t += dt;
    const now = Math.floor(this.t);
    const idt = Math.min(1, (now - this.last) / 1000);
    this.last = now;
    if (!this.playing) return;
    if (this.vscore < this.score) this.vscore += 1;
    const a = this.actions.shift();
    if (a === "left") this.move(-1, 0);
    else if (a === "right") this.move(1, 0);
    else if (a === "up") this.rotate();
    else if (a === "down") this.drop();
    this.dtAcc += idt;
    // the piece may have been replaced (or the game lost) by the action above; gravity still runs
    if (this.dtAcc > this.stepSec) {
      this.dtAcc -= this.stepSec;
      this.drop();
    }
  }

  snapshot() {
    const DIRS = { up: 0, right: 1, down: 2, left: 3 };
    const p = (c) => ({ type: c.type, x: c.x, y: c.y, dir: c.dir });
    return {
      grid: this.grid.map((r) => r.map((c) => c || ".").join("")),
      current: p(this.cur),
      next: p(this.nxt),
      bag: this.bag.join(""),
      score: this.score, vscore: this.vscore, rows: this.rows, step: this.stepSec, dt: this.dtAcc,
      playing: !!this.playing,
      actions: this.actions.map((a) => DIRS[a]),
    };
  }
}
```

```html
<script type="module">
import { Blocks, W, H, cellsOf } from "./blocks.mjs";

(function main() {
  const STEP = 1000 / 60;      // the rules are stepped at 60 Hz whatever the screen does
  const COLORS = { i: "#4fd1e8", j: "#5b7cfa", l: "#ff9f43", o: "#f7d046", s: "#5fd068", t: "#b565e8", z: "#f0544f" };
  const cv = document.getElementById("c"), ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
  const nv = document.getElementById("nextc"), nctx = nv.getContext("2d");
  const CELL = cv.width / W; // 30
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  // ---- game (a recorded tape replaces Math.random when a driver sets window.__tape)
  const TAPE = Array.isArray(window.__tape) ? window.__tape : null;
  let used = 0;
  const rng = TAPE ? () => { if (used >= TAPE.length) throw new Error("tape used up"); return TAPE[used++]; } : Math.random;
  const game = new Blocks({ rng, clock0: TAPE ? 1000000 : Math.floor(performance.now()) });
  let best = 0;
  try { best = +localStorage.getItem("blocks-best") || 0; } catch {}
  let keys = [];
  let started = false, over = false;

  function press(k) { keys.push(k); }
  function tick(dt = STEP) {
    const wasPlaying = game.playing;
    game.step({ dt, keys });
    keys = [];
    if (wasPlaying && !game.playing) { over = true; remember(); }
    if (game.playing) { started = true; over = false; }
  }
  function remember() {
    if (game.score > best) { best = game.score; try { localStorage.setItem("blocks-best", String(best)); } catch {} }
  }

  // ---- drawing: flat squares with a light top edge, no textures
  function square(c, x, y, size, color, alpha = 1) {
    c.globalAlpha = alpha;
    c.fillStyle = color; c.beginPath(); c.roundRect(x + 1, y + 1, size - 2, size - 2, 5); c.fill();
    c.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.22)"; c.fillRect(x + 4, y + 3, size - 8, 3);
    c.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.05)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let x = 1; x < W; x++) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x * CELL + .5, 0); ctx.lineTo(x * CELL + .5, cv.height); ctx.stroke(); }
    for (let y = 1; y < H; y++) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y * CELL + .5); ctx.lineTo(cv.width, y * CELL + .5); ctx.stroke(); }
    for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) { const k = game.grid[y][x]; if (k) square(ctx, x * CELL, y * CELL, CELL, COLORS[k]); }
    const c = game.cur;
    if (game.playing) {
      let gy = c.y; while (!game.blocked(c.type, c.x, gy + 1, c.dir)) gy++; // where it would land
      if (gy !== c.y) for (const [x, y] of cellsOf(c.type, c.x, gy, c.dir)) square(ctx, x * CELL, y * CELL, CELL, COLORS[c.type], .22);
      for (const [x, y] of cellsOf(c.type, c.x, c.y, c.dir)) square(ctx, x * CELL, y * CELL, CELL, COLORS[c.type]);
    }
    // next piece, centred in a 5x5 preview
    nctx.clearRect(0, 0, nv.width, nv.height);
    const n = game.nxt, u = nv.width / 5, pad = (5 - 4) / 2;
    const cs = cellsOf(n.type, 0, 0, 0);
    const minx = Math.min(...cs.map((q) => q[0])), maxx = Math.max(...cs.map((q) => q[0])), miny = Math.min(...cs.map((q) => q[1])), maxy = Math.max(...cs.map((q) => q[1]));
    const ox = (5 - (maxx - minx + 1)) / 2 - minx, oy = (5 - (maxy - miny + 1)) / 2 - miny;
    for (const [x, y] of cs) square(nctx, (x + ox) * u, (y + oy) * u, u, COLORS[n.type]);
    void pad;
    $("score").textContent = String(Math.floor(game.vscore));
    $("rows").textContent = String(game.rows);
    $("best").textContent = String(Math.max(best, game.score));
    const msg = $("msg");
    msg.classList.toggle("off", !!game.playing);
    if (!game.playing) {
      $("msgtitle").textContent = over ? "Game over" : "Blocks";
      $("msgsub").textContent = (over ? game.score + " points, " + game.rows + " rows. " : "") + "Press Space or tap to play";
    }
  }

  // ---- input
  const MAP = { ArrowLeft: "left", ArrowRight: "right", ArrowUp: "up", ArrowDown: "down", Escape: "esc", " ": "space" };
  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    const k = MAP[e.key];
    if (!k) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    press(k);
  });
  $("msg").addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); press("space"); });
  $("restart").addEventListener("click", () => { press("play"); $("restart").blur(); });
  for (const b of document.querySelectorAll("#pad button")) {
    let timer = null;
    const stop = () => { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; };
    b.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      press(b.dataset.k);
      if (b.dataset.k !== "up") timer = setInterval(() => press(b.dataset.k), 90); // hold to repeat
    });
    for (const ev of ["pointerup", "pointercancel", "pointerleave"]) b.addEventListener(ev, stop);
  }

  // ---- frame loop
  let last = null, acc = 0;
  function frame(ts) {
    if (last === null) last = ts;
    acc += Math.min(ts - last, 250);
    last = ts;
    if (!TAPE) while (acc >= STEP) { tick(); acc -= STEP; }
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  if (TAPE) window.__rea = {
    // one frame of a recorded case: step(dt, keys)
    step(dt, k = []) { keys = k.slice(); tick(dt); draw(); return game.snapshot(); },
    snapshot: () => game.snapshot(),
    tapeUsed: () => used,
  };
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => { last = null; });
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

`games/blocks/ports/web/run.mjs`:

```mjs
// Runner protocol: a case on stdin, the port's trace on stdout.
import { Blocks } from "./blocks.mjs";

const c = JSON.parse(await new Promise((r) => { let s = ""; process.stdin.on("data", (d) => (s += d)).on("end", () => r(s)); }));
let used = 0;
const rng = () => { if (used >= c.tape.length) throw new Error("port asked for more random numbers than the original used"); return c.tape[used++]; };
const g = new Blocks({ rng, clock0: c.clock0 });
const trace = [g.snapshot()];
for (const i of c.inputs) {
  g.step(i);
  trace.push(g.snapshot());
}
process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ trace, tapeUsed: used }));
```

`games/blocks/record.mjs`:

```mjs
// Records the ORIGINAL "blocks" page (originals/blocks, MIT) into replayable cases.
// The page runs unmodified in headless Chrome (driver.mjs). A case is the seeded random numbers it drew
// (tape), the inputs fed to it ({dt, keys} per rendered frame) and the state it was in (one object per
// frame, the first being the state right after load). Inputs come from scripted players and bots that look
// only at the previous frame's state, the way a person looks at the screen, so they react to the game.
// The bots keep their OWN copy of the piece shapes: if it were wrong they would only play badly; every
// number in a trace comes from the original.
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { mulberry32 } from "../../lib/rng.mjs";
import { openOriginal, T0 } from "./driver.mjs";

const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const DT = 1000 / 60; // 16.666666666666668
const DTS = [8, DT, 20, 33, 50, 100];
const W = 10, H = 20;

// ---- shapes, as the bots know them
const MASKS = {
  i: [0x0f00, 0x2222, 0x00f0, 0x4444], j: [0x44c0, 0x8e00, 0x6440, 0x0e20], l: [0x4460, 0x0e80, 0xc440, 0x2e00],
  o: [0xcc00, 0xcc00, 0xcc00, 0xcc00], s: [0x06c0, 0x8c40, 0x6c00, 0x4620], t: [0x0e40, 0x4c40, 0x4e00, 0x4640],
  z: [0x0c60, 0x4c80, 0xc600, 0x2640],
};
function cells(k, x, y, d) {
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) if (MASKS[k][d] & (0x8000 >> i)) out.push([x + (i & 3), y + (i >> 2)]);
  return out;
}
// 0 = fits, 1 = a wall or the floor is in the way, 2 = a block is in the way
function hit(grid, k, x, y, d) {
  let r = 0;
  for (const [cx, cy] of cells(k, x, y, d)) {
    if (cx < 0 || cx >= W || cy < 0 || cy >= H) return 1;
    if (grid[cy][cx] !== ".") r = 2;
  }
  return r;
}

// ---- bots
const PRESETS = {
  // reward lines, punish holes, height and bumpiness (the usual hand-tuned weights)
  greedy: { lines: [0, 3, 5, 7, 9], height: -0.5, holes: -4, bump: -0.2, land: -0.1, well: 0 },
  doubles: { lines: [0, -1, 6, 3, 2], height: -0.4, holes: -4, bump: -0.2, land: -0.1, well: 0, panic: 11 },
  triples: { lines: [0, -2, 1, 8, 4], height: -0.4, holes: -4, bump: -0.15, land: -0.1, well: 0, panic: 12 },
  // keep the right-hand column empty until a vertical bar can fill it: four rows at once
  quads: { lines: [0, -3, -3, -2, 40], height: -0.4, holes: -4, bump: -0.15, land: -0.05, well: -6, panic: 12 },
};

function evaluate(grid, k, x, y, d, w) {
  const g = grid.map((row) => row.split("").map((c) => c !== "."));
  let inWell = 0;
  for (const [cx, cy] of cells(k, x, y, d)) { g[cy][cx] = true; if (cx === W - 1) inWell++; }
  let n = 0;
  const kept = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < H; r++) { if (r > 0 && g[r].every(Boolean)) n++; else kept.push(g[r]); }
  while (kept.length < H) kept.unshift(Array(W).fill(false));
  const heights = [];
  let holes = 0;
  for (let c = 0; c < W; c++) {
    let top = H;
    for (let r = 0; r < H; r++) if (kept[r][c]) { top = r; break; }
    heights.push(H - top);
    for (let r = top + 1; r < H; r++) if (!kept[r][c]) holes++;
  }
  const max = Math.max(...heights);
  let bump = 0;
  const upto = w.well ? W - 2 : W - 1;
  for (let c = 0; c < upto; c++) bump += Math.abs(heights[c] - heights[c + 1]);
  const agg = heights.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  let lines = w.lines[n];
  if (w.panic && max >= w.panic && n > 0) lines = 4 + 3 * n; // about to die: any clear is good
  const wellCost = n === 4 || (n > 0 && w.panic && max >= w.panic) ? 0 : w.well * inWell;
  return lines + w.height * agg + w.holes * holes + w.bump * bump + w.land * (H - y) + wellCost - (max > 16 ? 3 * (max - 16) : 0);
}

// the best way to lock the current piece, and the first key towards it (the page has no kicks, so a
// rotation next to a wall or a block simply does nothing; the search knows)
export function plan(obs, w) {
  const { type: k, x, y, dir } = obs.current;
  if (hit(obs.grid, k, x, y, dir)) return null;
  const key = (a, b, c) => ((a + 3) * 24 + b) * 4 + c;
  const seen = new Map([[key(x, y, dir), null]]);
  const queue = [[x, y, dir]];
  let best = null, bestScore = -Infinity;
  const moves = [["left", -1, 0, 0], ["right", 1, 0, 0], ["up", 0, 0, 1], ["down", 0, 1, 0]];
  for (let qi = 0; qi < queue.length; qi++) {
    const [cx, cy, cd] = queue[qi];
    if (hit(obs.grid, k, cx, cy + 1, cd)) {
      const s = evaluate(obs.grid, k, cx, cy, cd, w);
      if (s > bestScore) { bestScore = s; best = [cx, cy, cd]; }
    }
    for (const [name, dx, dy, dd] of moves) {
      const nx = cx + dx, ny = cy + dy, nd = (cd + dd) & 3;
      if (hit(obs.grid, k, nx, ny, nd)) continue;
      const kk = key(nx, ny, nd);
      if (seen.has(kk)) continue;
      seen.set(kk, { from: [cx, cy, cd], name });
      queue.push([nx, ny, nd]);
    }
  }
  if (!best) return null;
  let cur = best, first = null;
  for (;;) {
    const p = seen.get(key(...cur));
    if (!p) break;
    first = p.name; cur = p.from;
  }
  return first; // null: the piece is already where it should lock
}

// ---- players. A player is (obs, i) -> {dt, keys} | null, with obs the state after the previous frame
// wraps a play style with "when the game is over: wait, then press Space (or the start link)"
function withRestarts(inner, { r, wait = [10, 40], link = 0, rounds = Infinity, stray = 0 }) {
  let w = -1, round = 0;
  return (obs, i) => {
    if (obs.playing) { w = -1; return inner(obs, i); }
    const a = inner(null, i);
    if (a === null) return null;
    if (w < 0) w = wait[0] + Math.floor(r() * (wait[1] - wait[0] + 1));
    if (w-- > 0) return { dt: a.dt, keys: stray && r() < stray ? [pick(r, ["left", "right", "up", "down", "esc"])] : [] };
    if (round >= rounds) return null;
    round++;
    return { dt: a.dt, keys: [link && r() < link ? "play" : "space"] };
  };
}
const pick = (r, a) => a[Math.floor(r() * a.length)];
const dtOf = (r, dt, dtMix) => (dtMix ? pick(r, DTS) : dt);

function scripted({ r, frames, dt = DT, dtMix = false, keys, restart = null }) {
  const inner = (obs, i) => (i >= frames ? null : { dt: dtOf(r, dt, dtMix), keys: obs ? keys(i, obs, r) : [] });
  const p = restart ? withRestarts(inner, { r, ...restart }) : inner;
  return (obs, i) => (i === 0 && !restart ? { dt: dtOf(r, dt, dtMix), keys: ["space"] } : p(obs, i));
}

function bot({ r, frames, dt = DT, dtMix = false, preset = "greedy", miss = 0, noise = 0, esc = 0, restart = { wait: [8, 40] }, stopAt = null }) {
  const w = PRESETS[preset];
  const inner = (obs, i) => {
    if (i >= frames) return null;
    const d = dtOf(r, dt, dtMix);
    if (!obs) return { dt: d, keys: [] };
    if (stopAt && obs.rows >= stopAt) return null;
    let keys = [];
    if (esc && r() < esc) return { dt: d, keys: ["esc"] };
    if (obs.actions.length === 0) {
      const k = plan(obs, w);
      if (k && !(miss && r() < miss)) keys = [k];
    }
    if (noise && r() < noise) keys = [pick(r, ["left", "right", "up", "down"])];
    return { dt: d, keys };
  };
  const p = withRestarts(inner, { r, ...restart });
  return (obs, i) => (i === 0 ? { dt: dtOf(r, dt, dtMix), keys: ["space"] } : p(obs, i));
}

// ---- coverage read off a recorded trace (independent of any port)
export function analyze(trace, inputs) {
  const c = {
    frames: trace.length, starts: 0, restarts: 0, loses: 0, losesByEsc: 0, losesByStack: 0, locks: 0,
    clear1: 0, clear2: 0, clear3: 0, clear4: 0, maxRows: 0, maxScore: 0, minStep: 0.6, stepValues: 0,
    rotations: 0, rotBlockedWall: 0, rotBlockedStack: 0, rotMismatch: 0, kicksNeeded: 0,
    moves: 0, movesBlocked: 0, softDrops: 0, gravityDrops: 0, keysWhileStopped: 0, queueMax: 0, queueCleared: 0,
    doubleLockFrames: 0, vscoreCatchUp: 0, bagRefills: 0, locksByType: {}, rotByTypeDir: {},
  };
  const steps = new Set();
  const DIRN = ["up", "right", "down", "left"];
  for (let f = 1; f < trace.length; f++) {
    const p = trace[f - 1], s = trace[f], inp = inputs[f - 1];
    if (s.playing && !p.playing) { c.starts++; if (c.loses) c.restarts++; }
    if (!s.playing && p.playing) {
      c.loses++;
      if (inp.keys.includes("esc") && !p.actions.length) c.losesByEsc++; else c.losesByStack++;
    }
    c.maxRows = Math.max(c.maxRows, s.rows); c.maxScore = Math.max(c.maxScore, s.score);
    c.minStep = Math.min(c.minStep, s.step); steps.add(s.step);
    c.queueMax = Math.max(c.queueMax, s.actions.length);
    if (s.vscore < s.score && s.playing) c.vscoreCatchUp++;
    if (!p.playing && inp.keys.some((k) => k !== "space" && k !== "play")) c.keysWhileStopped++;
    if (s.bag.length > p.bag.length + 2) c.bagRefills++;
    if (!p.playing) continue;
    // the action handled in this frame: the head of the queue after this frame's key presses
    const pushed = s.playing || true ? inp.keys.filter((k) => ["left", "right", "up", "down"].includes(k)).map((k) => DIRN.indexOf(k)) : [];
    const queue = p.actions.concat(pushed);
    const head = inp.keys.includes("esc") ? undefined : queue[0];
    const locked = s.score !== p.score;
    const rows = s.rows - p.rows;
    if (rows > 0) c["clear" + rows]++;
    if (locked) {
      c.locks++;
      c.locksByType[p.current.type] = (c.locksByType[p.current.type] || 0) + 1;
      if (s.score - p.score >= 20 && rows === 0) c.doubleLockFrames++;
    }
    if (head !== undefined && !inp.keys.includes("esc")) {
      const q = p.current;
      if (head === 0) {
        c.rotations++;
        const nd = (q.dir + 1) & 3;
        const h = hit(p.grid, q.type, q.x, q.y, nd);
        if (h === 1) c.rotBlockedWall++; else if (h === 2) c.rotBlockedStack++;
        if (!locked && s.playing) {
          const turned = s.current.dir !== q.dir || (q.type === "o");
          if ((h === 0) !== turned && q.type !== "o") c.rotMismatch++;
        }
        if (h === 0) { const k = q.type + nd; c.rotByTypeDir[k] = (c.rotByTypeDir[k] || 0) + 1; }
        else if (q.type !== "o") {
          // would a kick (one column either way) have let it turn?
          if ([-1, 1, -2, 2].some((dx) => hit(p.grid, q.type, q.x + dx, q.y, nd) === 0)) c.kicksNeeded++;
        }
      } else if (head === 2) c.softDrops++;
      else {
        c.moves++;
        if (hit(p.grid, q.type, q.x + (head === 3 ? -1 : 1), q.y, q.dir)) c.movesBlocked++;
      }
    }
    if (p.actions.length && !s.actions.length && locked) c.queueCleared++;
    if (s.dt < p.dt && !locked && s.current.y === p.current.y + 1 && head !== 2) c.gravityDrops++;
  }
  c.stepValues = steps.size;
  return c;
}

export async function runCase({ seed, player }) {
  const g = await openOriginal({ seed });
  try {
    const trace = [g.initial];
    const inputs = [];
    for (let i = 0; ; i++) {
      const inp = player(trace[trace.length - 1], i);
      if (!inp) break;
      const st = await g.step(inp);
      inputs.push({ dt: inp.dt, keys: inp.keys });
      trace.push(st);
    }
    return { tape: await g.tape(), inputs, trace };
  } finally { await g.close(); }
}

export function buildCases() {
  const R = (s) => mulberry32(s * 7919 + 17);
  const cases = [];
  const add = (name, seed, make) => cases.push({ name, seed, make: () => make(R(seed)) });
  const arrows = ["left", "right", "up", "down"];
  // nothing pressed: the pieces fall and stack in place until the court is full, again and again
  add("idle-wait-16ms", 1, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 1500, keys: () => [] }));
  add("idle-stack-lose-100ms", 2, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 3500, dt: 100, keys: () => [], restart: { wait: [5, 30] } }));
  add("idle-stack-lose-50ms", 3, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 3500, dt: 50, keys: () => [], restart: { wait: [5, 30], link: 0.5 } }));
  add("idle-stack-mixed-dt", 4, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 4000, dtMix: true, keys: () => [], restart: { wait: [1, 20] } }));
  // keys with no game running, then a start: arrows, Escape and Space while stopped
  add("keys-while-stopped", 5, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 600, dtMix: true, keys: () => [], restart: { wait: [40, 90], stray: 0.6 } }));
  add("space-and-link-while-playing", 6, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 900, dtMix: true, keys: (i, o, rr) => (rr() < 0.05 ? [pick(rr, ["space", "play"])] : []), restart: { wait: [3, 15], link: 0.5 } }));
  // random keys
  add("random-keys-60fps", 7, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 2500, keys: (i, o, rr) => (rr() < 0.4 ? [pick(rr, arrows)] : []), restart: { wait: [5, 30] } }));
  add("random-keys-8ms", 8, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 2000, dt: 8, keys: (i, o, rr) => (rr() < 0.5 ? [pick(rr, arrows)] : []), restart: { wait: [5, 30] } }));
  add("random-keys-mixed-dt", 9, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 3500, dtMix: true, keys: (i, o, rr) => (rr() < 0.5 ? [pick(rr, arrows)] : []), restart: { wait: [2, 20] } }));
  add("random-keys-100ms", 10, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 2500, dt: 100, keys: (i, o, rr) => (rr() < 0.6 ? [pick(rr, arrows)] : []), restart: { wait: [2, 20] } }));
  add("several-keys-per-frame", 11, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 1500, dtMix: true, keys: (i, o, rr) => { const n = Math.floor(rr() * 4); const k = []; for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) k.push(pick(rr, [...arrows, "esc"].slice(0, rr() < 0.97 ? 4 : 5))); return k; }, restart: { wait: [2, 15] } }));
  // soft drop spam and key mashing: the queue grows, and is emptied whenever a piece locks
  add("soft-drop-every-frame", 12, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 2500, keys: () => ["down"], restart: { wait: [2, 10] } }));
  add("soft-drop-100ms", 13, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 2000, dt: 100, keys: () => ["down"], restart: { wait: [2, 10] } }));
  add("soft-drop-twice-per-frame", 14, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 1500, dt: 33, keys: () => ["down", "down"], restart: { wait: [2, 10] } }));
  add("mash-all-arrows", 15, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 1800, dtMix: true, keys: () => ["left", "up", "right", "down"], restart: { wait: [2, 10] } }));
  // rotations against walls and stacks (no kicks in the original)
  add("rotate-at-left-wall", 16, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 2000, dt: 33, keys: (i) => (i % 40 < 8 ? ["left"] : i % 40 < 30 ? ["up"] : ["down"]), restart: { wait: [2, 20] } }));
  add("rotate-at-right-wall", 17, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 2000, dt: 33, keys: (i) => (i % 40 < 8 ? ["right"] : i % 40 < 30 ? ["up"] : ["down"]), restart: { wait: [2, 20] } }));
  add("rotate-spam-on-stack", 18, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 2500, dt: 50, keys: (i, o, rr) => (o.actions.length < 2 && rr() < 0.7 ? [pick(rr, ["up", "up", "up", "left", "right"])] : []), restart: { wait: [2, 20] } }));
  // Escape: ends the game at once, then start again
  add("esc-at-random", 19, (r) => scripted({ r, frames: 1500, dtMix: true, keys: (i, o, rr) => (rr() < 0.02 ? ["esc"] : rr() < 0.3 ? [pick(rr, arrows)] : []), restart: { wait: [1, 10], link: 0.3 } }));
  // bots that clear lines
  add("bot-greedy-60fps", 21, (r) => bot({ r, frames: 3500 }));
  add("bot-greedy-60fps-b", 22, (r) => bot({ r, frames: 3500 }));
  add("bot-doubles", 23, (r) => bot({ r, frames: 3500, preset: "doubles" }));
  add("bot-triples", 24, (r) => bot({ r, frames: 3500, preset: "triples" }));
  add("bot-quads", 25, (r) => bot({ r, frames: 3500, preset: "quads" }));
  add("bot-quads-33ms", 26, (r) => bot({ r, frames: 3500, preset: "quads", dt: 33 }));
  add("bot-8ms", 27, (r) => bot({ r, frames: 2500, dt: 8 }));
  add("bot-20ms", 28, (r) => bot({ r, frames: 2500, dt: 20, preset: "doubles" }));
  add("bot-50ms", 29, (r) => bot({ r, frames: 2500, dt: 50, preset: "triples" }));
  add("bot-100ms", 30, (r) => bot({ r, frames: 2500, dt: 100 }));
  add("bot-mixed-dt", 31, (r) => bot({ r, frames: 3500, dtMix: true, preset: "quads" }));
  // bots with slips: wrong keys, skipped keys, Escape: they lose and start over
  add("bot-sloppy-1", 32, (r) => bot({ r, frames: 3500, miss: 0.15, noise: 0.15, restart: { wait: [3, 20] } }));
  add("bot-sloppy-2", 33, (r) => bot({ r, frames: 3500, miss: 0.3, noise: 0.1, dtMix: true, restart: { wait: [3, 20], link: 0.4 } }));
  add("bot-slow-reflexes", 34, (r) => bot({ r, frames: 3500, miss: 0.7, dt: 20, restart: { wait: [3, 20] } }));
  add("bot-with-escape", 35, (r) => bot({ r, frames: 3000, esc: 0.004, restart: { wait: [3, 20] } }));
  // long runs that reach a hundred rows: gravity gets to its fastest (step 0.6 - 0.005 * rows, at least 0.1)
  add("bot-marathon-a", 41, (r) => bot({ r, frames: 12000, preset: "doubles", dt: 33, stopAt: 130, restart: { wait: [3, 20] } }));
  add("bot-marathon-b", 42, (r) => bot({ r, frames: 12000, preset: "greedy", dtMix: true, stopAt: 130, restart: { wait: [3, 20] } }));
  return cases;
}

export async function record({ only, log = () => {} } = {}) {
  const outDir = path.join(here, "cases");
  fs.mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true });
  const cases = buildCases().filter((c) => !only || only.includes(c.name));
  let frames = 0, inputs = 0;
  const total = { locksByType: {}, rotByTypeDir: {} };
  for (const c of cases) {
    const { tape, inputs: inp, trace } = await runCase({ seed: c.seed, player: c.make() });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, `${c.name}.json`), JSON.stringify({ game: "blocks", name: c.name, seed: c.seed, clock0: T0, tape, inputs: inp, trace }));
    const a = analyze(trace, inp);
    for (const k of Object.keys(a)) {
      if (typeof a[k] === "object") for (const [kk, v] of Object.entries(a[k])) total[k][kk] = (total[k][kk] ?? 0) + v;
      else total[k] = (k === "minStep" ? Math.min(total[k] ?? 1, a[k]) : k === "maxRows" || k === "maxScore" || k === "queueMax" ? Math.max(total[k] ?? 0, a[k]) : (total[k] ?? 0) + a[k]);
    }
    frames += trace.length; inputs += inp.length;
    log(`${c.name.padEnd(30)} frames ${String(trace.length).padStart(5)} randoms ${String(tape.length).padStart(4)} rows ${String(a.maxRows).padStart(3)} clears ${a.clear1}/${a.clear2}/${a.clear3}/${a.clear4} loses ${a.loses} rotBlocked ${a.rotBlockedWall}+${a.rotBlockedStack} mism ${a.rotMismatch}`);
  }
  return { cases: cases.length, inputs, frames, coverage: total };
}

if (process.argv[1] === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) console.log(JSON.stringify(await record({ log: console.log })));

```

`games/canvas-bird/GAME.md`:

```md
# Canvas Bird: behavior spec

Original: Canvas Bird (MIT), vendored unmodified in `originals/canvas-bird` (`app.js`, about 300 lines, one IIFE).
The port in `ports/web/bird.mjs` was written from this page, not by translating `app.js`.

## What was recorded and how

The page runs unmodified in headless Chrome (`driver.mjs`). Its state is inside the IIFE, so it is observed
black-box through the canvas 2D context: `clearRect`, `drawImage`, `fillText` and `strokeText` are wrapped
(and so are the `fillStyle` / `strokeStyle` setters, to keep the raw string that was assigned). Everything the
player can see is one of those calls, so a frame is the list of its calls, as strings, numbers printed exactly
as JavaScript prints them (nothing is rounded):

| string | call |
|---|---|
| `c:0:0:640:480` | `clearRect` |
| `i:enemy_up:x:y` | `drawImage(img, x, y)`, image named by its file |
| `s:player:sx:0:64:64:70:y:64:64` | `drawImage` with a source rectangle (the bird, 3 sprite frames) |
| `t:fill|stroke:text:x:y:style` | `fillText` / `strokeText` with the style string last assigned |
| `a:point`, `a:lose` | `Audio.play()` of the point / lose sound was requested |

Only its inputs are replaced:

- **Clock.** `Date.now`, `performance.now`, `requestAnimationFrame` and `cancelAnimationFrame` are faked. The page
  advances only when the driver calls `step({dt, click})`: the click event (if any) is dispatched on the canvas, the
  clock moves by `dt` ms (starts at 1000000), and the queued animation callback runs once. `Date.now()` is
  `floor(t)` as in a real browser, `t` accumulates the float `dt` values.
- **Random.** `Math.random` is a seeded generator; every value it hands out is saved as `tape`.
- **Audio.** `Audio` is a stub whose `play()` only adds `a:...` to the frame.
- The page's CSS imports a web font; network requests are blocked (the font cannot change what is drawn on the
  canvas, `ctx.font` is not observable through the calls above).

A case is `{seed, tape, inputs: [{dt, click}], trace}`. `trace[0]` is the frame `window.onload` draws before any
step, `trace[i]` is the frame of `inputs[i-1]`. The inputs come from small scripted players that look only at the
previous frame's draw list (`record.mjs`), so they react to the game; the port gets the inputs and the tape and
nothing else.

## Constants

| | |
|---|---|
| canvas | 640 x 480 |
| bird | box 64 x 64, x = 70 (never changes), starts at y = 20 with velocity 2, force 0.15 per frame, jump sets velocity -6, falling velocity stops growing once it is 8 or more |
| pipes | 5 sets, each an up pipe and a down pipe, 64 x 316 images, 300 px apart (x = 640 + 300 i), 3 px per frame |
| gap | up pipe y = 240 + 120 + off, down pipe y = 0 - 120 + off, off = `floor(rand * 201 - 150)`, so -150..50; the opening is `[off + 196, off + 360]`, 164 px tall |
| background | two images, 640 wide, 1 px per frame, jump to x = 640 once x <= -640 |
| frame gate | 30 fps = 1000/30 = 33.333... ms |
| text | `Click to start game` at x = 90, y = 80; the score at x = 309 (stroke, y 51) and 310 (fill, y 50) |

## Order of operations in one rendered frame

A step is: (click handler, if clicked) then the animation callback.

**Click handler.** If controls are on: velocity = -6. If no round is on: score = 0, velocity = 2, y = 20, five new
pipe sets are made (one random number each, in order 0..4), `next = 0`, `last = 4`, round on, controls on. So the
**first click only starts** (controls were off when it began), the second one flaps.

**Frame.** `clearRect`, two background draws, then both backgrounds move.
- *No round on:* stroke the text with `rgba(0,0,0,a)`, fill it with `rgba(255,255,255,a)`, then move `a` by 0.02:
  `a` starts at 1 and falls; when it is below 0 it turns and rises; when above 1 it turns and falls. It is not reset
  by a round, so the splash after a loss continues where the last one stopped.
- *Round on:* for each pipe set 0..4: draw up pipe, draw down pipe, move up pipe, move down pipe. Then the bird:
  1. pick the sprite frame (this reads the clock, gate below), draw the bird at the current y,
  2. fall (gate below): velocity += 0.15 if it is below 8, then y += velocity,
  3. collision check with the new y; if it hit, controls go off, and if `y - 64 > 480` the round ends,
  4. `strokeText(score)` using whatever stroke style the splash left, `fillText(score)` in white.

A pipe is therefore drawn before it moves and the bird is drawn before it falls: the frame shows the position
from before this frame's physics; the collision is judged after it.

**Pipe move.** Up pipe: x -= 3; if x <= -64 it is recycled: its x and its down pipe's x become the x of pipe
`last` plus 300 (that pipe's value at that moment, which has or has not moved yet this frame depending on the
order of the ids), one random number is taken for a new offset, `last` advances. Both pipes then check scoring:
if this set is `next` and its x + 64 < 134, `next` advances and, if controls are on, score += 1 and `a:point`. The
down pipe moves 3 px after the up pipe in the same frame, so after the first recycle the two images of a set are
3 px apart in x for ever.

## Collision

Only `pipes[next]` is looked at. With `right = 134` (bird x + 64, the front edge), `px = down.x + 40`:

- if `px < right < px + 24` (down.x between 70 and 94 exclusive, 8 frames at 3 px) and
  (`top < down.y + 316` or `bottom > up.y`): hit. The top and bottom of the bird are the 64 px box.
- if `bottom < 0` or `top > 480`: hit, whether or not a pipe is near.

`a:lose` is requested when a hit is found while controls are still on, i.e. once per round. The hit does not stop
the round: controls go off (no flap, no score, a new click does nothing), the bird keeps falling and the pipes keep
moving (and recycling, and taking random numbers) until the bird is below the screen, then the splash returns.
A hit above the top does not end the round either: the bird (controls off) falls back onto the screen and out of
the bottom, so a "top exit" costs a few dozen extra frames before the splash.

## What the 30 fps gate really does

Two clocks are compared with `now - counter > 33.33`:

- **Sprite frame** (`fpsCounter`) is reset each time the sprite advances, so the bird flaps its three frames
  (0, 1, 2, 0...) at most every 34 ms of the clock. With 16.667 ms steps it changes every 3rd frame (50 ms, as
  the integer clock reaches 34+), with 8 ms every 5th, with 33 ms every 2nd, with 50 and 100 ms every frame.
- **Fall** (`fallingCounter`) is set once at page load and **never reset**. After the first 34 ms of the clock it is
  always true, so the physics runs once per rendered frame whatever `dt` is: falling speed per second depends on
  the frame rate (twice as fast at 8 ms steps as at 16.667 ms, and the pipes, 3 px a frame, scale the same
  way, so only the clicks' timing is different in time terms). The gate matters only for a round that starts
  within 34 ms of load: with 16.667 ms steps the first two frames after the click do not fall (clock 16, 33), so y = 20 is
  drawn three times; with 8 ms steps four frames do not fall and y = 20 is drawn five times. Recorded in
  `click-at-load-60fps` and `click-at-load-8ms`.

## Quirks found

- The gate above: "30 fps lock for falling" does not lock anything after the first 34 ms.
- Recycled pipes get a new random offset but their `y` is not recomputed: `yOffset` is stored and never used. The
  gap heights of the five sets are fixed by the first five random numbers of a round; later random numbers
  are consumed (and must be, to keep the tape in step) but change nothing on screen. The pipes just repeat every 5.
- `hasCollided & PLAYER_CONTROLS_ON`: a single `&` between booleans. It works (the result is 0 or 1) and is
  not a behavior difference.
- The score stroke uses the stroke style the last splash frame left (`rgba(0,0,0,0.9199999999999999)` and so on),
  so the outline's opacity is a leftover; fill is plain white.
- The first click does not flap. A click while the bird is falling after a hit does nothing.
- Only the next pipe is checked and only for 8 frames: the 40 px offsets make the hit box 24 px wide inside a 64 px
  image, and the bird's front edge is the only thing tested (its back part can overlap a pipe image).
- Falling speed stops growing at 8, flap speed is -6: from velocity -6 the bird rises about 120 px.
- `playerBottomY < 0` is "above the top", so the bird that flew up can go on until its whole body is out of sight
  before that counts.
- The fall counter, the sprite clock, the text alpha and the background offsets are never reset by a new round.

## Not modelled, and why that is safe

- **Audio.** The sounds are not played; only the request is traced (`a:point` / `a:lose`, once per event). The
  game never reads anything back from audio.
- **The images.** Pixel content is not compared; names, positions and source rectangles are. The one place the
  game reads an image is its `width` / `height`, which `loadImage` sets from the constants (64, 316, 640), so
  size comes from attributes, not from files.
- **Real time and the web font.** Replaced by the fake clock; no draw call depends on the font.
- **Everything not reachable through the page's one click handler:** no keyboard, touch or other events exist in
  the original, so the inputs `{dt, click}` are all there is.

## Coverage of the recording (read off the traces by `analyze()` in `record.mjs`, not from the port)

30 cases, 68,409 inputs, 68,439 recorded frames (28 MB of JSON), seeds 1 to 41, steps of 8, 16.667, 20, 33, 50
and 100 ms (and a random mix of all six).

| what | count |
|---|---|
| rounds started | 133 (105 of them after a loss, i.e. restarts from the splash) |
| score increments (`a:point`) | 354; highest score in one round 60; 9 cases reach 32 or more (bot-60fps-a, bot-60fps-b, bot-mixed-dt, bot-8ms, bot-20ms, bot-33ms, bot-50ms, bot-100ms, bot-marathon) |
| pipe recycles seen (an up pipe jumping right) | 494 (each takes one random number) |
| hits (`a:lose`) | 142: 48 top pipe, 11 bottom pipe, 68 above the top, 15 below the bottom |
| round ended by falling off the bottom | 108 (back to the splash) |
| splash frames (alpha fluctuation) | 3,898, the longest wait is 700 frames, so alpha crossed both ends |

Hit kinds are classified from the frame after the hit (bird y) and the pipe whose window the bird front was in; the
two the bots rarely produce, bottom pipe (11) and below the bottom (15), have the thinnest coverage.

## Not covered

- Only the next-pipe rule was exercised by bots that pass, plus crashes; a bird that sits outside the gap in the
  window of a pipe other than `next` is possible only if `next` lags the pipes, which never happened in any case.
- One click per frame only (the driver dispatches one click event per step); several clicks between two frames
  are not recorded. The handler is idempotent per frame apart from the first click, so two clicks in one frame would
  start a round and flap in the same frame, which no case does.
- `dt` values were never below 8 ms or above 100 ms, and `dt` = 0 was not tried.
- Cases are one session from page load; the page is never reloaded mid case.


```

`games/canvas-bird/driver.mjs`:

```mjs
// Runs the ORIGINAL Canvas Bird (originals/canvas-bird, MIT) unmodified in headless Chrome and
// observes it black-box through the canvas 2D context. Only its inputs are replaced: a fake clock
// (Date.now, performance.now, requestAnimationFrame), a seeded Math.random whose values go to a tape,
// and a stub Audio. Every rendered frame becomes a list of strings, one per draw call:
//   c:x:y:w:h                      clearRect
//   i:name:x:y                     drawImage(img, x, y)
//   s:name:sx:sy:sw:sh:dx:dy:dw:dh drawImage with a source rectangle
//   t:fill|stroke:text:x:y:style   fillText / strokeText with the raw style string last assigned
//   a:point|lose                   Audio.play() was called
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";

const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
export const ORIGINAL = path.join(here, "../../originals/canvas-bird/index.html");
export const T0 = 1000000; // the fake clock's start, in ms (the port uses the same)

function loadPlaywright() {
  const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);
  const tries = ["playwright", process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH, "/opt/node22/lib/node_modules/playwright", "/opt/node-tools/node_modules/playwright"].filter(Boolean);
  for (const t of tries) { try { return require(t); } catch {} }
  throw new Error("playwright not found; set PLAYWRIGHT_PATH");
}

// runs in the page before any of its scripts
function install({ seed, T0 }) {
  let t = T0;
  const queue = [];
  let frame = [];
  const tape = [];
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  Math.random = () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let x = a;
    x = Math.imul(x ^ (x >>> 15), x | 1);
    x ^= x + Math.imul(x ^ (x >>> 7), x | 61);
    const v = ((x ^ (x >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    tape.push(v);
    return v;
  };
  Date.now = () => Math.floor(t);
  performance.now = () => t - T0;
  window.requestAnimationFrame = (cb) => { queue.push(cb); return queue.length; };
  window.cancelAnimationFrame = () => {};
  const base = (s) => String(s).split("/").pop().replace(/\.[a-z0-9]+$/, "");
  window.Audio = function (src) { this.src = src; };
  window.Audio.prototype.play = function () { frame.push("a:" + base(this.src)); return Promise.resolve(); };
  const P = CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype;
  const raw = { fillStyle: "#000000", strokeStyle: "#000000" };
  for (const k of ["fillStyle", "strokeStyle"]) {
    const d = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(P, k);
    Object.defineProperty(P, k, { get() { return d.get.call(this); }, set(v) { raw[k] = String(v); d.set.call(this, v); }, configurable: true });
  }
  const wrap = (name, fn) => { const o = P[name]; P[name] = function (...args) { frame.push(fn(args)); return o.apply(this, args); }; };
  wrap("clearRect", (a) => "c:" + a.join(":"));
  wrap("drawImage", (a) => {
    const n = a[0] && a[0].getAttribute ? base(a[0].getAttribute("src")) : "?";
    return (a.length === 9 ? "s:" : "i:") + [n, ...a.slice(1)].join(":");
  });
  wrap("fillText", (a) => "t:fill:" + [a[0], a[1], a[2], raw.fillStyle].join(":"));
  wrap("strokeText", (a) => "t:stroke:" + [a[0], a[1], a[2], raw.strokeStyle].join(":"));
  window.__bird = {
    // one rendered frame: optionally click first, advance the clock, run the animation callbacks
    step(dt, click) {
      frame = [];
      if (click) document.getElementById("canvas").dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("click", { bubbles: true }));
      t += dt;
      const cbs = queue.splice(0);
      for (const cb of cbs) cb(t);
      return frame;
    },
    take() { const f = frame; frame = []; return f; },
    tape: () => tape.slice(),
  };
}

export async function openOriginal({ seed = 1, headless = true } = {}) {
  const { chromium } = loadPlaywright();
  let browser;
  try { browser = await chromium.launch({ headless }); }
  catch { browser = await chromium.launch({ headless, channel: "chrome" }); }
  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 700, height: 540 } });
  await page.route((u) => !u.protocol.startsWith("file"), (r) => r.abort()); // the page imports a web font
  await page.addInitScript(install, { seed, T0 });
  await page.goto(pathToFileURL(ORIGINAL).href, { waitUntil: "load" });
  const initial = await page.evaluate(() => window.__bird.take()); // the frame drawn by window.onload
  return {
    page,
    initial,
    step: ({ dt, click = false }) => page.evaluate(([d, c]) => window.__bird.step(d, c), [dt, !!click]),
    shot: (file) => page.screenshot({ path: file, clip: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 660, height: 500 } }),
    tape: () => page.evaluate(() => window.__bird.tape()),
    close: () => browser.close(),
  };
}
```
