```rs
//! Canvas Bird rules in plain Rust. Same operation order as the verified JS port so f64 results match.
//! The game advances one rendered frame per `step`; draw calls are a typed list, printed by the runner.

pub const T0: f64 = 1000000.0;
pub const W: f64 = 640.0;
pub const H: f64 = 480.0;
const PIPES: usize = 5;
const SPACING: f64 = 300.0;
const GAP: f64 = 120.0;
const MIN_OFF: f64 = -150.0;
const MAX_OFF: f64 = 50.0;
const PIPE_SPEED: f64 = 3.0;
pub const PIPE_W: f64 = 64.0;
pub const PIPE_H: f64 = 316.0;
pub const BIRD_X: f64 = 70.0;
pub const BIRD_W: f64 = 64.0;
pub const BIRD_H: f64 = 64.0;
const START_Y: f64 = 20.0;
const START_V: f64 = 2.0;
const FORCE: f64 = 0.15;
const JUMP: f64 = -6.0;
const MAX_V: f64 = 8.0;
const FRAME_MS: f64 = 1000.0 / 30.0;

/// One canvas call (or audio request) of a frame.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Call {
    Clear,
    Background(f64),
    EnemyUp(f64, f64),
    EnemyDown(f64, f64),
    /// sprite source x, y
    Player(f64, f64, f64),
    /// stroke?, text, x, y, style
    Text {
        stroke: bool,
        text: Text,
        x: f64,
        y: f64,
        style: Style,
    },
    Point,
    Lose,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Text {
    Splash,
    Score(u32),
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Style {
    /// rgba(r,g,b,alpha)
    Rgba(u8, f64),
    White,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Pipe {
    pub id: usize,
    pub up_x: f64,
    pub up_y: f64,
    pub down_x: f64,
    pub down_y: f64,
    pub off: f64,
}

pub struct Bird {
    rng: Box<dyn FnMut() -> f64>,
    t: f64,
    pub playing: bool,
    pub controls: bool,
    pub score: u32,
    pub alpha: f64,
    rising: bool,
    stroke_alpha: f64,
    pub bg: [f64; 2],
    pub y: f64,
    pub v: f64,
    pub sprite: u32,
    sprite_clock: f64,
    fall_clock: f64,
    pub pipes: Vec<Pipe>,
    next: usize,
    last: usize,
    out: Vec<Call>,
}

impl Bird {
    pub fn new(rng: Box<dyn FnMut() -> f64>, start: f64) -> Bird {
        let n = start.floor();
        Bird {
            rng,
            t: start,
            playing: false,
            controls: false,
            score: 0,
            alpha: 1.0,
            rising: false,
            stroke_alpha: 1.0,
            bg: [0.0, W],
            y: START_Y,
            v: START_V,
            sprite: 0,
            sprite_clock: n,
            fall_clock: n,
            pipes: Vec::new(),
            next: 0,
            last: PIPES - 1,
            out: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    fn now(&self) -> f64 {
        self.t.floor()
    }

    fn rand_int(&mut self, lo: f64, hi: f64) -> f64 {
        ((self.rng)() * (hi - lo + 1.0) + lo).floor()
    }

    fn setup_pipes(&mut self) {
        self.next = 0;
        self.last = PIPES - 1;
        self.pipes.clear();
        for i in 0..PIPES {
            let off = self.rand_int(MIN_OFF, MAX_OFF);
            let x = W + i as f64 * SPACING;
            self.pipes.push(Pipe {
                id: i,
                up_x: x,
                up_y: H / 2.0 + GAP + off,
                down_x: x,
                down_y: 0.0 - GAP + off,
                off,
            });
        }
    }

    fn score_check(&mut self, id: usize, x: f64) {
        if id == self.next && x + PIPE_W < BIRD_X + BIRD_W {
            self.next = if self.next == PIPES - 1 {
                0
            } else {
                self.next + 1
            };
            if self.controls {
                self.score += 1;
                self.out.push(Call::Point);
            }
        }
    }

    fn move_up(&mut self, i: usize) {
        self.pipes[i].up_x -= PIPE_SPEED;
        if self.pipes[i].up_x <= -PIPE_W {
            let nx = self.pipes[self.last].up_x + SPACING;
            self.pipes[i].up_x = nx;
            self.pipes[i].down_x = nx;
            self.pipes[i].off = self.rand_int(MIN_OFF, MAX_OFF); // y is not recomputed (see GAME.md)
            self.last = if self.last == PIPES - 1 {
                0
            } else {
                self.last + 1
            };
        }
        let (id, x) = (self.pipes[i].id, self.pipes[i].up_x);
        self.score_check(id, x);
    }

    fn move_down(&mut self, i: usize) {
        self.pipes[i].down_x -= PIPE_SPEED;
        let (id, x) = (self.pipes[i].id, self.pipes[i].down_x);
        self.score_check(id, x);
    }

    fn collided(&mut self) -> bool {
        let right = BIRD_X + BIRD_W;
        let top = self.y;
        let bottom = self.y + BIRD_H;
        let p = &self.pipes[self.next];
        let px = p.down_x + 40.0;
        let gap_top = p.down_y + PIPE_H;
        let gap_bottom = p.up_y;
        let mut hit = false;
        if right > px && right < px + PIPE_W - 40.0 && (top < gap_top || bottom > gap_bottom) {
            hit = true;
        }
        if bottom < 0.0 || top > H {
            hit = true;
        }
        if hit && self.controls {
            self.out.push(Call::Lose);
        }
        hit
    }

    fn sprite_frame(&mut self) -> u32 {
        let n = self.now();
        if n - self.sprite_clock > FRAME_MS {
            self.sprite_clock = n;
            self.sprite += 1;
            if self.sprite > 2 {
                self.sprite = 0;
            }
        }
        self.sprite
    }

    /// Draws one frame and returns its calls.
    pub fn draw(&mut self) -> Vec<Call> {
        self.out = Vec::new();
        self.out.push(Call::Clear);
        for i in 0..2 {
            let x = self.bg[i];
            self.out.push(Call::Background(x));
        }
        for b in self.bg.iter_mut() {
            *b -= 1.0;
            if *b <= -W {
                *b = W;
            }
        }
        let tx = W / 2.0 - 230.0;
        if !self.playing {
            self.stroke_alpha = self.alpha;
            self.out.push(Call::Text {
                stroke: true,
                text: Text::Splash,
                x: tx,
                y: 80.0,
                style: Style::Rgba(0, self.alpha),
            });
            self.out.push(Call::Text {
                stroke: false,
                text: Text::Splash,
                x: tx,
                y: 80.0,
                style: Style::Rgba(255, self.alpha),
            });
            if self.alpha < 0.0 {
                self.rising = true;
            }
            if self.alpha > 1.0 {
                self.rising = false;
            }
            self.alpha += if self.rising { 0.02 } else { -0.02 };
        } else {
            for i in 0..self.pipes.len() {
                let p = &self.pipes[i];
                let (a, b, c, d) = (p.up_x, p.up_y, p.down_x, p.down_y);
                self.out.push(Call::EnemyUp(a, b));
                self.out.push(Call::EnemyDown(c, d));
                self.move_up(i);
                self.move_down(i);
            }
            let sx = self.sprite_frame() as f64 * BIRD_W;
            self.out.push(Call::Player(sx, 0.0, self.y));
            if self.now() - self.fall_clock > FRAME_MS {
                if self.v < MAX_V {
                    self.v += FORCE;
                }
                self.y += self.v;
            }
            if self.collided() {
                self.controls = false;
                if self.y - BIRD_H > H {
                    self.playing = false;
                }
            }
            let s = self.score;
            self.out.push(Call::Text {
                stroke: true,
                text: Text::Score(s),
                x: W / 2.0 - 11.0,
                y: 51.0,
                style: Style::Rgba(0, self.stroke_alpha),
            });
            self.out.push(Call::Text {
                stroke: false,
                text: Text::Score(s),
                x: W / 2.0 - 10.0,
                y: 50.0,
                style: Style::White,
            });
        }
        std::mem::take(&mut self.out)
    }

    fn click(&mut self) {
        if self.controls {
            self.v = JUMP;
        }
        if !self.playing {
            self.score = 0;
            self.v = START_V;
            self.y = START_Y;
            self.setup_pipes();
            self.playing = true;
            self.controls = true;
        }
    }

    /// The frame drawn at page load, before any step.
    pub fn load(&mut self) -> Vec<Call> {
        self.draw()
    }

    pub fn step(&mut self, dt: f64, clicked: bool) -> Vec<Call> {
        if clicked {
            self.click();
        }
        self.t += dt;
        self.draw()
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Playable Canvas Bird: bird-core runs the rules at 60 steps a second, Bevy draws plain shapes.
//! Click, tap or press Space to flap; click after losing to restart. The score is in the window title.
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bird_core::{Bird, BIRD_H, BIRD_W, BIRD_X, H, PIPE_H, PIPE_W, W};

const STEP_MS: f64 = 1000.0 / 60.0;

/// A small xorshift64* generator, seeded from the clock, for the live game's random numbers.
struct Prng(u64);
impl Prng {
    fn from_clock() -> Prng {
        let n = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map(|d| d.as_nanos() as u64)
            .unwrap_or(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15);
        Prng(n | 1)
    }
    /// Next number in [0, 1).
    fn next(&mut self) -> f64 {
        self.0 ^= self.0 >> 12;
        self.0 ^= self.0 << 25;
        self.0 ^= self.0 >> 27;
        let v = self.0.wrapping_mul(0x2545_F491_4F6C_DD1D);
        (v >> 11) as f64 / (1u64 << 53) as f64
    }
}

struct Game {
    bird: Bird,
    acc: f64,
}

#[derive(Component)]
struct Drawn;

fn main() {
    App::new()
        .add_plugins(DefaultPlugins.set(WindowPlugin {
            primary_window: Some(Window {
                title: "Canvas Bird".into(),
                resolution: (640u32, 480u32).into(),
                ..default()
            }),
            ..default()
        }))
        .insert_resource(ClearColor(Color::srgb(0.45, 0.75, 0.9)))
        .insert_non_send(Game {
            bird: {
                let mut p = Prng::from_clock();
                let mut b = Bird::new(Box::new(move || p.next()), bird_core::T0);
                b.load();
                b
            },
            acc: 0.0,
        })
        .add_systems(Startup, |mut commands: Commands| {
            commands.spawn(Camera2d);
        })
        .add_systems(Update, (tick, draw).chain())
        .run();
}

fn tick(
    time: Res<Time>,
    keys: Res<ButtonInput<KeyCode>>,
    mouse: Res<ButtonInput<MouseButton>>,
    touches: Res<Touches>,
    mut game: NonSendMut<Game>,
) {
    let g = &mut *game;
    let mut click = keys.just_pressed(KeyCode::Space)
        || mouse.just_pressed(MouseButton::Left)
        || touches.any_just_pressed();
    g.acc += (time.delta_secs_f64() * 1000.0).min(250.0);
    while g.acc >= STEP_MS {
        g.acc -= STEP_MS;
        g.bird.step(STEP_MS, click);
        click = false;
    }
}

/// Rectangle in game pixels (y down, 640x480).
fn rect(commands: &mut Commands, x: f64, y: f64, w: f64, h: f64, color: Color) {
    let cx = (x + w / 2.0 - W / 2.0) as f32;
    let cy = (H / 2.0 - (y + h / 2.0)) as f32;
    commands.spawn((
        Sprite::from_color(color, Vec2::new(w as f32, h as f32)),
        Transform::from_xyz(cx, cy, 0.0),
        Drawn,
    ));
}

fn draw(
    mut commands: Commands,
    old: Query<Entity, With<Drawn>>,
    game: NonSend<Game>,
    mut windows: Query<&mut Window>,
) {
    for e in &old {
        commands.entity(e).despawn();
    }
    let b = &game.bird;
    let hill = Color::srgb(0.35, 0.65, 0.4);
    for (i, x) in b.bg.iter().enumerate() {
        rect(
            &mut commands,
            *x,
            400.0,
            W,
            80.0,
            if i == 0 {
                hill
            } else {
                Color::srgb(0.3, 0.6, 0.35)
            },
        );
    }
    if b.playing {
        let pipe = Color::srgb(0.2, 0.55, 0.25);
        let cap = Color::srgb(0.15, 0.4, 0.2);
        for p in &b.pipes {
            rect(&mut commands, p.up_x, p.up_y, PIPE_W, PIPE_H, pipe);
            rect(&mut commands, p.up_x - 4.0, p.up_y, PIPE_W + 8.0, 20.0, cap);
            rect(&mut commands, p.down_x, p.down_y, PIPE_W, PIPE_H, pipe);
            rect(
                &mut commands,
                p.down_x - 4.0,
                p.down_y + PIPE_H - 20.0,
                PIPE_W + 8.0,
                20.0,
                cap,
            );
        }
    }
    // bird: body, wing that follows the sprite frame, beak, eye
    let wing = [-8.0, 0.0, 8.0][(b.sprite % 3) as usize];
    rect(
        &mut commands,
        BIRD_X + 4.0,
        b.y + 12.0,
        BIRD_W - 12.0,
        BIRD_H - 24.0,
        Color::srgb(0.95, 0.8, 0.2),
    );
    rect(
        &mut commands,
        BIRD_X + 12.0,
        b.y + 28.0 + wing,
        24.0,
        12.0,
        Color::srgb(0.85, 0.6, 0.15),
    );
    rect(
        &mut commands,
        BIRD_X + BIRD_W - 10.0,
        b.y + 26.0,
        12.0,
        8.0,
        Color::srgb(0.95, 0.45, 0.1),
    );
    rect(
        &mut commands,
        BIRD_X + 42.0,
        b.y + 18.0,
        8.0,
        8.0,
        Color::WHITE,
    );
    rect(
        &mut commands,
        BIRD_X + 46.0,
        b.y + 20.0,
        4.0,
        4.0,
        Color::BLACK,
    );

    let title = if !b.playing {
        "Canvas Bird - click to start".to_string()
    } else if b.controls {
        format!("Canvas Bird - score {}", b.score)
    } else {
        format!("Canvas Bird - crashed, score {}", b.score)
    };
    if let Some(mut w) = windows.iter_mut().next() {
        if w.title != title {
            w.title = title;
        }
    }
}
```

`games/canvas-bird/ports/bevy/runner/src/main.rs`:

```rs
//! Runner protocol: a case JSON on stdin, {trace, tapeUsed} on stdout.
use bird_core::{Bird, Call, Style, Text, T0};
use serde_json::Value;
use std::cell::Cell;
use std::io::{Read, Write};
use std::rc::Rc;

/// A number printed the way JavaScript prints it (shortest digits; integers without ".0").
fn num(x: f64) -> String {
    if x == 0.0 {
        return "0".into();
    }
    if x.fract() == 0.0 && x.abs() < 1e21 {
        return format!("{}", x as i128);
    }
    serde_json::Number::from_f64(x)
        .map(|n| n.to_string())
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

fn style(s: &Style) -> String {
    match s {
        Style::White => "white".into(),
        Style::Rgba(c, a) => format!("rgba({c},{c},{c},{})", num(*a)),
    }
}

fn call(c: &Call) -> String {
    match c {
        Call::Clear => "c:0:0:640:480".into(),
        Call::Background(x) => format!("i:background:{}:0", num(*x)),
        Call::EnemyUp(x, y) => format!("i:enemy_up:{}:{}", num(*x), num(*y)),
        Call::EnemyDown(x, y) => format!("i:enemy_down:{}:{}", num(*x), num(*y)),
        Call::Player(sx, _, y) => format!("s:player:{}:0:64:64:70:{}:64:64", num(*sx), num(*y)),
        Call::Text {
            stroke,
            text,
            x,
            y,
            style: st,
        } => {
            let t = match text {
                Text::Splash => "Click to start game".to_string(),
                Text::Score(n) => n.to_string(),
            };
            format!(
                "t:{}:{}:{}:{}:{}",
                if *stroke { "stroke" } else { "fill" },
                t,
                num(*x),
                num(*y),
                style(st)
            )
        }
        Call::Point => "a:point".into(),
        Call::Lose => "a:lose".into(),
    }
}

fn frame(calls: &[Call]) -> Value {
    Value::Array(calls.iter().map(|c| Value::String(call(c))).collect())
}

fn main() {
    let mut text = String::new();
    std::io::stdin()
        .read_to_string(&mut text)
        .expect("read stdin");
    let c: Value = serde_json::from_str(&text).expect("case json");
    let tape: Vec<f64> = c["tape"]
        .as_array()
        .expect("tape")
        .iter()
        .map(|v| v.as_f64().unwrap())
        .collect();
    let used = Rc::new(Cell::new(0usize));
    let u = used.clone();
    let rng = move || {
        let i = u.get();
        if i >= tape.len() {
            eprintln!("port asked for more random numbers than the original used");
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
        u.set(i + 1);
        tape[i]
    };
    let mut g = Bird::new(Box::new(rng), T0);
    let inputs = c["inputs"].as_array().expect("inputs");
    let mut trace = Vec::with_capacity(inputs.len() + 1);
    trace.push(frame(&g.load()));
    for i in inputs {
        let dt = i["dt"].as_f64().unwrap_or(0.0);
        let click = matches!(i.get("click"), Some(Value::Bool(true)));
        trace.push(frame(&g.step(dt, click)));
    }
    let mut out = serde_json::Map::new();
    out.insert("trace".into(), Value::Array(trace));
    out.insert("tapeUsed".into(), Value::from(used.get()));
    let mut so = std::io::stdout().lock();
    serde_json::to_writer(&mut so, &Value::Object(out)).unwrap();
    so.flush().unwrap();
}

```

`games/canvas-bird/ports/godot/bird.gd`:

```gd
# Canvas Bird rules in GDScript, written from games/canvas-bird/GAME.md and checked against ports/web/bird.mjs.
# Pure logic: no engine time, no engine randomness unless `live` is set. Every operation runs in the order the
# JavaScript port uses, so the draw lists match string for string.
#   Bird.new(tape, live)    tape: recorded random numbers; live: draw from randf() instead
#   load_frame()            the frame the page draws on load, before any step
#   step(dt, click)         one rendered frame; returns its draw list (PackedStringArray)
extends RefCounted

const T0 := 1000000.0
const W := 640.0
const H := 480.0
const PIPES := 5
const SPACING := 300.0
const GAP := 120.0
const MIN_OFF := -150.0
const MAX_OFF := 50.0
const PIPE_SPEED := 3.0
const PIPE_W := 64.0
const PIPE_H := 316.0
const BIRD_X := 70.0
const BIRD_W := 64.0
const BIRD_H := 64.0
const START_Y := 20.0
const START_V := 2.0
const FORCE := 0.15
const JUMP := -6.0
const MAX_V := 8.0
const FRAME_MS := 1000.0 / 30.0

class Pipe:
	extends RefCounted
	var id := 0
	var up_x := 0.0
	var up_y := 0.0
	var down_x := 0.0
	var down_y := 0.0
	var off := 0.0

var tape: Array = []
var used := 0
var live := false
var overrun := false # the port asked for more tape than recorded (the runner reports it)

var t := T0
var playing := false # a round is on screen (the splash text is hidden)
var controls := false # taps flap and pipes score; false once the bird has hit something
var score := 0
var alpha := 1.0
var rising := false
var stroke_style := "#000000"
var bg0 := 0.0
var bg1 := W
var by := START_Y
var bv := START_V
var sprite := 0
var sprite_clock := 0.0
var fall_clock := 0.0 # set once and never moved: this is why the 30 fps gate stops mattering
var pipes: Array = []
var next := 0
var last := PIPES - 1
var out := PackedStringArray()

func _init(p_tape: Array, p_live: bool) -> void:
	tape = p_tape
	live = p_live
	sprite_clock = floorf(t)
	fall_clock = floorf(t)

# ---- numbers as JavaScript prints them ---------------------------------------------------------------

# does the fixed-point text s read back as the double a? m / 10^k is correctly rounded when m and 10^k are
# exact; above 2^53 the distance of m from a * p is worked out in double-double
static func reads_as(s: String, a: float) -> bool:
	var dot := s.find(".")
	var k := s.length() - dot - 1
	var sig := (s.substr(0, dot) + s.substr(dot + 1)).lstrip("0")
	if sig.length() == 0:
		return a == 0.0
	if sig.length() >= 17 or k > 22:
		return true # 17 significant digits of the exact value always read back as it
	var p := 1.0
	for i in k:
		p *= 10.0
	var m := int(sig)
	if m <= 9007199254740992 or m % 2 == 0:
		return float(m) / p == a
	# m above 2^53: a * p to double-double (Dekker), then m - a * p against half a gap of doubles around a
	var c1 := 134217729.0 * a
	var ah := c1 - (c1 - a)
	var al := a - ah
	var c2 := 134217729.0 * p
	var ph := c2 - (c2 - p)
	var pl := p - ph
	var prod := a * p
	var err := ((ah * ph - prod) + ah * pl + al * ph) + al * pl
	var resid := float(m - int(prod)) - err
	var e := int(floorf(log(a) / log(2.0)))
	while pow(2.0, e) > a:
		e -= 1
	while pow(2.0, e + 1) <= a:
		e += 1
	var ulp := pow(2.0, e - 52)
	if resid < 0.0 and pow(2.0, e) == a:
		ulp *= 0.5 # below a power of two the doubles are twice as close
	var half := ulp * 0.5
	return absf(resid) < half * p

# the shortest decimal that reads back as v: a fixed-point string, or JS's exponent form for tiny values
static func num(v: float) -> String:
	if v == floorf(v) and absf(v) < 1e15:
		return str(int(v))
	var neg := v < 0.0
	var a := absf(v)
	var res := ""
	if a >= 1e-6:
		for k in range(1, 25):
			var s := String.num(a, k)
			if reads_as(s, a):
				res = s
				break
		if res == "":
			res = String.num(a, 24)
		if res.contains("."):
			res = res.rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
	else:
		res = _sci(a)
	return "-" + res if neg else res

static func _sci(a: float) -> String:
	var s := String.num(a, 80)
	var digits := s.substr(s.find(".") + 1)
	var z := 0
	while z < digits.length() and digits[z] == "0":
		z += 1
	var e10 := -(z + 1)
	var sig := digits.substr(z)
	for p in range(1, 18):
		var d := sig.substr(0, p)
		if sig.length() > p and sig[p] >= "5":
			d = str(int(d) + 1).pad_zeros(p)
		var e := e10
		if d.length() > p: # 9.99 rounded up to 10.0
			d = d.substr(0, p)
			e += 1
		var m := d.substr(0, 1) + ("." + d.substr(1) if d.length() > 1 else "")
		var cand := "%se%d" % [m, e]
		if cand.to_float() == a or p == 17:
			return cand
	return sig

# ---- random --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

func rand_int(lo: float, hi: float) -> float:
	var r := 0.0
	if live:
		r = randf()
	elif used < tape.size():
		r = tape[used]
	else:
		overrun = true
	used += 1
	return floorf(r * (hi - lo + 1.0) + lo)

# ---- rules, in the order of bird.mjs -------------------------------------------------------------------

func make_pipe(i: int, off: float) -> Pipe:
	var p := Pipe.new()
	p.id = i
	p.up_x = W + i * SPACING
	p.up_y = H / 2.0 + GAP + off
	p.down_x = p.up_x
	p.down_y = 0.0 - GAP + off
	p.off = off
	return p

func setup_pipes() -> void:
	next = 0
	last = PIPES - 1
	pipes = []
	for i in PIPES:
		pipes.append(make_pipe(i, rand_int(MIN_OFF, MAX_OFF)))

func score_check(p: Pipe, x: float) -> void:
	if p.id == next and x + PIPE_W < BIRD_X + BIRD_W:
		next = 0 if next == PIPES - 1 else next + 1
		if controls:
			score += 1
			out.append("a:point")

func move_up(p: Pipe) -> void:
	p.up_x -= PIPE_SPEED
	if p.up_x <= -PIPE_W:
		var nx: float = (pipes[last] as Pipe).up_x + SPACING
		p.up_x = nx
		p.down_x = nx
		p.off = rand_int(MIN_OFF, MAX_OFF) # drawn y is not recomputed from it (see GAME.md)
		last = 0 if last == PIPES - 1 else last + 1
	score_check(p, p.up_x)

func move_down(p: Pipe) -> void:
	p.down_x -= PIPE_SPEED
	score_check(p, p.down_x)

func collided() -> bool:
	var right := BIRD_X + BIRD_W
	var top := by
	var bottom := by + BIRD_H
	var p: Pipe = pipes[next]
	var px := p.down_x + 40.0
	var gap_top := p.down_y + PIPE_H
	var gap_bottom := p.up_y
	var hit := false
	if right > px and right < px + PIPE_W - 40.0:
		if top < gap_top or bottom > gap_bottom:
			hit = true
	if bottom < 0.0 or top > H:
		hit = true
	if hit and controls:
		out.append("a:lose")
	return hit

func sprite_frame() -> int:
	var n := floorf(t)
	if n - sprite_clock > FRAME_MS:
		sprite_clock = n
		sprite += 1
		if sprite > 2:
			sprite = 0
	return sprite

func draw() -> PackedStringArray:
	out = PackedStringArray()
	out.append("c:0:0:640:480")
	out.append("i:background:%s:0" % num(bg0))
	out.append("i:background:%s:0" % num(bg1))
	bg0 -= 1.0
	if bg0 <= -W:
		bg0 = W
	bg1 -= 1.0
	if bg1 <= -W:
		bg1 = W
	if not playing:
		var a := num(alpha)
		stroke_style = "rgba(0,0,0,%s)" % a
		out.append("t:stroke:Click to start game:90:80:" + stroke_style)
		out.append("t:fill:Click to start game:90:80:rgba(255,255,255,%s)" % a)
		if alpha < 0.0:
			rising = true
		if alpha > 1.0:
			rising = false
		alpha += 0.02 if rising else -0.02
	else:
		for o in pipes:
			var p: Pipe = o
			out.append("i:enemy_up:%s:%s" % [num(p.up_x), num(p.up_y)])
			out.append("i:enemy_down:%s:%s" % [num(p.down_x), num(p.down_y)])
			move_up(p)
			move_down(p)
		var sx := sprite_frame() * 64
		out.append("s:player:%d:0:64:64:70:%s:64:64" % [sx, num(by)])
		if floorf(t) - fall_clock > FRAME_MS:
			if bv < MAX_V:
				bv += FORCE
			by += bv
		if collided():
			controls = false
			if by - BIRD_H > H:
				playing = false
		out.append("t:stroke:%d:309:51:%s" % [score, stroke_style])
		out.append("t:fill:%d:310:50:white" % score)
	return out

func do_click() -> void:
	if controls:
		bv = JUMP
	if not playing:
		score = 0
		bv = START_V
		by = START_Y
		setup_pipes()
		playing = true
		controls = true

func load_frame() -> PackedStringArray:
	return draw()

func step(dt: float, clicked: bool) -> PackedStringArray:
	if clicked:
		do_click()
	t += dt
	return draw()

```

`games/canvas-bird/ports/godot/main.gd`:

```gd
# Playable Canvas Bird in Godot: click, tap or press Space to flap; the first click starts a round, and after a
# loss a click restarts. The rules are bird.gd, the file the check runs; the art is drawn here from shapes.
extends Control

const Bird := preload("res://bird.gd")
const STEP_MS := 1000.0 / 60.0

var game
var acc := 0.0
var clicked := false
var clock := 0.0 # animation clock (ms), only for drawing

func _ready() -> void:
	randomize()
	game = Bird.new([], true)
	game.load_frame()
	queue_redraw()

func _unhandled_input(e: InputEvent) -> void:
	if e is InputEventMouseButton and e.pressed and e.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		clicked = true
	elif e is InputEventScreenTouch and e.pressed:
		clicked = true
	elif e is InputEventKey and e.pressed and not e.echo and e.keycode == KEY_SPACE:
		clicked = true

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	acc += delta * 1000.0
	while acc >= STEP_MS:
		acc -= STEP_MS
		advance()
	queue_redraw()

# one rules frame of 1000/60 ms with the click gathered since the last one
func advance() -> void:
	game.step(STEP_MS, clicked)
	clicked = false
	clock += STEP_MS

func _draw() -> void:
	var s := minf(size.x / Bird.W, size.y / Bird.H)
	var origin := Vector2((size.x - Bird.W * s) / 2.0, (size.y - Bird.H * s) / 2.0)
	draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), Color("1b2a3a"))
	draw_set_transform(origin, 0.0, Vector2(s, s))
	draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, Bird.W, Bird.H), Color("7ec8e8"))
	for bx in [game.bg0, game.bg1]:
		_scenery(bx)
	for o in game.pipes:
		_pipe(o)
	_bird()
	var f := ThemeDB.fallback_font
	if game.playing:
		draw_string(f, Vector2(0, 50), str(game.score), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, Bird.W, 36, Color.WHITE)
	else:
		var a := clampf(game.alpha, 0.0, 1.0)
		draw_string(f, Vector2(0, 240), "Click to start game", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, Bird.W, 36, Color(1, 1, 1, a))

func _scenery(bx: float) -> void:
	draw_rect(Rect2(bx, 420, Bird.W, 60), Color("6aa84f"))
	draw_rect(Rect2(bx, 410, Bird.W, 10), Color("93c47d"))
	for i in 4:
		var cx := bx + 60.0 + i * 160.0
		var cy := 80.0 + (i % 2) * 50.0
		draw_circle(Vector2(cx, cy), 22, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8))
		draw_circle(Vector2(cx + 24, cy + 6), 18, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8))
		draw_circle(Vector2(cx - 22, cy + 8), 16, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8))

func _pipe(o) -> void:
	var green := Color("3f9b3f")
	var dark := Color("2c6e2c")
	# the up pipe hangs from its y to the bottom, the down pipe ends at y + 316
	draw_rect(Rect2(o.up_x + 4, o.up_y, 56, Bird.PIPE_H), green)
	draw_rect(Rect2(o.up_x, o.up_y, 64, 22), dark)
	draw_rect(Rect2(o.down_x + 4, o.down_y, 56, Bird.PIPE_H), green)
	draw_rect(Rect2(o.down_x, o.down_y + Bird.PIPE_H - 22, 64, 22), dark)

func _bird() -> void:
	var c := Vector2(Bird.BIRD_X + 32.0, game.by + 32.0)
	var tilt := clampf(game.bv * 0.06, -0.5, 0.8)
	var body := Color("f2c230") if game.controls or not game.playing else Color("d96a4a")
	draw_circle(c, 26, body)
	var wing_up: bool = game.sprite == 1
	var wy := -12.0 if wing_up else (12.0 if game.sprite == 2 else 0.0)
	draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([c + Vector2(-20, 0), c + Vector2(-2, wy), c + Vector2(-2, 8)]), Color("c9962a"))
	draw_circle(c + Vector2(12, -8 + tilt * 6.0), 7, Color.WHITE)
	draw_circle(c + Vector2(14, -8 + tilt * 6.0), 3, Color.BLACK)
	draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([c + Vector2(22, -2), c + Vector2(36, 4), c + Vector2(22, 10)]), Color("e8742c"))
```

`games/canvas-bird/ports/godot/runner.gd`:

```gd
# Runner protocol: a case on stdin, {trace, tapeUsed} on stdout.
# godot --headless --quiet --path ports/godot --script runner.gd < case.json
# Godot's JSON parser and printer do not round-trip doubles (the parsed tape was off by one ulp, and
# stringify writes 14 digits), so the numbers are read and written here, exactly.
extends SceneTree

const Bird := preload("res://bird.gd")

# a decimal as the double JavaScript would read: m / 10^k is correctly rounded when both are exact
func parse_num(s: String) -> float:
	var t := s.strip_edges()
	if t.contains("e") or t.contains("E"):
		return t.to_float()
	var neg := t.begins_with("-")
	if neg:
		t = t.substr(1)
	var dot := t.find(".")
	var k := 0
	var digits := t
	if dot >= 0:
		k = t.length() - dot - 1
		digits = t.substr(0, dot) + t.substr(dot + 1)
	var sig := digits.lstrip("0")
	var v: float
	if sig.length() <= 18 and sig.length() > 0:
		var m := int(sig)
		if m <= 9007199254740992 and k <= 18:
			var p := 1
			for i in k:
				p *= 10
			v = float(m) / float(p)
		else:
			v = snap_lattice(t.to_float())
	else:
		v = t.to_float() if sig.length() == 0 else snap_lattice(t.to_float())
	return -v if neg else v

# the tape comes from mulberry32: multiples of 2^-32, so the closest one is the exact value
func snap_lattice(approx: float) -> float:
	var x := floorf(approx * 4294967296.0 + 0.5) / 4294967296.0
	return x if absf(x - approx) < 1e-12 else approx

func section(text: String, key: String, stop: String) -> String:
	var a := text.find(key)
	if a < 0:
		return ""
	a += key.length()
	var b := text.find(stop, a)
	return text.substr(a, (b if b >= 0 else text.length()) - a)

func _init() -> void:
	var text := OS.read_string_from_stdin(1 << 27)
	var tape_s := section(text, "\"tape\":[", "]")
	var inputs_s := section(text, "\"inputs\":[", "],\"trace\"")
	if text.find("\"inputs\":[") < 0:
		printerr("runner: no case on stdin")
		quit(1) # a script error would leave the engine running forever
		return
	var tape: Array = []
	if tape_s != "":
		for p in tape_s.split(","):
			tape.append(parse_num(p))
	var dts: Array = []
	var clicks: Array = []
	if inputs_s != "":
		for obj in inputs_s.trim_prefix("{").trim_suffix("}").split("},{"):
			var dt := 0.0
			var c := false
			for kv in obj.split(","):
				var i := kv.find(":")
				var key := kv.substr(0, i).strip_edges().trim_prefix("\"").trim_suffix("\"")
				var val := kv.substr(i + 1).strip_edges()
				if key == "dt":
					dt = parse_num(val)
				elif key == "click":
					c = val == "true"
			dts.append(dt)
			clicks.append(c)
	var g = Bird.new(tape, false)
	var out := PackedStringArray()
	out.append("{\"trace\":[")
	out.append(frame(g.load_frame()))
	for i in dts.size():
		var f: PackedStringArray = g.step(dts[i], clicks[i])
		out.append(",")
		out.append(frame(f))
		if g.overrun:
			printerr("runner: the port asked for more random numbers than the original used")
			quit(1)
			return
	out.append("],\"tapeUsed\":%d}" % g.used)
	print("".join(out))
	quit()

# one frame's draw list as a JSON array of strings (none contains a quote or a backslash)
func frame(f: PackedStringArray) -> String:
	return "[\"" + "\",\"".join(f) + "\"]"

```

```gd
# Smoke test of the playable scene, not part of the check: godot --headless --path ports/godot --script smoke.gd
# Loads main.tscn, feeds clicks and prints the game state. It proves the scene runs and reacts to input,

extends SceneTree

func click() -> InputEventMouseButton:

func _init() -> void:

	print("after flap v=", g.bv)

	main.advance()
	print("after restart playing=", g.playing, " y=", g.by, " score=", g.score)
	main.queue_redraw()

	await process_frame

	quit()
```

`games/canvas-bird/ports/web/bird.mjs`:

```mjs
// Canvas Bird, rebuilt from games/canvas-bird/GAME.md. Pure logic: no DOM, no clock, no Math.random.
// createBird({ rng }) takes a random source and returns a game that advances one rendered frame per
// step({ dt, click }) and returns that frame's draw list (the strings described in driver.mjs).
// The clock is a number the game advances itself by dt, so a replay is exact.
export const T0 = 1000000;

const W = 640, H = 480;
const PIPES = 5, SPACING = 300, GAP = 120, MIN_OFF = -150, MAX_OFF = 50, PIPE_SPEED = 3;
const PIPE_W = 64, PIPE_H = 316;
const BIRD = { x: 70, w: 64, h: 64, startY: 20, startV: 2, force: 0.15, jump: -6, maxV: 8 };
const FRAME_MS = 1000 / 30;

export function createBird({ rng, start = T0 }) {
  let t = start;
  const now = () => Math.floor(t);
  const randInt = (lo, hi) => Math.floor(rng() * (hi - lo + 1) + lo);

  let playing = false; // a round is on screen (splash text is hidden)
  let controls = false; // taps flap and pipes score; false once the bird has hit something
  let score = 0;
  let alpha = 1, rising = false;
  let strokeStyle = "#000000", fillStyle = "#000000";
  const bg = [{ x: 0 }, { x: W }];
  const bird = { y: BIRD.startY, v: BIRD.startV, sprite: 0 };
  let spriteClock = now(); // when the sprite frame last changed
  const fallClock = now(); // set once and never moved: this is why the 30 fps gate stops mattering
  let pipes = [];
  let next = 0, last = PIPES - 1;
  let out = [];

  const addPipe = (i, off) => ({
    id: i,
    up: { x: W + i * SPACING, y: H / 2 + GAP + off },
    down: { x: W + i * SPACING, y: 0 - GAP + off },
    off,
  });
  function setupPipes() {
    next = 0; last = PIPES - 1; pipes = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < PIPES; i++) pipes.push(addPipe(i, randInt(MIN_OFF, MAX_OFF)));
  }

  function scoreCheck(p, x) {
    if (p.id === next && x + PIPE_W < BIRD.x + BIRD.w) {
      next = next === PIPES - 1 ? 0 : next + 1;
      if (controls) { score++; out.push("a:point"); }
    }
  }
  function moveUp(p) {
    p.up.x -= PIPE_SPEED;
    if (p.up.x <= -PIPE_W) {
      p.up.x = p.down.x = pipes[last].up.x + SPACING;
      p.off = randInt(MIN_OFF, MAX_OFF); // drawn y is NOT recomputed from it (see GAME.md)
      last = last === PIPES - 1 ? 0 : last + 1;
    }
    scoreCheck(p, p.up.x);
  }
  function moveDown(p) {
    p.down.x -= PIPE_SPEED;
    scoreCheck(p, p.down.x);
  }

  function collided() {
    const right = BIRD.x + BIRD.w, top = bird.y, bottom = bird.y + BIRD.h;
    const p = pipes[next];
    const px = p.down.x + 40, gapTop = p.down.y + PIPE_H, gapBottom = p.up.y;
    let hit = false;
    if (right > px && right < px + PIPE_W - 40) {
      if (top < gapTop || bottom > gapBottom) hit = true;
    }
    if (bottom < 0 || top > H) hit = true;
    if (hit && controls) out.push("a:lose");
    return hit;
  }

  function spriteFrame() {
    const n = now();
    if (n - spriteClock > FRAME_MS) {
      spriteClock = n;
      bird.sprite++;
      if (bird.sprite > 2) bird.sprite = 0;
    }
    return bird.sprite;
  }

  function draw() {
    out = [];
    out.push(`c:0:0:${W}:${H}`);
    for (const b of bg) out.push(`i:background:${b.x}:0`);
    for (const b of bg) { b.x -= 1; if (b.x <= -W) b.x = W; }
    if (!playing) {
      strokeStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${alpha})`;
      out.push(`t:stroke:Click to start game:${W / 2 - 230}:80:${strokeStyle}`);
      fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`;
      out.push(`t:fill:Click to start game:${W / 2 - 230}:80:${fillStyle}`);
      if (alpha < 0) rising = true;
      if (alpha > 1) rising = false;
      alpha += rising ? 0.02 : -0.02;
    } else {
      for (const p of pipes) {
        out.push(`i:enemy_up:${p.up.x}:${p.up.y}`);
        out.push(`i:enemy_down:${p.down.x}:${p.down.y}`);
        moveUp(p);
        moveDown(p);
      }
      const sx = spriteFrame() * BIRD.w;
      out.push(`s:player:${sx}:0:${BIRD.w}:${BIRD.h}:${BIRD.x}:${bird.y}:${BIRD.w}:${BIRD.h}`);
      if (now() - fallClock > FRAME_MS) {
        if (bird.v < BIRD.maxV) bird.v += BIRD.force;
        bird.y += bird.v;
      }
      if (collided()) {
        controls = false;
        if (bird.y - BIRD.h > H) playing = false;
      }
      fillStyle = "black";
      out.push(`t:stroke:${score}:${W / 2 - 11}:51:${strokeStyle}`);
      fillStyle = "white";
      out.push(`t:fill:${score}:${W / 2 - 10}:50:${fillStyle}`);
    }
    return out;
  }

  function click() {
    if (controls) bird.v = BIRD.jump;
    if (!playing) {
      score = 0; bird.v = BIRD.startV; bird.y = BIRD.startY;
      setupPipes();
      playing = true;
      controls = true;
    }
  }

  return {
    // the frame the page draws when it loads, before any step
    load: () => draw(),
    step({ dt, click: clicked = false }) {
      if (clicked) click();
      t += dt;
      return draw();
    },
    // what a renderer with its own art needs
    view: () => ({ playing, controls, score, alpha, bird: { x: BIRD.x, y: bird.y, v: bird.v, sprite: bird.sprite }, pipes, next, bg }),
  };
}

```

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">

<div id="wrap"><canvas id="c" width="1280" height="960" aria-label="Canvas Bird game"></canvas></div>
<p><b>Tap</b>, click or press <b>Space</b> to flap. Pass the pipes. Best: <b id="best">0</b></p>
<script type="module">
import { createBird } from "./bird.mjs";

const W = 640, H = 480;
const cv = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
const bestEl = document.getElementById("best");
let best = 0;
try { best = +localStorage.getItem("canvas-bird-best") || 0; } catch {}
bestEl.textContent = best;

// DEMO HOOK (scripts/demo-canvas-bird.mjs): when window.__tape is set, the game draws its random numbers from
// that recorded tape and window.__rea.step(dt) advances one recorded frame (the page's own loop then idles).
// Without it nothing here changes.
const TAPE = Array.isArray(window.__tape) ? window.__tape : null;
let tapeUsed = 0;
const rng = TAPE ? () => { if (tapeUsed >= TAPE.length) throw new Error("tape used up"); return TAPE[tapeUsed++]; } : Math.random;
const game = createBird({ rng, ...(TAPE ? { start: 1000000 } : {}) });
let clickPending = false;
let lastScore = 0, wasPlaying = false, over = false;

// ---- sound: tiny beeps, only after the first tap (browsers need a gesture)
let ac = null;
function beep(freq, len, type = "square", gain = 0.05) {
  try {
    ac = ac || new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const o = ac.createOscillator(), g = ac.createGain();
    o.type = type; o.frequency.value = freq; g.gain.value = gain;
    o.connect(g); g.connect(ac.destination);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, ac.currentTime + len);
    o.start(); o.stop(ac.currentTime + len);
  } catch {}
}

// ---- input
function tap(e) { if (e) e.preventDefault(); clickPending = true; }
cv.addEventListener("pointerdown", tap);
addEventListener("keydown", (e) => { if (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "ArrowUp" || e.code === "Enter") { if (!e.repeat) tap(e); } });

// ---- own art, all drawn here
const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
sky.addColorStop(0, "#4fb3ff"); sky.addColorStop(0.7, "#bfe7ff"); sky.addColorStop(1, "#ffe9b8");
const clouds = [[60, 90, 1], [260, 150, 0.8], [470, 70, 1.2], [610, 190, 0.7], [140, 260, 0.6]];
function cloud(x, y, s) {
  for (const [dx, dy, rx, ry] of [[0, 0, 36, 16], [26, -10, 26, 18], [-24, -6, 22, 14]]) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x + dx * s, y + dy * s, rx * s, ry * s, 0, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
  }
}
function drawBackground(v) {
  ctx.fillStyle = sky; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  const off = v.bg[0].x; // scrolls 1 px a frame, like the original
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,.85)";
  for (const k of [0, 1]) for (const [x, y, s] of clouds) cloud(((x + off * (0.4 + 0.5 * s) + k * W + W * 2) % (W * 1.2)) - 60, y, s);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#7ccf79";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, H);
  for (let x = 0; x <= W; x += 20) ctx.lineTo(x, H - 26 - 10 * Math.sin((x - off * 2) / 55));
  ctx.lineTo(W, H); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#5bb461"; ctx.fillRect(0, H - 14, W, 14);
}
function pipeBody(x, y, h, capAtBottom) {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, 0, x + 64, 0);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#2f9e44"); g.addColorStop(0.35, "#69db7c"); g.addColorStop(1, "#2b8a3e");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(x + 5, y, 54, h);
  const cy = capAtBottom ? y + h - 26 : y;
  ctx.fillRect(x, cy, 64, 26);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#1b5e2b"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeRect(x + 5, y, 54, h); ctx.strokeRect(x, cy, 64, 26);
}
function drawPipes(v) {
  for (const p of v.pipes) { pipeBody(p.down.x, p.down.y, 316, true); pipeBody(p.up.x, p.up.y, 316, false); }
}
function drawBird(v) {
  const b = v.bird;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(b.x + 32, b.y + 32);
  ctx.rotate(Math.max(-0.5, Math.min(1.1, b.v / 9)));
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffd43b"; ctx.strokeStyle = "#e67700"; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 28, 24, 0, 0, 7); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
  const wing = [-6, 0, 8][b.sprite];
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fcc419";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(-8, 4 + wing * 0.5, 14, 8, -0.3 + wing * 0.04, 0, 7); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fff"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(14, -8, 8, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#212529"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(16, -8, 3.5, 0, 7); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ff6b35"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(22, -1); ctx.lineTo(38, 4); ctx.lineTo(22, 10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}
function label(text, x, y, size, alpha = 1) {
  ctx.font = `800 ${size}px system-ui, sans-serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = "center";
  ctx.lineWidth = size / 6; ctx.lineJoin = "round";
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(20,30,50,${alpha})`; ctx.strokeText(text, x, y);
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${alpha})`; ctx.fillText(text, x, y);
}
function render() {
  const v = game.view();
  ctx.setTransform(cv.width / W, 0, 0, cv.height / H, 0, 0);
  drawBackground(v);
  if (!v.playing) {
    if (over) { label("Game over", W / 2, 150, 54); label(`Score ${lastScore}   Best ${best}`, W / 2, 205, 26); }
    label("Tap to " + (over ? "play again" : "start"), W / 2, over ? 290 : 120, 38, Math.max(0.25, Math.min(1, v.alpha)));
    drawBird({ bird: { x: 70, y: 200 + Math.sin(performance.now() / 280) * 8, v: 0, sprite: (performance.now() / 120 | 0) % 3 } });
  } else {
    drawPipes(v); drawBird(v);
    label(String(v.score), W / 2, 62, 52);
  }
}

// ---- loop: the original's physics is per rendered frame (tuned at 60 fps), so run it on a fixed 60 Hz step
const STEP = 1000 / 60;
let acc = 0, prev = performance.now();
function advance(dt) {
  const out = game.step({ dt, click: clickPending });
  if (clickPending && ac === null) beep(1, 0.01, "sine", 0.0001);
  if (clickPending) beep(520, 0.06);
  clickPending = false;
  if (out.includes("a:point")) beep(880, 0.12, "triangle", 0.08);
  if (out.includes("a:lose")) beep(160, 0.35, "sawtooth", 0.08);
  const v = game.view();
  if (v.playing) { lastScore = v.score; wasPlaying = true; }
  else if (wasPlaying) {
    wasPlaying = false; over = true;
    if (lastScore > best) { best = lastScore; bestEl.textContent = best; try { localStorage.setItem("canvas-bird-best", best); } catch {} }
  }
  return out;
}
function frame(now) {
  acc += Math.min(100, now - prev); prev = now;
  if (!TAPE) while (acc >= STEP) { acc -= STEP; advance(STEP); }
  render();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
if (TAPE) game.load(); // the original draws one frame when it loads, before any step
if (TAPE) window.__rea = { step(dt) { const out = advance(dt); render(); return out; }, tapeUsed: () => tapeUsed };
requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

`games/canvas-bird/ports/web/run.mjs`:

```mjs
// Replays one recorded case: reads it from stdin, prints { trace, tapeUsed } on stdout.
import fs from "node:fs";
import { createBird } from "./bird.mjs";

const c = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0, "utf8"));
let used = 0;
const rng = () => {
  if (used >= c.tape.length) throw new Error(`asked for random number ${used + 1}, the recording has ${c.tape.length}`);
  return c.tape[used++];
};
const g = createBird({ rng });
const trace = [g.load()];
for (const i of c.inputs) trace.push(g.step(i));
process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ trace, tapeUsed: used }));
```
