`games/dino/ports/godot/dino.gd`:

```gd
# Chrome Dino rules in GDScript, written from games/dino/GAME.md and checked against ports/web/dino.mjs.
# Pure logic: no engine time, no engine randomness unless `live` is set. Every number is a float and
# every operation runs in the order the JavaScript port uses, so the trace matches bit for bit.
#   Dino.new(tape, clock0, live)   tape: recorded gameplay randoms; live: draw from randf() instead
#   step(dt, flags)                one browser frame, flags are the F_* bits below
extends RefCounted

const WIDTH := 600.0
const HEIGHT := 150.0
const FPS := 60.0

const F_JUMP := 1
const F_DUCK := 2
const F_JUMP_UP := 4
const F_DUCK_UP := 8
const F_ENTER := 16
const F_ANIM_END := 32

const ACCELERATION := 0.001
const BOTTOM_PAD := 10.0
const CLEAR_TIME := 3000.0
const GAMEOVER_CLEAR_TIME := 750.0
const GAP_COEFFICIENT := 0.6
const MAX_OBSTACLE_DUPLICATION := 2
const MAX_SPEED := 13.0
const SPEED := 6.0

const T_DROP_VELOCITY := -5.0
const T_GRAVITY := 0.6
const T_HEIGHT := 47.0
const T_INITIAL_JUMP_VELOCITY := -10.0
const T_INTRO_DURATION := 1500.0
const T_MAX_JUMP_HEIGHT := 30.0
const T_MIN_JUMP_HEIGHT := 30.0
const T_SPEED_DROP_COEFFICIENT := 3.0
const T_START_X_POS := 50.0
const T_WIDTH := 44.0

const MAX_GAP_COEFFICIENT := 1.5
const MAX_OBSTACLE_LENGTH := 3

# boxes are [x, y, width, height]
const TREX_BOXES_DUCKING := [[1.0, 18.0, 55.0, 25.0]]
const TREX_BOXES_RUNNING := [[22.0, 0.0, 17.0, 16.0], [1.0, 18.0, 30.0, 9.0], [10.0, 35.0, 14.0, 8.0],
	[1.0, 24.0, 29.0, 5.0], [5.0, 30.0, 21.0, 4.0], [9.0, 34.0, 15.0, 4.0]]
const OBSTACLE_TYPES := [
	{"type": "CACTUS_SMALL", "width": 17.0, "height": 35.0, "yPos": [105.0], "multipleSpeed": 4.0, "minGap": 120.0,
		"minSpeed": 0.0, "speedOffset": 0.0, "boxes": [[0.0, 7.0, 5.0, 27.0], [4.0, 0.0, 6.0, 34.0], [10.0, 4.0, 7.0, 14.0]]},
	{"type": "CACTUS_LARGE", "width": 25.0, "height": 50.0, "yPos": [90.0], "multipleSpeed": 7.0, "minGap": 120.0,
		"minSpeed": 0.0, "speedOffset": 0.0, "boxes": [[0.0, 12.0, 7.0, 38.0], [8.0, 0.0, 7.0, 49.0], [13.0, 10.0, 10.0, 38.0]]},
	{"type": "PTERODACTYL", "width": 46.0, "height": 40.0, "yPos": [100.0, 75.0, 50.0], "multipleSpeed": 999.0, "minGap": 150.0,
		"minSpeed": 8.5, "speedOffset": 0.8,
		"boxes": [[15.0, 15.0, 16.0, 5.0], [18.0, 21.0, 24.0, 6.0], [2.0, 14.0, 4.0, 3.0], [6.0, 10.0, 4.0, 7.0], [10.0, 8.0, 6.0, 9.0]]},
]

# ---- state --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
var tape: Array = []
var used := 0
var live := false
var overrun := false # the port asked for more tape than recorded (the runner reports it)

var now := 0.0
var obstacles: Array = [] # of Obstacle
var obstacle_history: Array = []
var distance_ran := 0.0
var highest_score := 0.0
var time := 0.0
var running_time := 0.0
var ms_per_frame := 1000.0 / FPS
var current_speed := SPEED
var activated := false
var playing := false
var crashed := false
var paused := false
var playing_intro := false
var play_count := 0.0
var intro_listener := false

# requestAnimationFrame bookkeeping: pending callbacks [id, cancelled], the frame being run, last id
var queue: Array = []
var running_q = null
var next_id := 1
var raq_id := 0
var update_pending := false

# dino
var t_x := 0.0
var t_ground := HEIGHT - T_HEIGHT - BOTTOM_PAD
var t_y := 0.0
var t_min_jump := 0.0
var t_status := "WAITING"
var t_jumping := false
var t_ducking := false
var t_jump_velocity := 0.0
var t_reached_min := false
var t_speed_drop := false
var t_jump_count := 0.0
var t_playing_intro := false

class Obstacle:
	var type_cfg: Dictionary
	var size := 1.0
	var remove := false
	var x := 0.0
	var y := 0.0
	var width := 0.0
	var gap := 0.0
	var speed_offset := 0.0
	var followed := false
	var boxes: Array = []

	func is_visible() -> bool:
		return x + width > 0.0

	func update(delta_time: float, speed: float) -> void:
		if not remove:
			if type_cfg["speedOffset"] != 0.0:
				speed += speed_offset
			x -= floorf((speed * 60.0 / 1000.0) * delta_time)
			if not is_visible():
				remove = true

func _init(p_tape: Array = [], clock0 := 1000.0, p_live := false) -> void:
	tape = p_tape
	live = p_live
	now = clock0
	t_y = t_ground
	t_min_jump = t_ground - T_MIN_JUMP_HEIGHT
	# Runner.init ends with one update(): it starts the waiting-for-input loop
	update()

# JavaScript's Math.round: halves go up (GDScript's round() sends them away from zero)
static func js_round(v: float) -> float:
	var f := floorf(v)
	return f + 1.0 if v - f >= 0.5 else f

func rng() -> float:
	if live:
		return randf()
	if used >= tape.size():
		overrun = true
		return 0.0
	var v: float = tape[used]
	used += 1
	return v

func random_num(lo: float, hi: float) -> float:
	return floorf(rng() * (hi - lo + 1.0)) + lo

# ---- requestAnimationFrame ----------------------------------------------------------------
func request_frame() -> int:
	var id := next_id
	next_id += 1
	queue.append([id, false])
	return id

func cancel_frame(id: int) -> void:
	var kept := []
	for q in queue:
		if q[0] != id:
			kept.append(q)
	queue = kept
	if running_q != null:
		for q in running_q:
			if q[0] == id:
				q[1] = true

func schedule_next_update() -> void:
	if not update_pending:
		update_pending = true
		raq_id = request_frame()

# ---- one frame ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
func step(dt: float, flags: int) -> void:
	now = now + dt
	if flags & F_JUMP: key_down("jump")
	if flags & F_DUCK: key_down("duck")
	if flags & F_JUMP_UP: key_up("jump")
	if flags & F_DUCK_UP: key_up("duck")
	if flags & F_ENTER: key_up("enter")
	if (flags & F_ANIM_END) and intro_listener:
		start_game()
	running_q = queue
	queue = []
	for q in running_q:
		if not q[1]:
			update()
	running_q = null

# ---- Runner -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
func update() -> void:
	update_pending = false
	var n := now
	var delta_time := n - (time if time != 0.0 else n)
	time = n

	if playing:
		if t_jumping:
			trex_update_jump(delta_time)
		running_time += delta_time
		var has_obstacles := running_time > CLEAR_TIME

		# the first landing starts the intro
		if t_jump_count == 1.0 and not playing_intro:
			play_intro()

		# the horizon does not move until the intro is over
		if playing_intro:
			update_obstacles_if(0.0, current_speed, has_obstacles)
		else:
			delta_time = delta_time if activated else 0.0
			update_obstacles_if(delta_time, current_speed, has_obstacles)

		var collision := has_obstacles and check_for_collision()
		if not collision:
			distance_ran += current_speed * delta_time / ms_per_frame
			if current_speed < MAX_SPEED:
				current_speed += ACCELERATION
		else:
			game_over()

	if playing or not activated:
		trex_update(delta_time)
		schedule_next_update()

func play_intro() -> void:
	if not activated and not crashed:
		playing_intro = true
		t_playing_intro = true
		intro_listener = true
		playing = true
		activated = true
	elif crashed:
		restart()

func start_game() -> void:
	running_time = 0.0
	playing_intro = false
	t_playing_intro = false
	play_count += 1.0

func game_over() -> void:
	stop()
	crashed = true
	trex_update(100.0, "CRASHED")
	if distance_ran > highest_score:
		highest_score = ceilf(distance_ran)
	time = now

func stop() -> void:
	playing = false
	paused = true
	cancel_frame(raq_id)
	raq_id = 0

func play() -> void:
	if not crashed:
		playing = true
		paused = false
		trex_update(0.0, "RUNNING")
		time = now
		update()

func restart() -> void:
	if raq_id == 0:
		play_count += 1.0
		running_time = 0.0
		playing = true
		crashed = false
		distance_ran = 0.0
		current_speed = SPEED
		time = now
		obstacles = [] # Horizon.reset (obstacle_history is kept)
		trex_reset()
		update()

func is_running() -> bool:
	return raq_id != 0

# ---- keys ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
func key_down(which: String) -> void:
	if which == "jump" and not crashed:
		if not playing:
			playing = true
			update()
		if not t_jumping and not t_ducking:
			trex_start_jump(current_speed)
	if which == "duck" and playing and not crashed:
		if t_jumping:
			trex_set_speed_drop()
		elif not t_jumping and not t_ducking:
			trex_set_duck(true)

func key_up(which: String) -> void:
	var is_jump := which == "jump"
	if is_running() and is_jump:
		trex_end_jump()
	elif which == "duck":
		t_speed_drop = false
		trex_set_duck(false)
	elif crashed:
		var delta_time := now - time
		if which == "enter" or (delta_time >= GAMEOVER_CLEAR_TIME and is_jump):
			restart()
	elif paused and is_jump:
		trex_reset()
		play()

# ---- Trex ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
func trex_update(delta_time: float, status := "") -> void:
	if status != "":
		t_status = status
	# the intro slides the dino in from the left
	if t_playing_intro and t_x < T_START_X_POS:
		t_x += js_round((T_START_X_POS / T_INTRO_DURATION) * delta_time)
	# the original's draw() shifts a crashed, ducking dino one pixel
	if t_status == "CRASHED" and t_ducking:
		t_x += 1.0
	# a speed drop turns into a duck once the dino is on the ground
	if t_speed_drop and t_y == t_ground:
		t_speed_drop = false
		trex_set_duck(true)

func trex_start_jump(speed: float) -> void:
	if not t_jumping:
		trex_update(0.0, "JUMPING")
		t_jump_velocity = T_INITIAL_JUMP_VELOCITY - speed / 10.0
		t_jumping = true
		t_reached_min = false
		t_speed_drop = false

func trex_end_jump() -> void:
	if t_reached_min and t_jump_velocity < T_DROP_VELOCITY:
		t_jump_velocity = T_DROP_VELOCITY

func ms_per_anim_frame() -> float:
	match t_status:
		"WAITING": return 1000.0 / 3.0
		"RUNNING": return 1000.0 / 12.0
		"DUCKING": return 1000.0 / 8.0
	return 1000.0 / 60.0 # CRASHED, JUMPING

func trex_update_jump(delta_time: float) -> void:
	var frames_elapsed := delta_time / ms_per_anim_frame()
	if t_speed_drop:
		t_y += js_round(t_jump_velocity * T_SPEED_DROP_COEFFICIENT * frames_elapsed)
	else:
		t_y += js_round(t_jump_velocity * frames_elapsed)
	t_jump_velocity += T_GRAVITY * frames_elapsed
	if t_y < t_min_jump or t_speed_drop:
		t_reached_min = true
	if t_y < T_MAX_JUMP_HEIGHT or t_speed_drop:
		trex_end_jump()
	if t_y > t_ground:
		trex_reset()
		t_jump_count += 1.0
	trex_update(delta_time)

func trex_set_speed_drop() -> void:
	t_speed_drop = true
	t_jump_velocity = 1.0

func trex_set_duck(is_ducking: bool) -> void:
	if is_ducking and t_status != "DUCKING":
		trex_update(0.0, "DUCKING")
		t_ducking = true
	elif t_status == "DUCKING":
		trex_update(0.0, "RUNNING")
		t_ducking = false

func trex_reset() -> void:
	t_y = t_ground
	t_jump_velocity = 0.0
	t_jumping = false
	t_ducking = false
	trex_update(0.0, "RUNNING")
	t_speed_drop = false
	t_jump_count = 0.0

# ---- collision ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
static func box_compare(ax: float, ay: float, aw: float, ah: float, bx: float, by: float, bw: float, bh: float) -> bool:
	return ax < bx + bw and ax + aw > bx and ay < by + bh and ah + ay > by

func check_for_collision() -> bool:
	if obstacles.is_empty():
		return false
	var o: Obstacle = obstacles[0]
	var tx := t_x + 1.0
	var ty := t_y + 1.0
	var tw := T_WIDTH - 2.0
	var th := T_HEIGHT - 2.0
	var ox := o.x + 1.0
	var oy := o.y + 1.0
	var ow: float = o.type_cfg["width"] * o.size - 2.0
	var oh: float = o.type_cfg["height"] - 2.0
	if box_compare(tx, ty, tw, th, ox, oy, ow, oh):
		var tboxes: Array = TREX_BOXES_DUCKING if t_ducking else TREX_BOXES_RUNNING
		for tb in tboxes:
			for ob in o.boxes:
				if box_compare(tb[0] + tx, tb[1] + ty, tb[2], tb[3], ob[0] + ox, ob[1] + oy, ob[2], ob[3]):
					return true
	return false

# ---- Horizon ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
func update_obstacles_if(delta_time: float, speed: float, do_update: bool) -> void:
	if do_update:
		update_obstacles(delta_time, speed)

func update_obstacles(delta_time: float, speed: float) -> void:
	var updated := obstacles.duplicate()
	for o in obstacles:
		o.update(delta_time, speed)
		if o.remove:
			updated.pop_front()
	obstacles = updated
	if obstacles.size() > 0:
		var last: Obstacle = obstacles[obstacles.size() - 1]
		if last != null and not last.followed and last.is_visible() and (last.x + last.width + last.gap) < WIDTH:
			add_new_obstacle(speed)
			last.followed = true
	else:
		add_new_obstacle(speed)

func add_new_obstacle(speed: float) -> void:
	var type: Dictionary = OBSTACLE_TYPES[int(random_num(0.0, OBSTACLE_TYPES.size() - 1.0))]
	if overrun:
		return # out of tape: stop here, the runner reports it
	if duplicate_obstacle_check(type["type"]) or speed < type["minSpeed"]:
		add_new_obstacle(speed)
	else:
		obstacles.append(make_obstacle(type, speed, type["width"]))
		obstacle_history.push_front(type["type"])
		if obstacle_history.size() > 1:
			obstacle_history.resize(mini(obstacle_history.size(), MAX_OBSTACLE_DUPLICATION))

func make_obstacle(type: Dictionary, speed: float, x_offset: float) -> Obstacle:
	var o := Obstacle.new()
	o.type_cfg = type
	o.size = random_num(1.0, MAX_OBSTACLE_LENGTH)
	o.x = WIDTH + x_offset
	for b in type["boxes"]:
		o.boxes.append(b.duplicate())
	# only allow groups when the speed is high enough
	if o.size > 1.0 and type["multipleSpeed"] > speed:
		o.size = 1.0
	o.width = type["width"] * o.size
	var ys: Array = type["yPos"]
	if ys.size() > 1:
		o.y = ys[int(random_num(0.0, ys.size() - 1.0))]
	else:
		o.y = ys[0]
	# the middle box grows with the group, the last one moves to the end
	if o.size > 1.0:
		o.boxes[1][2] = o.width - o.boxes[0][2] - o.boxes[2][2]
		o.boxes[2][0] = o.width - o.boxes[2][2]
	if type["speedOffset"] != 0.0:
		o.speed_offset = type["speedOffset"] if rng() > 0.5 else -type["speedOffset"]
	var min_gap := js_round(o.width * speed + type["minGap"] * GAP_COEFFICIENT)
	var max_gap := js_round(min_gap * MAX_GAP_COEFFICIENT)
	o.gap = random_num(min_gap, max_gap)
	return o

func duplicate_obstacle_check(next: String) -> bool:
	var count := 0
	for h in obstacle_history:
		count = count + 1 if h == next else 0
	return count >= MAX_OBSTACLE_DUPLICATION

# ---- what the recording compares ----------------------------------------------------------
func snapshot() -> Dictionary:
	var d := ceilf(distance_ran)
	var obs := []
	for o in obstacles:
		obs.append({"type": o.type_cfg["type"], "xPos": o.x, "yPos": o.y, "size": o.size, "width": o.width, "gap": o.gap,
			"speedOffset": o.speed_offset, "followed": o.followed})
	return {
		"playing": playing,
		"crashed": crashed,
		"activated": activated,
		"playingIntro": playing_intro,
		"paused": paused,
		"currentSpeed": current_speed,
		"distanceRan": distance_ran,
		"score": js_round(d * 0.025) if d != 0.0 else 0.0,
		"highestScore": highest_score,
		"runningTime": running_time,
		"playCount": play_count,
		"time": time,
		"running": raq_id != 0,
		"rafPending": queue.size(),
		"tRex": {"xPos": t_x, "yPos": t_y, "jumping": t_jumping, "ducking": t_ducking, "speedDrop": t_speed_drop,
			"jumpVelocity": t_jump_velocity, "jumpCount": t_jump_count, "status": t_status, "reachedMinHeight": t_reached_min},
		"obstacleHistory": obstacle_history.duplicate(),
		"obstacles": obs,
	}

```

`games/dino/ports/godot/main.gd`:

```gd
# Playable Dino in Godot: Space or Up jumps (hold for a high jump), Down ducks (in the air: drops fast),
# Space after a crash restarts (the original waits 750 ms), Enter restarts at once. The rules are dino.gd, the
# file the check runs; the art is drawn here from rectangles and polygons.
extends Control

const Dino := preload("res://dino.gd")
const STEP_MS := 1000.0 / 60.0
const INK := Color("535353")
const BG := Color("f7f7f7")

var game
var acc := 0.0
var flags := 0
var intro_ms := -1.0 # game time since the dino started to slide in; the intro ends after 400 ms
var clock := 0.0 # animation clock (ms), only for drawing

func _ready() -> void:
	randomize()
	game = Dino.new([], 1000.0, true)
	queue_redraw()

func _unhandled_input(e: InputEvent) -> void:
	if not (e is InputEventKey):
		return
	var jump: bool = e.keycode == KEY_SPACE or e.keycode == KEY_UP
	if e.pressed:
		if jump:
			flags |= Dino.F_JUMP
		elif e.keycode == KEY_DOWN:
			flags |= Dino.F_DUCK
	elif jump:
		flags |= Dino.F_JUMP_UP
	elif e.keycode == KEY_DOWN:
		flags |= Dino.F_DUCK_UP
	elif e.keycode == KEY_ENTER:
		flags |= Dino.F_ENTER

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	acc += delta * 1000.0
	while acc >= STEP_MS:
		acc -= STEP_MS
		advance()
	queue_redraw()

# one rules frame of 1000/60 ms with the keys gathered since the last one
func advance() -> void:
	if game.playing_intro:
		intro_ms = 0.0 if intro_ms < 0.0 else intro_ms + STEP_MS
		if intro_ms >= 400.0:
			flags |= Dino.F_ANIM_END
			intro_ms = -1.0
	else:
		intro_ms = -1.0
	game.step(STEP_MS, flags)
	flags = 0
	clock += STEP_MS

func _draw() -> void:
	var s := minf(size.x / 600.0, size.y / 150.0)
	var origin := Vector2((size.x - 600.0 * s) / 2.0, (size.y - 150.0 * s) / 2.0)
	draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), BG)
	draw_set_transform(origin, 0.0, Vector2(s, s))
	draw_line(Vector2(0, 140), Vector2(600, 140), INK, 1.5)
	for i in 12: # ground specks scroll with the distance
		var gx := fposmod(i * 53.0 - game.distance_ran * 1.0, 600.0)
		draw_rect(Rect2(gx, 143 + (i % 3) * 3, 4 + (i % 2) * 3, 1), INK.lightened(0.4))
	for o in game.obstacles:
		draw_obstacle(o)
	draw_dino()
	var f := ThemeDB.fallback_font
	var score := int(game.snapshot()["score"])
	draw_string(f, Vector2(440, 20), "HI %05d  %05d" % [int(round(game.highest_score * 0.025)), score], HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 14, INK)
	if game.crashed:
		draw_string(f, Vector2(0, 70), "G A M E   O V E R", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, 600, 18, INK)
		draw_string(f, Vector2(0, 90), "space to restart", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, 600, 12, INK)
	elif not game.activated and not game.playing:
		draw_string(f, Vector2(0, 70), "press space", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, 600, 14, INK)

func draw_dino() -> void:
	var x: float = game.t_x
	var y: float = game.t_y
	var c := INK
	if game.crashed:
		c = Color("a33")
	if game.t_ducking:
		# long and low
		draw_rect(Rect2(x, y + 18, 40, 20), c)
		draw_rect(Rect2(x + 34, y + 14, 20, 16), c)
		draw_rect(Rect2(x + 46, y + 18, 3, 3), BG)
		draw_rect(Rect2(x + 44, y + 28, 10, 2), BG)
		_legs(x + 8, y + 38, y + 43)
		return
	draw_rect(Rect2(x + 8, y + 16, 22, 22), c) # body
	draw_rect(Rect2(x + 22, y, 18, 16), c) # head
	draw_rect(Rect2(x + 32, y + 4, 3, 3), BG) # eye
	draw_rect(Rect2(x + 30, y + 12, 10, 2), BG) # mouth line
	draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(x + 8, y + 18), Vector2(x, y + 28), Vector2(x + 8, y + 32)]), c) # tail
	draw_rect(Rect2(x + 28, y + 24, 8, 3), c) # arm
	if game.t_jumping:
		draw_rect(Rect2(x + 10, y + 38, 5, 9), c)
		draw_rect(Rect2(x + 20, y + 38, 5, 9), c)
	else:
		_legs(x + 10, y + 38, y + 47)

func _legs(x: float, top: float, bottom: float) -> void:
	var step: bool = int(clock / 90.0) % 2 == 0 and game.playing
	var lift := 4.0 if step else 0.0
	var other := 0.0 if step else (4.0 if game.playing else 0.0)
	draw_rect(Rect2(x, top, 5, bottom - top - lift), INK)
	draw_rect(Rect2(x + 10, top, 5, bottom - top - other), INK)

func draw_obstacle(o) -> void:
	var t: String = o.type_cfg["type"]
	var w: float = o.type_cfg["width"]
	if t == "PTERODACTYL":
		var up := int(clock / 150.0) % 2 == 0
		draw_rect(Rect2(o.x + 10, o.y + 14, 34, 10), INK) # body
		draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(o.x + 10, o.y + 14), Vector2(o.x, o.y + 18), Vector2(o.x + 10, o.y + 22)]), INK) # beak
		var wy: float = o.y + (2.0 if up else 26.0)
		draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(o.x + 18, o.y + 16 if up else o.y + 22), Vector2(o.x + 36, o.y + 16 if up else o.y + 22),
			Vector2(o.x + 30, wy)]), INK)
		return
	for i in int(o.size):
		var cx: float = o.x + w * i
		var h: float = o.type_cfg["height"]
		draw_rect(Rect2(cx + w * 0.35, o.y, w * 0.3, h), INK) # trunk
		draw_rect(Rect2(cx + 1, o.y + h * 0.3, w * 0.35, 3), INK) # left arm
		draw_rect(Rect2(cx + 1, o.y + h * 0.2, 3, h * 0.2), INK)
		draw_rect(Rect2(cx + w * 0.6, o.y + h * 0.45, w * 0.35, 3), INK) # right arm
		draw_rect(Rect2(cx + w - 4, o.y + h * 0.35, 3, h * 0.2), INK)

```

`games/dino/ports/godot/runner.gd`:

```gd
# Runner protocol: a case on stdin, {trace, tapeUsed} on stdout.
# godot --headless --quiet --path ports/godot --script runner.gd < case.json
# Godot's JSON parser and printer do not round-trip doubles (the parsed tape was off by one ulp, and
# stringify writes 14 digits), so the numbers are read and written here, exactly.
extends SceneTree

const Dino := preload("res://dino.gd")

# a decimal as the double JavaScript would read: m / 10^k is correctly rounded when both are exact
func parse_num(s: String) -> float:
	var t := s.strip_edges()
	if t.contains("e") or t.contains("E"):
		return t.to_float()
	var neg := t.begins_with("-")
	if neg:
		t = t.substr(1)
	var dot := t.find(".")
	var k := 0
	var digits := t
	if dot >= 0:
		k = t.length() - dot - 1
		digits = t.substr(0, dot) + t.substr(dot + 1)
	var sig := digits.lstrip("0")
	var v: float
	if sig.length() <= 18 and sig.length() > 0:
		var m := int(sig)
		if m <= 9007199254740992 and k <= 18:
			var p := 1
			for i in k:
				p *= 10
			v = float(m) / float(p)
		else:
			v = snap_lattice(t.to_float())
	else:
		v = t.to_float() if sig.length() == 0 else snap_lattice(t.to_float())
	return -v if neg else v

# the tape comes from mulberry32: multiples of 2^-32, so the closest one is the exact value
func snap_lattice(approx: float) -> float:
	var x := floorf(approx * 4294967296.0 + 0.5) / 4294967296.0
	return x if absf(x - approx) < 1e-12 else approx

func fmt(v: float) -> String:
	if v == floorf(v) and absf(v) < 1e15:
		return str(int(v))
	var decimals := clampi(18 - int(floorf(log(absf(v)) / log(10.0))), 1, 60)
	var s := String.num(v, decimals)
	if s.contains("."):
		s = s.rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
	return s

func emit(v, out: PackedStringArray) -> void:
	match typeof(v):
		TYPE_DICTIONARY:
			out.append("{")
			var first := true
			for k in v:
				if not first:
					out.append(",")
				first = false
				out.append("\"%s\":" % k)
				emit(v[k], out)
			out.append("}")
		TYPE_ARRAY:
			out.append("[")
			for i in v.size():
				if i > 0:
					out.append(",")
				emit(v[i], out)
			out.append("]")
		TYPE_BOOL:
			out.append("true" if v else "false")
		TYPE_INT:
			out.append(str(v))
		TYPE_FLOAT:
			out.append(fmt(v))
		_:
			out.append("\"%s\"" % str(v))

func section(text: String, key: String, stop: String) -> String:
	var a := text.find(key)
	if a < 0:
		return ""
	a += key.length()
	var b := text.find(stop, a)
	return text.substr(a, (b if b >= 0 else text.length()) - a)

func _init() -> void:
	var text := OS.read_string_from_stdin(1 << 27)
	var clock0_s := section(text, "\"clock0\":", ",")
	var tape_s := section(text, "\"tape\":[", "]")
	var inputs_s := section(text, "\"inputs\":[", "],\"trace\"")
	if clock0_s == "" or inputs_s == "" and text.find("\"inputs\":[") < 0:
		printerr("runner: no case on stdin")
		quit(1) # a script error would leave the engine running forever
		return
	var tape: Array = []
	if tape_s != "":
		for p in tape_s.split(","):
			tape.append(parse_num(p))
	var dts: Array = []
	var flags: Array = []
	var bits := {"jump": 1, "duck": 2, "jumpUp": 4, "duckUp": 8, "enter": 16, "animEnd": 32}
	if inputs_s != "":
		for obj in inputs_s.trim_prefix("{").trim_suffix("}").split("},{"):
			var dt := 0.0
			var f := 0
			for kv in obj.split(","):
				var i := kv.find(":")
				var key := kv.substr(0, i).strip_edges().trim_prefix("\"").trim_suffix("\"")
				var val := kv.substr(i + 1).strip_edges()
				if key == "dt":
					dt = parse_num(val)
				elif bits.has(key) and val == "true":
					f |= bits[key]
			dts.append(dt)
			flags.append(f)
	var g = Dino.new(tape, parse_num(clock0_s), false)
	var out := PackedStringArray()
	out.append("{\"trace\":[")
	emit(g.snapshot(), out)
	for i in dts.size():
		g.step(dts[i], flags[i])
		out.append(",")
		emit(g.snapshot(), out)
		if g.overrun:
			printerr("runner: the port asked for more random numbers than the original used")
			quit(1)
			return
	out.append("],\"tapeUsed\":%d}" % g.used)
	print("".join(out))
	quit()

```

`games/dino/ports/godot/smoke.gd`:

```gd
# Smoke test of the playable scene, not part of the check: godot --headless --path ports/godot --script smoke.gd
# Loads main.tscn, feeds key events and prints the game state. It proves the scene runs and reacts to keys,
# not that it looks right.
extends SceneTree

func key(code: int, pressed: bool) -> InputEventKey:
	var e := InputEventKey.new()
	e.keycode = code
	e.physical_keycode = code
	e.pressed = pressed
	return e

func _init() -> void:
	var main = load("res://main.tscn").instantiate()
	root.add_child(main)
	await process_frame
	var g = main.game
	print("start playing=", g.playing, " y=", g.t_y)
	main._unhandled_input(key(KEY_SPACE, true))
	for i in 3:
		main.advance()
	print("after space playing=", g.playing, " jumping=", g.t_jumping, " y=", g.t_y)
	for i in 120:
		main.advance()
	print("after 120 frames jumping=", g.t_jumping, " activated=", g.activated, " intro=", g.playing_intro, " x=", g.t_x)
	main._unhandled_input(key(KEY_SPACE, false))
	main._unhandled_input(key(KEY_DOWN, true))
	for i in 60:
		main.advance()
	print("after down ducking=", g.t_ducking, " status=", g.t_status)
	main._unhandled_input(key(KEY_DOWN, false))
	var n := 0
	while not g.crashed and n < 6000:
		main.advance()
		n += 1
	print("idle until crash frames=", n, " crashed=", g.crashed, " obstacles=", g.obstacles.size(), " tape-free used=", g.used)
	for i in 60: # 1 s later, space restarts
		main.advance()
	main._unhandled_input(key(KEY_SPACE, true))
	main._unhandled_input(key(KEY_SPACE, false))
	main.advance()
	main.advance()
	print("after restart crashed=", g.crashed, " playing=", g.playing, " distance=", g.distance_ran)
	main.queue_redraw()
	await process_frame
	await process_frame
	print("frames drawn ok")
	quit()

```

`games/dino/ports/web/dino.mjs`:

```mjs
// Chrome Dino gameplay, rebuilt from games/dino/GAME.md. Pure logic: no DOM, no clock, no Math.random.
//   rng()  returns the next gameplay random number in [0, 1) (the recorded tape, or Math.random)
//   step({dt, jump, duck, jumpUp, duckUp, enter, animEnd})  one browser frame:
//          the clock moves by dt ms, the key events of the frame run, then the pending
//          requestAnimationFrame callbacks run (there can be two, see GAME.md "update chains").
// Numbers are computed with the same operations in the same order as the original, so the trace
// matches bit for bit.

export const WIDTH = 600;
export const HEIGHT = 150;
const FPS = 60;

const CFG = {
  ACCELERATION: 0.001, BOTTOM_PAD: 10, CLEAR_TIME: 3000, GAMEOVER_CLEAR_TIME: 750, GAP_COEFFICIENT: 0.6,
  MAX_OBSTACLE_DUPLICATION: 2, MAX_SPEED: 13, SPEED: 6,
};
const TREX = {
  DROP_VELOCITY: -5, GRAVITY: 0.6, HEIGHT: 47, INIITAL_JUMP_VELOCITY: -10, INTRO_DURATION: 1500,
  MAX_JUMP_HEIGHT: 30, MIN_JUMP_HEIGHT: 30, SPEED_DROP_COEFFICIENT: 3, START_X_POS: 50, WIDTH: 44,
};
// ms per animation frame of each status; the jump physics divides the frame time by it
const MS_PER_FRAME = { WAITING: 1000 / 3, RUNNING: 1000 / 12, CRASHED: 1000 / 60, JUMPING: 1000 / 60, DUCKING: 1000 / 8 };

const box = (x, y, width, height) => ({ x, y, width, height });
const TREX_BOXES = {
  DUCKING: [box(1, 18, 55, 25)],
  RUNNING: [box(22, 0, 17, 16), box(1, 18, 30, 9), box(10, 35, 14, 8), box(1, 24, 29, 5), box(5, 30, 21, 4), box(9, 34, 15, 4)],
};
const OBSTACLE_TYPES = [
  { type: "CACTUS_SMALL", width: 17, height: 35, yPos: 105, multipleSpeed: 4, minGap: 120, minSpeed: 0,
    boxes: [box(0, 7, 5, 27), box(4, 0, 6, 34), box(10, 4, 7, 14)] },
  { type: "CACTUS_LARGE", width: 25, height: 50, yPos: 90, multipleSpeed: 7, minGap: 120, minSpeed: 0,
    boxes: [box(0, 12, 7, 38), box(8, 0, 7, 49), box(13, 10, 10, 38)] },
  { type: "PTERODACTYL", width: 46, height: 40, yPos: [100, 75, 50], multipleSpeed: 999, minSpeed: 8.5, minGap: 150,
    speedOffset: 0.8,
    boxes: [box(15, 15, 16, 5), box(18, 21, 24, 6), box(2, 14, 4, 3), box(6, 10, 4, 7), box(10, 8, 6, 9)] },
];
const MAX_GAP_COEFFICIENT = 1.5;
const MAX_OBSTACLE_LENGTH = 3;

const boxCompare = (a, b) => a.x < b.x + b.width && a.x + a.width > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.height && a.height + a.y > b.y;
const adjusted = (b, by) => box(b.x + by.x, b.y + by.y, b.width, b.height);

class Obstacle {
  constructor(rng, type, speed, xOffset) {
    this.typeConfig = type;
    this.size = getRandomNum(rng, 1, MAX_OBSTACLE_LENGTH);
    this.remove = false;
    this.xPos = WIDTH + (xOffset || 0);
    this.yPos = 0;
    this.width = 0;
    this.gap = 0;
    this.speedOffset = 0;
    this.followingObstacleCreated = false;
    this.boxes = type.boxes.map((b) => box(b.x, b.y, b.width, b.height));
    // only allow groups when the speed is high enough
    if (this.size > 1 && type.multipleSpeed > speed) this.size = 1;
    this.width = type.width * this.size;
    if (Array.isArray(type.yPos)) this.yPos = type.yPos[getRandomNum(rng, 0, type.yPos.length - 1)];
    else this.yPos = type.yPos;
    // the middle box grows with the group, the last one moves to the end
    if (this.size > 1) {
      this.boxes[1].width = this.width - this.boxes[0].width - this.boxes[2].width;
      this.boxes[2].x = this.width - this.boxes[2].width;
    }
    if (type.speedOffset) this.speedOffset = rng() > 0.5 ? type.speedOffset : -type.speedOffset;
    const minGap = Math.round(this.width * speed + type.minGap * CFG.GAP_COEFFICIENT);
    const maxGap = Math.round(minGap * MAX_GAP_COEFFICIENT);
    this.gap = getRandomNum(rng, minGap, maxGap);
  }

  update(deltaTime, speed) {
    if (!this.remove) {
      if (this.typeConfig.speedOffset) speed += this.speedOffset;
      this.xPos -= Math.floor((speed * FPS / 1000) * deltaTime);
      if (!this.isVisible()) this.remove = true;
    }
  }

  isVisible() { return this.xPos + this.width > 0; }
}

function getRandomNum(rng, min, max) { return Math.floor(rng() * (max - min + 1)) + min; }

class Trex {
  constructor() {
    this.xPos = 0;
    this.groundYPos = HEIGHT - TREX.HEIGHT - CFG.BOTTOM_PAD;
    this.yPos = this.groundYPos;
    this.minJumpHeight = this.groundYPos - TREX.MIN_JUMP_HEIGHT;
    this.status = "WAITING";
    this.jumping = false;
    this.ducking = false;
    this.jumpVelocity = 0;
    this.reachedMinHeight = false;
    this.speedDrop = false;
    this.jumpCount = 0;
    this.playingIntro = false;
  }

  update(deltaTime, status) {
    if (status) this.status = status;
    // the intro slides the dino in from the left
    if (this.playingIntro && this.xPos < TREX.START_X_POS) this.xPos += Math.round((TREX.START_X_POS / TREX.INTRO_DURATION) * deltaTime);
    // the original's draw() shifts a crashed, ducking dino one pixel (it draws the standing sprite)
    if (this.status === "CRASHED" && this.ducking) this.xPos++;
    // a speed drop turns into a duck once the dino is on the ground
    if (this.speedDrop && this.yPos == this.groundYPos) {
      this.speedDrop = false;
      this.setDuck(true);
    }
  }

  startJump(speed) {
    if (!this.jumping) {
      this.update(0, "JUMPING");
      this.jumpVelocity = TREX.INIITAL_JUMP_VELOCITY - speed / 10;
      this.jumping = true;
      this.reachedMinHeight = false;
      this.speedDrop = false;
    }
  }

  endJump() {
    if (this.reachedMinHeight && this.jumpVelocity < TREX.DROP_VELOCITY) this.jumpVelocity = TREX.DROP_VELOCITY;
  }

  updateJump(deltaTime) {
    const msPerFrame = MS_PER_FRAME[this.status];
    const framesElapsed = deltaTime / msPerFrame;
    if (this.speedDrop) this.yPos += Math.round(this.jumpVelocity * TREX.SPEED_DROP_COEFFICIENT * framesElapsed);
    else this.yPos += Math.round(this.jumpVelocity * framesElapsed);
    this.jumpVelocity += TREX.GRAVITY * framesElapsed;
    if (this.yPos < this.minJumpHeight || this.speedDrop) this.reachedMinHeight = true;
    if (this.yPos < TREX.MAX_JUMP_HEIGHT || this.speedDrop) this.endJump();
    if (this.yPos > this.groundYPos) {
      this.reset();
      this.jumpCount++;
    }
    this.update(deltaTime);
  }

  setSpeedDrop() {
    this.speedDrop = true;
    this.jumpVelocity = 1;
  }

  setDuck(isDucking) {
    if (isDucking && this.status != "DUCKING") {
      this.update(0, "DUCKING");
      this.ducking = true;
    } else if (this.status == "DUCKING") {
      this.update(0, "RUNNING");
      this.ducking = false;
    }
  }

  reset() {
    this.yPos = this.groundYPos;
    this.jumpVelocity = 0;
    this.jumping = false;
    this.ducking = false;
    this.update(0, "RUNNING");
    this.speedDrop = false;
    this.jumpCount = 0;
  }
}

function checkForCollision(obstacle, tRex) {
  const tRexBox = box(tRex.xPos + 1, tRex.yPos + 1, TREX.WIDTH - 2, TREX.HEIGHT - 2);
  const obstacleBox = box(obstacle.xPos + 1, obstacle.yPos + 1, obstacle.typeConfig.width * obstacle.size - 2, obstacle.typeConfig.height - 2);
  if (boxCompare(tRexBox, obstacleBox)) {
    const tBoxes = tRex.ducking ? TREX_BOXES.DUCKING : TREX_BOXES.RUNNING;
    for (let t = 0; t < tBoxes.length; t++) {
      for (let i = 0; i < obstacle.boxes.length; i++) {
        if (boxCompare(adjusted(tBoxes[t], tRexBox), adjusted(obstacle.boxes[i], obstacleBox))) return true;
      }
    }
  }
  return false;
}

export class Dino {
  constructor({ rng, clock0 = 1000 }) {
    this.rng = rng;
    this.now = clock0;
    this.tRex = new Trex();
    this.obstacles = [];
    this.obstacleHistory = [];
    this.distanceRan = 0;
    this.highestScore = 0;
    this.time = 0;
    this.runningTime = 0;
    this.msPerFrame = 1000 / FPS;
    this.currentSpeed = CFG.SPEED;
    this.activated = false;
    this.playing = false;
    this.crashed = false;
    this.paused = false;
    this.playingIntro = false;
    this.playCount = 0;
    this.introListener = false;
    // requestAnimationFrame bookkeeping: pending callbacks, the frame being run, last id handed out
    this.queue = [];
    this.running = null;
    this.nextId = 1;
    this.raqId = 0;
    this.updatePending = false;
    // Runner.init ends with one update(): it starts the waiting-for-input loop
    this.update();
  }

  // ---- requestAnimationFrame ------------------------------------------------------------
  requestFrame() {
    const id = this.nextId++;
    this.queue.push({ id });
    return id;
  }
  cancelFrame(id) {
    this.queue = this.queue.filter((q) => q.id !== id);
    if (this.running) for (const q of this.running) if (q.id === id) q.cancelled = true;
  }
  scheduleNextUpdate() {
    if (!this.updatePending) {
      this.updatePending = true;
      this.raqId = this.requestFrame();
    }
  }

  // ---- one frame ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  step(input) {
    this.now = this.now + input.dt;
    if (input.jump) this.keyDown("jump");
    if (input.duck) this.keyDown("duck");
    if (input.jumpUp) this.keyUp("jump");
    if (input.duckUp) this.keyUp("duck");
    if (input.enter) this.keyUp("enter");
    if (input.animEnd && this.introListener) this.startGame();
    this.running = this.queue;
    this.queue = [];
    for (const q of this.running) if (!q.cancelled) this.update();
    this.running = null;
  }

  // ---- Runner ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  update() {
    this.updatePending = false;
    const now = this.now;
    let deltaTime = now - (this.time || now);
    this.time = now;

    if (this.playing) {
      if (this.tRex.jumping) this.tRex.updateJump(deltaTime);
      this.runningTime += deltaTime;
      const hasObstacles = this.runningTime > CFG.CLEAR_TIME;

      // the first landing starts the intro
      if (this.tRex.jumpCount == 1 && !this.playingIntro) this.playIntro();

      // the horizon does not move until the intro is over
      if (this.playingIntro) {
        this.updateHorizon(0, this.currentSpeed, hasObstacles);
      } else {
        deltaTime = !this.activated ? 0 : deltaTime;
        this.updateHorizon(deltaTime, this.currentSpeed, hasObstacles);
      }

      const collision = hasObstacles && checkForCollision(this.obstacles[0], this.tRex);
      if (!collision) {
        this.distanceRan += this.currentSpeed * deltaTime / this.msPerFrame;
        if (this.currentSpeed < CFG.MAX_SPEED) this.currentSpeed += CFG.ACCELERATION;
      } else {
        this.gameOver();
      }
    }

    // (the original also keeps this loop alive while !activated && blinkCount < 3; the port
    // assumes fewer than 3 blinks happen before the first key, which the recording checks)
    if (this.playing || !this.activated) {
      this.tRex.update(deltaTime);
      this.scheduleNextUpdate();
    }
  }

  playIntro() {
    if (!this.activated && !this.crashed) {
      this.playingIntro = true;
      this.tRex.playingIntro = true;
      this.introListener = true;
      this.playing = true;
      this.activated = true;
    } else if (this.crashed) {
      this.restart();
    }
  }

  startGame() {
    this.runningTime = 0;
    this.playingIntro = false;
    this.tRex.playingIntro = false;
    this.playCount++;
  }

  gameOver() {
    this.stop();
    this.crashed = true;
    this.tRex.update(100, "CRASHED");
    if (this.distanceRan > this.highestScore) this.highestScore = Math.ceil(this.distanceRan);
    this.time = this.now;
  }

  stop() {
    this.playing = false;
    this.paused = true;
    this.cancelFrame(this.raqId);
    this.raqId = 0;
  }

  play() {
    if (!this.crashed) {
      this.playing = true;
      this.paused = false;
      this.tRex.update(0, "RUNNING");
      this.time = this.now;
      this.update();
    }
  }

  restart() {
    if (!this.raqId) {
      this.playCount++;
      this.runningTime = 0;
      this.playing = true;
      this.crashed = false;
      this.distanceRan = 0;
      this.currentSpeed = CFG.SPEED; // setSpeed(SPEED) at width 600
      this.time = this.now;
      this.obstacles = []; // Horizon.reset (obstacleHistory is kept)
      this.tRex.reset();
      this.update();
    }
  }

  isRunning() { return !!this.raqId; }

  // ---- keys -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  keyDown(which) {
    if (which === "jump" && !this.crashed) {
      if (!this.playing) {
        this.playing = true;
        this.update();
      }
      if (!this.tRex.jumping && !this.tRex.ducking) this.tRex.startJump(this.currentSpeed);
    }
    if (which === "duck" && this.playing && !this.crashed) {
      if (this.tRex.jumping) this.tRex.setSpeedDrop();
      else if (!this.tRex.jumping && !this.tRex.ducking) this.tRex.setDuck(true);
    }
  }

  keyUp(which) {
    const isJumpKey = which === "jump";
    if (this.isRunning() && isJumpKey) {
      this.tRex.endJump();
    } else if (which === "duck") {
      this.tRex.speedDrop = false;
      this.tRex.setDuck(false);
    } else if (this.crashed) {
      const deltaTime = this.now - this.time;
      if (which === "enter" || (deltaTime >= CFG.GAMEOVER_CLEAR_TIME && isJumpKey)) this.restart();
    } else if (this.paused && isJumpKey) {
      this.tRex.reset();
      this.play();
    }
  }

  // ---- Horizon --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  updateHorizon(deltaTime, currentSpeed, updateObstacles) {
    if (updateObstacles) this.updateObstacles(deltaTime, currentSpeed);
  }

  updateObstacles(deltaTime, currentSpeed) {
    const updated = this.obstacles.slice(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < this.obstacles.length; i++) {
      const obstacle = this.obstacles[i];
      obstacle.update(deltaTime, currentSpeed);
      if (obstacle.remove) updated.shift();
    }
    this.obstacles = updated;
    if (this.obstacles.length > 0) {
      const last = this.obstacles[this.obstacles.length - 1];
      if (last && !last.followingObstacleCreated && last.isVisible() && (last.xPos + last.width + last.gap) < WIDTH) {
        this.addNewObstacle(currentSpeed);
        last.followingObstacleCreated = true;
      }
    } else {
      this.addNewObstacle(currentSpeed);
    }
  }

  addNewObstacle(currentSpeed) {
    const type = OBSTACLE_TYPES[getRandomNum(this.rng, 0, OBSTACLE_TYPES.length - 1)];
    if (this.duplicateObstacleCheck(type.type) || currentSpeed < type.minSpeed) {
      this.addNewObstacle(currentSpeed);
    } else {
      this.obstacles.push(new Obstacle(this.rng, type, currentSpeed, type.width));
      this.obstacleHistory.unshift(type.type);
      if (this.obstacleHistory.length > 1) this.obstacleHistory.splice(CFG.MAX_OBSTACLE_DUPLICATION);
    }
  }

  duplicateObstacleCheck(next) {
    let count = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.obstacleHistory.length; i++) count = this.obstacleHistory[i] == next ? count + 1 : 0;
    return count >= CFG.MAX_OBSTACLE_DUPLICATION;
  }

  // ---- what the recording compares ------------------------------------------------------
  snapshot() {
    const x = this.tRex;
    const d = Math.ceil(this.distanceRan);
    return {
      playing: this.playing,
      crashed: this.crashed,
      activated: this.activated,
      playingIntro: !!this.playingIntro,
      paused: this.paused,
      currentSpeed: this.currentSpeed,
      distanceRan: this.distanceRan,
      score: d ? Math.round(d * 0.025) : 0,
      highestScore: this.highestScore,
      runningTime: this.runningTime,
      playCount: this.playCount,
      time: this.time,
      running: !!this.raqId,
      rafPending: this.queue.length,
      tRex: {
        xPos: x.xPos, yPos: x.yPos, jumping: x.jumping, ducking: x.ducking, speedDrop: x.speedDrop,
        jumpVelocity: x.jumpVelocity, jumpCount: x.jumpCount, status: x.status, reachedMinHeight: x.reachedMinHeight,
      },
      obstacleHistory: this.obstacleHistory.slice(),
      obstacles: this.obstacles.map((o) => ({
        type: o.typeConfig.type, xPos: o.xPos, yPos: o.yPos, size: o.size, width: o.width, gap: o.gap,
        speedOffset: o.speedOffset, followed: o.followingObstacleCreated,
      })),
    };
  }
}

```

```html
<script type="module">
import { Dino } from "./dino.mjs";

(function main() {
  const STEP = 1000 / 60;      // the rules are stepped at 60 Hz whatever the screen does
  const INTRO_MS = 400;        // length of the intro animation, as in the recording
  const W = 600, H = 150, GROUND = 127;
  const cv = document.getElementById("c");
  const ctx = cv.getContext("2d");
  const rootStyle = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);

  // ---- canvas size: crisp on high density screens
  function fit() {
    const dpr = Math.max(1, Math.min(3, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));
    const cssW = cv.getBoundingClientRect().width || W;
    cv.width = Math.round(cssW * dpr);
    cv.height = Math.round(cssW * dpr * H / W);
    ctx.setTransform(cv.width / W, 0, 0, cv.width / W, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", fit);
  fit();

  // ---- game
  let best = 0;
  try { best = Number(localStorage.getItem("rea-dino-best")) || 0; } catch (e) { /* private mode */ }
  // DEMO HOOK (scripts/demo-dino.mjs): when window.__tape is set, the game draws its random numbers from that
  // recorded tape, the driver steps it with the case's dt, and window.__rea exposes snapshot(). Without it
  // nothing below changes.
  const TAPE = Array.isArray(window.__tape) ? window.__tape : null;
  let tapeUsed = 0;
  const rng = TAPE ? () => { if (tapeUsed >= TAPE.length) throw new Error("tape used up"); return TAPE[tapeUsed++]; } : Math.random;
  const game = new Dino({ rng, clock0: TAPE ? 1000 : performance.now() });
  let introT = 0, queue = [], acc = 0, last = null, ticks = 0, crashTicks = 0;
  const clouds = [{ x: 380, y: 40 }, { x: 120, y: 62 }];
  let scoreOf = () => { const d = Math.ceil(game.distanceRan); return d ? Math.round(d * 0.025) : 0; };

  // ---- input
  const push = (k) => queue.push(k);
  addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "ArrowUp") { e.preventDefault(); push({ jump: true }); }
    else if (e.code === "ArrowDown") { e.preventDefault(); push({ duck: true }); }
  });
  addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
    if (e.code === "Space" || e.code === "ArrowUp") { e.preventDefault(); push({ jumpUp: true }); }
    else if (e.code === "ArrowDown") { e.preventDefault(); push({ duckUp: true }); }
    else if (e.code === "Enter") push({ enter: true });
  });
  const wrap = document.getElementById("wrap");
  wrap.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); push({ jump: true }); });
  const lift = () => push({ jumpUp: true });
  wrap.addEventListener("pointerup", lift);
  wrap.addEventListener("pointercancel", lift);
  const duckBtn = document.getElementById("duck");
  duckBtn.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => { e.preventDefault(); push({ duck: true }); });
  for (const t of ["pointerup", "pointercancel", "pointerleave"]) duckBtn.addEventListener(t, () => push({ duckUp: true }));
  addEventListener("blur", () => { push({ jumpUp: true }); push({ duckUp: true }); });

  // ---- simulation
  function tick(dt = STEP) {
    const inp = queue.length ? queue.shift() : {};
    inp.dt = dt;
    if (game.playingIntro) { introT += dt; if (introT >= INTRO_MS) { inp.animEnd = true; introT = 0; } } else introT = 0;
    const wasCrashed = game.crashed;
    game.step(inp);
    ticks++;
    crashTicks = game.crashed ? crashTicks + 1 : 0;
    if (!wasCrashed && game.crashed) {
      const s = scoreOf();
      if (s > best) { best = s; try { localStorage.setItem("rea-dino-best", String(best)); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } }
    }
    // drifting clouds (looks only)
    const v = game.activated && !game.crashed ? game.currentSpeed * 0.2 : 0;
    for (const c of clouds) { c.x -= v * 0.6; if (c.x < -50) { c.x = W + Math.random() * 200; c.y = 25 + Math.random() * 45; } }
  }

  // ---- drawing (all shapes are rectangles drawn here, nothing is loaded)
  const pal = (night) => night
    ? { sky: "#202124", ink: "#e8e8e8", dim: "#6b6e75", eye: "#202124" }
    : { sky: "#f7f7f7", ink: "#535353", dim: "#c8c8c8", eye: "#f7f7f7" };
  function rects(list, ox, oy, color) { ctx.fillStyle = color; for (const [x, y, w, h] of list) ctx.fillRect(ox + x, oy + y, w, h); }

  function drawDino(g, p) {
    const t = g.tRex, ox = t.xPos, oy = t.yPos;
    const dead = g.crashed;
    const leg = !t.jumping && g.activated && !dead && Math.floor(ticks / 5) % 2 === 0;
    if (t.ducking && !dead) {
      rects([[1, 28, 40, 15], [34, 20, 22, 14], [48, 22, 9, 4], [0, 30, 6, 6], [8, 41, 5, 4], [26, 41, 5, 4]], ox, oy, p.ink);
      rects([[48, 23, 3, 3]], ox, oy, p.eye);
      if (!leg) rects([[8, 43, 5, 2]], ox, oy, p.ink);
      return;
    }
    rects([
      [22, 0, 17, 15], [30, 13, 9, 4],        // head and jaw
      [10, 14, 20, 20],                       // chest
      [4, 22, 8, 10], [0, 26, 6, 6],          // tail
      [26, 24, 8, 3],                         // little arm
      [12, 33, 12, 3],
    ], ox, oy, p.ink);
    // legs: one forward, one back, swap while running
    const a = leg ? 36 : 42, b = leg ? 42 : 36;
    rects([[12, 34, 5, a - 34 + 5], [20, 34, 5, b - 34 + 5]], ox, oy, p.ink);
    rects([[12, 40 + (a === 42 ? 3 : 0), 8, 3]], ox, oy, p.ink);
    if (dead) { rects([[31, 3, 2, 2], [35, 3, 2, 2], [33, 5, 2, 2], [31, 7, 2, 2], [35, 7, 2, 2]], ox, oy, p.eye); }
    else rects([[32, 3, 4, 4]], ox, oy, p.eye);
    rects([[34, 14, 4, 2]], ox, oy, p.eye); // mouth
  }

  function drawCactus(o, p) {
    const small = o.typeConfig.type === "CACTUS_SMALL";
    const uw = o.typeConfig.width, h = o.typeConfig.height;
    for (let i = 0; i < o.size; i++) {
      const x = o.xPos + i * uw, y = o.yPos;
      const stem = small ? 6 : 8, sx = x + Math.round((uw - stem) / 2);
      const arm = small ? [[x, y + 12, 4, 10, 3], [x + uw - 4, y + 6, 4, 12, 3]] : [[x + 1, y + 20, 5, 14, 5], [x + uw - 6, y + 12, 5, 16, 5]];
      ctx.fillStyle = p.ink;
      ctx.fillRect(sx, y, stem, h);
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 1, y - 1, stem - 2, 1);
      for (const [ax, ay, aw, ah, reach] of arm) {
        ctx.fillRect(ax, ay + ah - 4, aw + reach, 4);                       // elbow joined to the stem
        ctx.fillRect(ax, ay, aw, ah);                                       // arm going up
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = p.dim;
      ctx.fillRect(sx + 2, y + 4, 1, h - 10);
    }
  }

  function drawPtero(o, p) {
    const x = o.xPos, y = o.yPos, up = Math.floor(ticks / 9) % 2 === 0;
    rects([[0, 16, 14, 4], [4, 14, 6, 3], [12, 14, 26, 12], [36, 17, 10, 5]], x, y, p.ink);
    if (up) rects([[16, 3, 6, 11], [20, 0, 10, 6]], x, y, p.ink);
    else rects([[16, 26, 6, 10], [20, 33, 10, 6]], x, y, p.ink);
    rects([[8, 15, 2, 2]], x, y, p.eye);
  }

  function drawGround(g, p) {
    ctx.fillStyle = p.ink; ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND, W, 1);
    const scroll = Math.floor(g.distanceRan * 0.9) % 4096;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.dim;
    for (let i = -2; i < W / 9 + 2; i++) {
      const k = Math.floor((i * 9 + scroll) / 9);
      const h = (k * 2654435761 >>> 0) % 7;
      const x = i * 9 - (scroll % 9);
      if (h === 0) ctx.fillRect(x, GROUND + 5, 6, 1);
      else if (h === 1) ctx.fillRect(x, GROUND + 9, 3, 1);
      else if (h === 2) ctx.fillRect(x, GROUND + 3, 2, 2);
    }
  }

  function digits(n, len) { return String(n).padStart(len, "0"); }

  function draw() {
    const night = Math.floor(scoreOf() / 700) % 2 === 1;
    const p = pal(night);
    cv.style.background = p.sky;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.sky; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    // moon and clouds
    if (night) { ctx.fillStyle = p.ink; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(520, 38, 11, 0, 7); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = p.sky; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(526, 35, 10, 0, 7); ctx.fill(); }
    ctx.fillStyle = p.dim;
    for (const c of clouds) { ctx.fillRect(c.x + 6, c.y, 30, 4); ctx.fillRect(c.x, c.y + 4, 46, 5); ctx.fillRect(c.x + 12, c.y - 4, 14, 4); }
    drawGround(game, p);
    for (const o of game.obstacles) { if (o.typeConfig.type === "PTERODACTYL") drawPtero(o, p); else drawCactus(o, p); }
    drawDino(game, p);
    // score
    ctx.font = "bold 13px ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "right"; ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    ctx.fillStyle = p.ink; ctx.fillText(digits(scoreOf(), 5), W - 10, 8);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.dim; ctx.fillText("HI " + digits(best, 5), W - 70, 8);
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    if (!game.activated && !game.playing) { ctx.fillStyle = p.ink; ctx.font = "bold 14px system-ui, sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("PRESS SPACE OR TAP TO START", W / 2, 58); }
    if (game.crashed) {
      ctx.fillStyle = p.ink; ctx.font = "bold 17px ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace";
      ctx.fillText("G A M E   O V E R", W / 2, 38);
      // restart arrow
      ctx.strokeStyle = p.ink; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(W / 2, 80, 11, 0.5, 5.5); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = p.ink; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(W / 2 + 14, 70); ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + 4, 69); ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + 12, 80); ctx.fill();
      if (crashTicks * STEP >= 750) { ctx.fillStyle = p.dim; ctx.font = "12px system-ui, sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("space / tap / enter", W / 2, 104); }
    }
  }

  // ---- frame loop
  function frame(ts) {
    if (last === null) last = ts;
    acc += Math.min(ts - last, 100);
    last = ts;
    if (!TAPE) while (acc >= STEP) { tick(); acc -= STEP; }
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  if (TAPE) window.__rea = {
    // one frame of the recorded case: the key events dispatched since the last call are merged into one input
    step(dt) { const inp = Object.assign({}, ...queue); queue = []; queue.push(inp); tick(dt); draw(); return game.snapshot(); },
    snapshot: () => game.snapshot(),
    tapeUsed: () => tapeUsed,
  };
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => { last = null; });
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

```

`games/dino/ports/web/run.mjs`:

```mjs
// Runner protocol: a case on stdin, the port's trace on stdout.
import { Dino } from "./dino.mjs";

const c = JSON.parse(await new Promise((r) => { let s = ""; process.stdin.on("data", (d) => (s += d)).on("end", () => r(s)); }));
let used = 0;
const rng = () => { if (used >= c.tape.length) throw new Error("port asked for more random numbers than the original used"); return c.tape[used++]; };
const g = new Dino({ rng, clock0: c.clock0 });
const trace = [g.snapshot()];
for (const i of c.inputs) {
  g.step(i);
  trace.push(g.snapshot());
}
process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ trace, tapeUsed: used }));
```

`games/dino/record.mjs`:

```mjs
// Records the ORIGINAL Chrome Dino (originals/dino, BSD-3, unmodified) into replayable cases.
// The original runs in Chromium under a fake clock (driver.mjs); a seeded "player" decides the
// keys of every frame from the state it can see. Only the original's output is written as trace.
//   node games/dino/record.mjs              record every case, print the coverage
//   node games/dino/record.mjs --visual     record again with other visual-stream seeds, compare traces
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { mulberry32 } from "../../lib/rng.mjs";
import { openOriginal, CLOCK0 } from "./driver.mjs";
import { firstDiff } from "../../lib/compare.mjs";

const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const TREX_W = 44;
const NOMINAL = 1000 / 60;

// ---- frame times ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function makeDt(kind, r) {
  switch (kind) {
    case "steady": return () => 16.667;
    case "mixed": return () => { const x = r(); return x < 0.9 ? 16.667 : x < 0.95 ? 17 : x < 0.98 ? 33.333 : 50; };
    case "jitter": return () => 15 + r() * 3.5; // 15..18.5 ms with ugly fractions
    case "slow30": return () => 33.333;
    case "fast120": return () => 8.333;
    case "laggy": return () => { const x = r(); return x < 0.97 ? 16.667 : x < 0.99 ? 33.333 : 83; };
    default: throw new Error("dt kind " + kind);
  }
}
const DT_AVG = { steady: 16.667, mixed: 17.5, jitter: 16.7, slow30: 33.333, fast120: 8.333, laggy: 17.3 };

// ---- the player ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Looks at the state of the previous frame, returns the keys of the next one.
function makeBot(p, r) {
  const b = {
    f: 0, jumpHeld: false, jumpHeldFor: 0, duckHeld: false, duckHeldFor: 0, crashFor: 0,
    lastTargetX: -1e9, plan: null, sd: null, started: false,
  };
  const closingOf = (speed) => Math.max(1, Math.floor((speed * 60 / 1000) * DT_AVG[p.dt]));
  return (s) => {
    const inp = {};
    const f = b.f++;
    const x = s.tRex;
    const nominalFrames = (frames) => frames * (NOMINAL / DT_AVG[p.dt]);

    // ---- before the first key
    if (!s.playing && !s.crashed && !s.activated) {
      if (p.preNoise) {
        if (f === 2) inp.duck = true;
        if (f === 3) inp.duckUp = true;
        if (f === 4) inp.enter = true;
        if (f === 5) inp.jumpUp = true;
      }
      if (f >= p.startDelay && p.play) {
        if (p.firstKey === "duck") { if (!b.firstDuck) { inp.duck = true; b.firstDuck = true; return inp; } }
        inp.jump = true;
        b.jumpHeld = true; b.jumpHeldFor = 0; b.started = true;
        b.plan = null;
      }
      return inp;
    }
    if (!p.play) return inp;

    // ---- crashed: wait, maybe mash keys, restart
    if (s.crashed) {
      b.crashFor++;
      b.jumpHeld = false; b.duckHeld = false; b.sd = null; b.plan = null;
      if (p.crashNoise && r() < p.crashNoise) {
        const k = Math.floor(r() * 4);
        if (k === 0) inp.jump = true; else if (k === 1) inp.duck = true; else if (k === 2) inp.duckUp = true; else inp.jumpUp = b.crashFor > 20 ? false : true;
        if (!inp.jumpUp) delete inp.jumpUp;
      }
      if (p.restart === "enter" && b.crashFor === p.restartDelay) inp.enter = true;
      else if (p.restart === "space" && b.crashFor === p.restartDelay) { inp.jump = true; }
      else if (p.restart === "space" && b.crashFor === p.restartDelay + 1) { inp.jumpUp = true; }
      else if (p.restart === "mash" && b.crashFor >= p.restartDelay) { inp.jumpUp = true; }
      else if (p.restart === "never") { /* stays crashed */ }
      return inp;
    }
    b.crashFor = 0;

    // ---- fuzz: random keys every frame
    if (p.fuzz) {
      if (r() < p.fuzz) inp.jump = true;
      if (r() < p.fuzz) inp.duck = true;
      if (r() < p.fuzz) inp.jumpUp = true;
      if (r() < p.fuzz) inp.duckUp = true;
      if (r() < p.fuzz / 8) inp.enter = true;
      return inp;
    }

    // ---- hold bots: never look at the obstacles
    if (p.mode === "bunny") { // space held down with auto repeat
      if (!b.jumpHeld) { inp.jump = true; b.jumpHeld = true; } else if (b.f % 2 === 0) inp.jump = true;
      return inp;
    }
    if (p.mode === "duckHold") { // jump once to start, then hold down
      if (b.jumpHeld && b.jumpHeldFor++ >= 2 && !x.jumping) { inp.jumpUp = true; b.jumpHeld = false; }
      if (!b.duckHeld && !x.jumping && !b.jumpHeld) { inp.duck = true; b.duckHeld = true; }
      return inp;
    }
    if (p.mode === "idle") { // press the jump key once, then nothing
      if (b.jumpHeld && b.jumpHeldFor++ >= 3) { inp.jumpUp = true; b.jumpHeld = false; }
      return inp;
    }

    // ---- jump key release policy
    if (b.jumpHeld) {
      b.jumpHeldFor++;
      if (p.repeat && b.jumpHeldFor % 2 === 0) inp.jump = true; // OS auto repeat while held
      const rel =
        p.hold === "full" ? !x.jumping && b.jumpHeldFor > 2 :
        p.hold === "early" ? x.reachedMinHeight :
        p.hold === "tap" ? b.jumpHeldFor >= 2 :
        p.hold === "mixed" ? (b.plan && b.plan.early ? x.reachedMinHeight : !x.jumping && b.jumpHeldFor > 2) :
        false;
      if (rel || b.jumpHeldFor > 120) { inp.jumpUp = true; b.jumpHeld = false; }
    }
    if (b.duckHeld) {
      b.duckHeldFor++;
      if (b.sd) { // speed drop / duck after it: let go some frames after landing
        if (!x.jumping && b.duckHeldFor > b.sd.holdFor) { inp.duckUp = true; b.duckHeld = false; b.sd = null; }
      }
    }

    // ---- look at the next obstacle
    const o = s.obstacles.find((q) => q.xPos + q.width > x.xPos + 2);
    if (!o) return inp;
    if (o.xPos > b.lastTargetX) { // a new obstacle became the target: decide what to do about it
      b.plan = {
        miss: r() < (o.type === "PTERODACTYL" && p.missPtero !== undefined ? p.missPtero : p.miss),
        alt: r() < 0.5,
        lead: p.lead + (r() * 2 - 1) * p.leadJitter,
        early: r() < 0.5,
        lead50: 2.5 + r() * 3,
        sd: r() < p.sdProb,
        sdHold: 2 + Math.floor(r() * 25),
        done: false,
      };
    }
    b.lastTargetX = o.xPos;
    const plan = b.plan;
    const speed = s.currentSpeed + (o.type === "PTERODACTYL" ? o.speedOffset : 0);
    const closing = closingOf(speed);
    const dist = o.xPos - (x.xPos + TREX_W);
    const onGround = !x.jumping;

    // speed drop in the air once the obstacle is behind us
    if (plan.sd && x.jumping && !x.speedDrop && x.jumpVelocity > 0 && dist < -4 && !b.duckHeld) {
      inp.duck = true; b.duckHeld = true; b.duckHeldFor = 0; b.sd = { holdFor: plan.sdHold };
    }
    if (plan.done || !onGround && !b.duckHeld) { /* nothing more to do for this obstacle */ }

    const doJump = () => {
      if (b.duckHeld && !b.sd) { inp.duckUp = true; b.duckHeld = false; return false; }
      if (x.ducking) { inp.duckUp = true; b.duckHeld = false; return false; }
      inp.jump = true; b.jumpHeld = true; b.jumpHeldFor = 0; plan.done = true; return true;
    };

    if (o.type === "PTERODACTYL" && o.yPos === 75) { // flies at head height: duck under it
      const startDuck = dist <= closing * nominalFrames(p.duckLead);
      const passed = o.xPos + o.width < x.xPos + 4;
      if (!plan.miss && onGround && !b.duckHeld && startDuck && !passed) { inp.duck = true; b.duckHeld = true; b.duckHeldFor = 0; b.sd = null; }
      else if (plan.miss && plan.alt && onGround && !plan.done && startDuck && dist > -TREX_W) doJump(); // wrong answer: jump into it
      else if (b.duckHeld && !b.sd && passed) { inp.duckUp = true; b.duckHeld = false; }
    } else if (o.type === "PTERODACTYL" && o.yPos === 50) { // flies over the running dino
      if (plan.miss && onGround && !plan.done && dist <= closing * nominalFrames(plan.lead50)) doJump(); // too late: meets it in the air
    } else if (o.type === "PTERODACTYL" && plan.miss && plan.alt) { // wrong answer for a low one: duck under it
      const startDuck = dist <= closing * nominalFrames(p.duckLead);
      const passed = o.xPos + o.width < x.xPos + 4;
      if (onGround && !b.duckHeld && startDuck && !passed) { inp.duck = true; b.duckHeld = true; b.duckHeldFor = 0; b.sd = null; }
      else if (b.duckHeld && !b.sd && passed) { inp.duckUp = true; b.duckHeld = false; }
    } else { // cactus or low pterodactyl: jump over it
      const trigger = dist <= closing * nominalFrames(plan.lead + (b.duckHeld ? 3 : 0));
      if (!plan.miss && onGround && !plan.done && trigger && dist > -TREX_W) doJump();
    }
    // a duck held for nothing: let go when the next obstacle is a cactus
    return inp;
  };
}

// ---- running one case on the original -------------------------------------------------------
export async function runCase(spec, { visualSeed } = {}) {
  const o = await openOriginal({ seed: spec.seed, visualSeed });
  try {
    const bot = makeBot(spec.bot, mulberry32(spec.seed * 31 + 7));
    const nextDt = makeDt(spec.bot.dt, mulberry32(spec.seed * 131 + 3));
    const trace = [await o.initial()];
    const inputs = [];
    let state = trace[0];
    let blinkChecked = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < spec.frames; i++) {
      const inp = spec.script ? spec.script(i, state) : bot(state);
      inp.dt = nextDt();
      const { applied, state: s } = await o.step(inp);
      if (!blinkChecked && applied.jump) {
        // the port assumes the "waiting" update loop is still alive at the first key
        if ((await o.blinkCount()) >= 3) throw new Error(`${spec.name}: the dino blinked 3 times before the first key; use another seed`);
        blinkChecked = true;
      }
      inputs.push(applied);
      trace.push(s);
      state = s;
    }
    if (o.errors.length) throw new Error(`${spec.name}: page error ${o.errors[0]}`);
    return { game: "dino", name: spec.name, seed: spec.seed, clock0: CLOCK0, bot: spec.bot, tape: await o.tape(), inputs, trace, _o: o };
  } finally {
    // the caller closes via o.close() after reading callers; close here when not asked to keep
    if (!spec.keepOpen) await o.close();
  }
}

// ---- the cases -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
const base = { play: true, startDelay: 5, dt: "steady", lead: 8, leadJitter: 1, duckLead: 11, miss: 0, hold: "full", repeat: false, sdProb: 0, restart: "enter", restartDelay: 10, crashNoise: 0 };
const B = (o) => ({ ...base, ...o });

export function buildSpecs() {
  const S = [];
  const add = (name, seed, frames, bot) => S.push({ name, seed, frames, bot: B(bot) });
  add("no-input", 1, 300, { play: false });
  add("idle-crash-1", 2, 500, { mode: "idle", restart: "never" });
  add("idle-crash-2", 3, 600, { mode: "idle", restart: "enter", restartDelay: 30, dt: "mixed" });
  add("duck-hold-crash", 4, 600, { mode: "duckHold", restart: "enter", restartDelay: 12 });
  add("bunny-hop-1", 5, 600, { mode: "bunny", restart: "space", restartDelay: 50 });
  add("bunny-hop-2", 6, 600, { mode: "bunny", restart: "enter", restartDelay: 3, dt: "jitter" });
  add("pre-noise-idle", 7, 500, { mode: "idle", preNoise: true, startDelay: 9, restart: "space", restartDelay: 60 });
  // good players of different styles: long runs that reach the speed cap
  add("bot-full-steady", 11, 5000, { hold: "full" });
  add("bot-early-steady", 12, 3000, { hold: "early", restart: "space", restartDelay: 46 });
  add("bot-mixed-dt", 13, 4200, { hold: "full", dt: "mixed", leadJitter: 1.5 });
  add("bot-jitter-dt", 14, 2600, { hold: "full", dt: "jitter", repeat: true });
  add("bot-slow30", 15, 2000, { hold: "full", dt: "slow30", lead: 5, leadJitter: 0.5, duckLead: 6 });
  add("bot-fast120", 16, 2600, { hold: "full", dt: "fast120", lead: 16, duckLead: 22 });
  add("bot-laggy", 18, 3900, { hold: "full", dt: "laggy", restart: "mash", restartDelay: 38 });
  // players that make mistakes and speed-drop
  add("bot-speeddrop", 21, 3000, { hold: "mixed", sdProb: 0.6, miss: 0.04, restart: "mash", restartDelay: 40, dt: "mixed" });
  add("bot-sloppy-1", 22, 2200, { hold: "mixed", miss: 0.12, leadJitter: 3, sdProb: 0.3, restart: "enter", restartDelay: 4 });
  add("bot-sloppy-2", 23, 2200, { hold: "early", miss: 0.2, leadJitter: 4, restart: "space", restartDelay: 44, crashNoise: 0.15, dt: "jitter" });
  add("bot-sloppy-3", 24, 2200, { hold: "full", miss: 0.1, leadJitter: 2, sdProb: 1, restart: "mash", restartDelay: 41, crashNoise: 0.1, dt: "laggy" });
  add("bot-late-jumper", 25, 1800, { hold: "full", lead: 3.5, leadJitter: 1, restart: "enter", restartDelay: 20 });
  add("bot-early-jumper", 26, 1800, { hold: "full", lead: 14, leadJitter: 2, restart: "space", restartDelay: 45 });
  add("bot-tap-jump", 27, 1200, { hold: "tap", restart: "enter", restartDelay: 8, dt: "mixed" });
  add("bot-first-duck", 28, 1200, { hold: "full", firstKey: "duck", sdProb: 0.5, restart: "space", restartDelay: 44 });
  // good with cacti, wrong about pterodactyls (they come after speed 8.5, so each restart climbs again)
  add("ptero-hunter-1", 41, 4200, { hold: "full", missPtero: 1, restart: "enter", restartDelay: 6 });
  add("ptero-hunter-2", 42, 4200, { hold: "full", missPtero: 1, dt: "mixed", restart: "space", restartDelay: 44 });
  add("ptero-hunter-3", 43, 4200, { hold: "full", missPtero: 1, sdProb: 0.5, dt: "jitter", restart: "mash", restartDelay: 39 });
  add("ptero-hunter-4", 44, 4200, { hold: "full", missPtero: 1, dt: "laggy", restart: "enter", restartDelay: 9 });
  // random keys
  add("fuzz-sparse", 31, 1200, { fuzz: 0.02, restart: "enter", dt: "mixed" });
  add("fuzz-dense", 32, 1200, { fuzz: 0.15, dt: "jitter" });
  add("fuzz-1", 33, 1200, { fuzz: 0.06, dt: "laggy" });
  return S;
}

export async function record() {
  const outDir = path.join(here, "cases");
  fs.mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true });
  for (const f of fs.readdirSync(outDir)) if (f.endsWith(".json")) fs.rmSync(path.join(outDir, f));
  let frames = 0;
  const specs = buildSpecs();
  for (const spec of specs) {
    const c = await runCase(spec);
    delete c._o;
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, `${c.name}.json`), JSON.stringify(c));
    frames += c.inputs.length;
  }
  return { cases: specs.length, inputs: frames };
}

// ---- coverage, read back from the written cases ----------------------------------------------
export function coverage(cases) {
  const cov = {
    cases: cases.length, frames: 0, spawned: {}, ptero: {}, crashes: 0, crashedInto: {}, crashPose: {}, restarts: 0,
    maxSpeed: 0, framesAtCap: 0, maxScore: 0, jumps: 0, jumpsShort: 0, jumpsFull: 0, speedDropFrames: 0, duckFrames: 0,
    speedDropCrashes: 0, casesOver1000: 0, casesWithPtero: 0, casesAtCap: 0, maxObstaclesOnScreen: 0, pteroFrames: 0,
  };
  for (const c of cases) {
    let ptero = false, cap = false, over = false;
    const t = c.trace;
    for (let i = 0; i < c.inputs.length; i++) {
      const a = t[i], b = t[i + 1], inp = c.inputs[i];
      cov.frames++;
      for (const o of b.obstacles) {
        const w = { CACTUS_SMALL: 17, CACTUS_LARGE: 25, PTERODACTYL: 46 }[o.type];
        if (o.xPos === 600 + w) {
          const k = o.type === "PTERODACTYL" ? "PTERODACTYL" : `${o.type}x${o.size}`;
          cov.spawned[k] = (cov.spawned[k] || 0) + 1;
          if (o.type === "PTERODACTYL") { cov.ptero[o.yPos] = (cov.ptero[o.yPos] || 0) + 1; ptero = true; }
        }
        if (o.type === "PTERODACTYL") cov.pteroFrames++;
      }
      cov.maxObstaclesOnScreen = Math.max(cov.maxObstaclesOnScreen, b.obstacles.length);
      if (!a.crashed && b.crashed) {
        cov.crashes++;
        const o = b.obstacles[0];
        const k = o.type === "PTERODACTYL" ? `PTERODACTYL@${o.yPos}` : `${o.type}x${o.size}`;
        cov.crashedInto[k] = (cov.crashedInto[k] || 0) + 1;
        const pose = b.tRex.ducking ? "ducking" : b.tRex.speedDrop ? "speed-drop" : b.tRex.jumping ? "jumping" : "running";
        cov.crashPose[pose] = (cov.crashPose[pose] || 0) + 1;
      }
      if (a.crashed && !b.crashed) cov.restarts++;
      if (!a.tRex.jumping && b.tRex.jumping) cov.jumps++;
      if (a.tRex.jumping && inp.jumpUp && a.tRex.reachedMinHeight) cov.jumpsShort++;
      if (a.tRex.jumping && !b.tRex.jumping && !a.tRex.speedDrop) cov.jumpsFull++;
      if (b.tRex.speedDrop) cov.speedDropFrames++;
      if (b.tRex.ducking) cov.duckFrames++;
      cov.maxSpeed = Math.max(cov.maxSpeed, b.currentSpeed);
      if (b.currentSpeed >= 13) { cov.framesAtCap++; cap = true; }
      cov.maxScore = Math.max(cov.maxScore, b.score);
      if (b.score > 1000) over = true;
    }
    if (ptero) cov.casesWithPtero++;
    if (cap) cov.casesAtCap++;
    if (over) cov.casesOver1000++;
  }
  return cov;
}

export function loadCases() {
  const dir = path.join(here, "cases");
  return fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".json")).sort().map((f) => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, f), "utf8")));
}

// Same inputs, other visual-stream seeds (clouds, stars, ground bumps, blinks): the trace must not change.
export async function checkVisualIndependence(log = console.log) {
  let bad = 0;
  const cases = loadCases();
  for (const c of cases) {
    const spec = buildSpecs().find((s) => s.name === c.name);
    for (const vs of [1, 987654321]) {
      const o = await openOriginal({ seed: c.seed, visualSeed: vs });
      try {
        const trace = [await o.initial()];
        for (const inp of c.inputs) trace.push((await o.step({ ...inp, animEnd: inp.animEnd === true })).state);
        const tape = await o.tape();
        const d = firstDiff(c.trace, trace) || (firstDiff(c.tape, tape) && "tape differs");
        if (d) { bad++; log(`  DIFF ${c.name} visualSeed ${vs}: ${d}`); }
      } finally { await o.close(); }
    }
    log(`  visual-seed check ${c.name}: ${c.inputs.length} frames x 2 seeds`);
    void spec;
  }
  return bad;
}

if (process.argv[1] === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
  if (process.argv.includes("--visual")) {
    const bad = await checkVisualIndependence();
    console.log(bad ? `${bad} traces changed with the visual seed` : "all traces identical with other visual seeds");
    process.exit(bad ? 1 : 0);
  }
  console.log(await record());
  console.log(JSON.stringify(coverage(loadCases()), null, 1));
}
```

`lib/compare.mjs`:

```mjs
// Deep comparison that ignores object key order and reports the first difference.
export function firstDiff(a, b, at = "") {
  if (a === b) return null;
  if (typeof a === "number" && typeof b === "number") {
    return Object.is(a, b) || a === b ? null : `${at}: ${a} != ${b}`;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(a) && Array.isArray(b)) {
    if (a.length !== b.length) return `${at}: length ${a.length} != ${b.length}`;
    for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
      const d = firstDiff(a[i], b[i], `${at}[${i}]`);
      if (d) return d;
    }
    return null;
  }
  if (a && b && typeof a === "object" && typeof b === "object" && !Array.isArray(a) && !Array.isArray(b)) {
    const keys = new Set([...Object.keys(a), ...Object.keys(b)]);
    for (const k of [...keys].sort()) {
      if (!(k in a)) return `${at}.${k}: missing in expected`;
      if (!(k in b)) return `${at}.${k}: missing in port`;
      const d = firstDiff(a[k], b[k], `${at}.${k}`);
      if (d) return d;
    }
    return null;
  }
  return `${at}: ${JSON.stringify(a)} != ${JSON.stringify(b)}`;
}
```

`lib/rng.mjs`:

```mjs
// Small seeded generator (mulberry32). Used to make recordings repeatable.
export function mulberry32(seed) {
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  return function () {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = a;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}
```

```mjs
import fs from "node:fs";

export function scaffold(root, name) {

    original: { repo: "OWNER/REPO", license: "SPDX-ID", path: `originals/${name}` },

    ports: { web: { cmd: ["node", "ports/web/run.mjs"], play: "ports/web/index.html" } },

import fs from "node:fs";

const here = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));

  // TODO: open the original, replace the clock / requestAnimationFrame / Math.random, play seeded input scripts,
  // and write each case with fs.writeFileSync(path.join(here, "cases", \`\${name}.json\`), JSON.stringify(c)).
  throw new Error("record.mjs is a stub: write the recorder for ${name}");
}
`);

Original: OWNER/REPO (licence), vendored unmodified in \`originals/${name}\`.

## What was recorded
(how the original was driven, what a trace entry holds, how many cases and inputs, what they cover)

  w("ports/web/run.mjs", `// Runner protocol: a case on stdin, { trace, tapeUsed } on stdout.
const c = JSON.parse(await new Promise((r) => { let s = ""; process.stdin.on("data", (d) => (s += d)).on("end", () => r(s)); }));
let used = 0;
const rng = () => { if (used >= c.tape.length) throw new Error("asked for more random numbers than the original used"); return c.tape[used++]; };
const trace = []; // TODO: step your port through c.inputs and push one state per step
process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ trace, tapeUsed: used }));
`);
  return dir;
}
```

`lib/verify.mjs`:

```mjs
// Runs a port over every recorded case and compares its trace with the original's.
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import zlib from "node:zlib";
import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import { firstDiff } from "./compare.mjs";

export function loadGame(root, name) {
  const dir = path.join(root, "games", name);
  const meta = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, "game.json"), "utf8"));
  return { dir, meta };
}

export function listGames(root) {
  return fs.readdirSync(path.join(root, "games")).filter((n) => fs.existsSync(path.join(root, "games", n, "game.json"))).sort();
}

export function loadCases(dir) {
  const cd = path.join(dir, "cases");
  // cases are stored as .json, or as .json.gz once packed (`rea-games pack`) to keep the repository small
  return fs.readdirSync(cd).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".json") || f.endsWith(".json.gz")).sort().map((f) => {
    const buf = fs.readFileSync(path.join(cd, f));
    return { file: f.replace(/\.gz$/, ""), raw: (f.endsWith(".gz") ? zlib.gunzipSync(buf) : buf).toString("utf8") };
  });
}

export function verifyPort(root, name, portName, log = console.log) {
  const { dir, meta } = loadGame(root, name);
  const port = meta.ports[portName];
  if (!port) throw new Error(`${name} has no port "${portName}" (has: ${Object.keys(meta.ports).join(", ")})`);
  if (port.build) {
    const b = spawnSync(port.build[0], port.build.slice(1), { cwd: dir, stdio: ["ignore", "inherit", "inherit"] });
    if (b.status !== 0) throw new Error(`build of ${name}/${portName} failed`);
  }
  const cases = loadCases(dir);
  let passed = 0, inputs = 0, frames = 0;
  const failures = [];
  for (const { file, raw } of cases) {
    const c = JSON.parse(raw);
    // `godot` means the binary in $REA_GODOT when set, so a download outside PATH works
    const exe = port.cmd[0] === "godot" && process.env.REA_GODOT ? process.env.REA_GODOT : port.cmd[0];
    const r = spawnSync(exe, port.cmd.slice(1), { cwd: dir, input: raw, maxBuffer: 1 << 29, encoding: "utf8", timeout: 120000 }); // a hung port fails the case, not the run
    let problem = null;
    if (r.error?.code === "ETIMEDOUT") problem = "port did not finish within 120 s";
    else if (r.status !== 0) problem = `port exited ${r.status}: ${(r.stderr || "").trim().split("\n").slice(-2).join(" | ")}`;
    else {
      let out;
      // engines print a banner before the program's output: the result is the one line that starts with "{"
      const line = r.stdout.split("\n").find((l) => l.startsWith("{")) ?? r.stdout;
      try { out = JSON.parse(line); } catch { problem = "port printed something that is not JSON"; }
      if (!problem) {
        const d = firstDiff(c.trace, out.trace);
        if (d) problem = `trace differs at ${d}`;
        else if (out.tapeUsed !== c.tape.length) problem = `used ${out.tapeUsed} of the ${c.tape.length} recorded random numbers`;
      }
    }
    if (problem) { failures.push({ file, problem }); log(`  FAIL ${file}: ${problem}`); }
    else { passed++; inputs += c.inputs.length; frames += c.trace.length; log(`  ok   ${file}  (${c.inputs.length} inputs)`); }
  }
  return { name, port: portName, cases: cases.length, passed, inputs, frames, failures };
}

export function packCases(root, name) {
  const { dir } = loadGame(root, name);
  const cd = path.join(dir, "cases");
  let before = 0, after = 0;
  for (const f of fs.readdirSync(cd).filter((x) => x.endsWith(".json"))) {
    const buf = fs.readFileSync(path.join(cd, f));
    const gz = zlib.gzipSync(buf, { level: 9 });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(cd, f + ".gz"), gz);
    fs.unlinkSync(path.join(cd, f));
    before += buf.length; after += gz.length;
  }
  return { before, after };
}
```

`originals/2048/page/js/animframe_polyfill.js`:

```js
(function () {
  var lastTime = 0;
  var vendors = ['webkit', 'moz'];
  for (var x = 0; x < vendors.length && !window.requestAnimationFrame; ++x) {
    window.requestAnimationFrame = window[vendors[x] + 'RequestAnimationFrame'];
    window.cancelAnimationFrame = window[vendors[x] + 'CancelAnimationFrame'] ||
      window[vendors[x] + 'CancelRequestAnimationFrame'];
  }

  if (!window.requestAnimationFrame) {
    window.requestAnimationFrame = function (callback) {
      var currTime = new Date().getTime();
      var timeToCall = Math.max(0, 16 - (currTime - lastTime));
      var id = window.setTimeout(function () {
        callback(currTime + timeToCall);
      },
      timeToCall);
      lastTime = currTime + timeToCall;
      return id;
    };
  }

  if (!window.cancelAnimationFrame) {
    window.cancelAnimationFrame = function (id) {
      clearTimeout(id);
    };
  }
}());
```

```js
Function.prototype.bind = Function.prototype.bind || function (target) {
  var self = this;
  return function (args) {
    if (!(args instanceof Array)) {
      args = [args];
    }
    self.apply(target, args);
  };
};
```
