```js
    Trex.prototype = {
        /**
         * T-rex player initaliser.
         * Sets the t-rex to blink at random intervals.
         */
        init: function () {
            this.groundYPos = Runner.defaultDimensions.HEIGHT - this.config.HEIGHT -
                Runner.config.BOTTOM_PAD;
            this.yPos = this.groundYPos;
            this.minJumpHeight = this.groundYPos - this.config.MIN_JUMP_HEIGHT;

            this.draw(0, 0);
            this.update(0, Trex.status.WAITING);
        },

        /**
         * Setter for the jump velocity.
         * The approriate drop velocity is also set.
         */
        setJumpVelocity: function (setting) {
            this.config.INIITAL_JUMP_VELOCITY = -setting;
            this.config.DROP_VELOCITY = -setting / 2;
        },

        /**
         * Set the animation status.
         * @param {!number} deltaTime
         * @param {Trex.status} status Optional status to switch to.
         */
        update: function (deltaTime, opt_status) {
            this.timer += deltaTime;

            // Update the status.
            if (opt_status) {
                this.status = opt_status;
                this.currentFrame = 0;
                this.msPerFrame = Trex.animFrames[opt_status].msPerFrame;
                this.currentAnimFrames = Trex.animFrames[opt_status].frames;

                if (opt_status == Trex.status.WAITING) {
                    this.animStartTime = getTimeStamp();
                    this.setBlinkDelay();
                }
            }

            // Game intro animation, T-rex moves in from the left.
            if (this.playingIntro && this.xPos < this.config.START_X_POS) {
                this.xPos += Math.round((this.config.START_X_POS /
                    this.config.INTRO_DURATION) * deltaTime);
            }

            if (this.status == Trex.status.WAITING) {
                this.blink(getTimeStamp());
            } else {
                this.draw(this.currentAnimFrames[this.currentFrame], 0);
            }

            // Update the frame position.
            if (this.timer >= this.msPerFrame) {
                this.currentFrame = this.currentFrame ==
                    this.currentAnimFrames.length - 1 ? 0 : this.currentFrame + 1;
                this.timer = 0;
            }

            // Speed drop becomes duck if the down key is still being pressed.
            if (this.speedDrop && this.yPos == this.groundYPos) {
                this.speedDrop = false;
                this.setDuck(true);
            }
        },

        /**
         * Draw the t-rex to a particular position.
         * @param {number} x
         * @param {number} y
         */
        draw: function (x, y) {
            var sourceX = x;
            var sourceY = y;
            var sourceWidth = this.ducking && this.status != Trex.status.CRASHED ?
                this.config.WIDTH_DUCK : this.config.WIDTH;
            var sourceHeight = this.config.HEIGHT;

            if (IS_HIDPI) {
                sourceX *= 2;
                sourceY *= 2;
                sourceWidth *= 2;
                sourceHeight *= 2;
            }

            // Adjustments for sprite sheet position.
            sourceX += this.spritePos.x;
            sourceY += this.spritePos.y;

            // Ducking.
            if (this.ducking && this.status != Trex.status.CRASHED) {
                this.canvasCtx.drawImage(Runner.imageSprite, sourceX, sourceY,
                    sourceWidth, sourceHeight,
                    this.xPos, this.yPos,
                    this.config.WIDTH_DUCK, this.config.HEIGHT);
            } else {
                // Crashed whilst ducking. Trex is standing up so needs adjustment.
                if (this.ducking && this.status == Trex.status.CRASHED) {
                    this.xPos++;
                }
                // Standing / running
                this.canvasCtx.drawImage(Runner.imageSprite, sourceX, sourceY,
                    sourceWidth, sourceHeight,
                    this.xPos, this.yPos,
                    this.config.WIDTH, this.config.HEIGHT);
            }
        },

        /**
         * Sets a random time for the blink to happen.
         */
        setBlinkDelay: function () {
            this.blinkDelay = Math.ceil(Math.random() * Trex.BLINK_TIMING);
        },

        /**
         * Make t-rex blink at random intervals.
         * @param {number} time Current time in milliseconds.
         */
        blink: function (time) {
            var deltaTime = time - this.animStartTime;

            if (deltaTime >= this.blinkDelay) {
                this.draw(this.currentAnimFrames[this.currentFrame], 0);

                if (this.currentFrame == 1) {
                    // Set new random delay to blink.
                    this.setBlinkDelay();
                    this.animStartTime = time;
                    this.blinkCount++;
                }
            }
        },

        /**
         * Initialise a jump.
         * @param {number} speed
         */
        startJump: function (speed) {
            if (!this.jumping) {
                this.update(0, Trex.status.JUMPING);
                // Tweak the jump velocity based on the speed.
                this.jumpVelocity = this.config.INIITAL_JUMP_VELOCITY - (speed / 10);
                this.jumping = true;
                this.reachedMinHeight = false;
                this.speedDrop = false;
            }
        },

        /**
         * Jump is complete, falling down.
         */
        endJump: function () {
            if (this.reachedMinHeight &&
                this.jumpVelocity < this.config.DROP_VELOCITY) {
                this.jumpVelocity = this.config.DROP_VELOCITY;
            }
        },

        /**
         * Update frame for a jump.
         * @param {number} deltaTime
         * @param {number} speed
         */
        updateJump: function (deltaTime, speed) {
            var msPerFrame = Trex.animFrames[this.status].msPerFrame;
            var framesElapsed = deltaTime / msPerFrame;

            // Speed drop makes Trex fall faster.
            if (this.speedDrop) {
                this.yPos += Math.round(this.jumpVelocity *
                    this.config.SPEED_DROP_COEFFICIENT * framesElapsed);
            } else {
                this.yPos += Math.round(this.jumpVelocity * framesElapsed);
            }

            this.jumpVelocity += this.config.GRAVITY * framesElapsed;

            // Minimum height has been reached.
            if (this.yPos < this.minJumpHeight || this.speedDrop) {
                this.reachedMinHeight = true;
            }

            // Reached max height
            if (this.yPos < this.config.MAX_JUMP_HEIGHT || this.speedDrop) {
                this.endJump();
            }

            // Back down at ground level. Jump completed.
            if (this.yPos > this.groundYPos) {
                this.reset();
                this.jumpCount++;
            }

            this.update(deltaTime);
        },

        /**
         * Set the speed drop. Immediately cancels the current jump.
         */
        setSpeedDrop: function () {
            this.speedDrop = true;
            this.jumpVelocity = 1;
        },

        /**
         * @param {boolean} isDucking.
         */
        setDuck: function (isDucking) {
            if (isDucking && this.status != Trex.status.DUCKING) {
                this.update(0, Trex.status.DUCKING);
                this.ducking = true;
            } else if (this.status == Trex.status.DUCKING) {
                this.update(0, Trex.status.RUNNING);
                this.ducking = false;
            }
        },

        /**
         * Reset the t-rex to running at start of game.
         */
        reset: function () {
            this.yPos = this.groundYPos;
            this.jumpVelocity = 0;
            this.jumping = false;
            this.ducking = false;
            this.update(0, Trex.status.RUNNING);
            this.midair = false;
            this.speedDrop = false;
            this.jumpCount = 0;
        }
    };


    //******************************************************************************

    /**
     * Handles displaying the distance meter.
     * @param {!HTMLCanvasElement} canvas
     * @param {Object} spritePos Image position in sprite.
     * @param {number} canvasWidth
     * @constructor
     */
    function DistanceMeter(canvas, spritePos, canvasWidth) {
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.canvasCtx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.image = Runner.imageSprite;
        this.spritePos = spritePos;
        this.x = 0;
        this.y = 5;

        this.currentDistance = 0;
        this.maxScore = 0;
        this.highScore = 0;
        this.container = null;

        this.digits = [];
        this.acheivement = false;
        this.defaultString = '';
        this.flashTimer = 0;
        this.flashIterations = 0;
        this.invertTrigger = false;

        this.config = DistanceMeter.config;
        this.maxScoreUnits = this.config.MAX_DISTANCE_UNITS;
        this.init(canvasWidth);
    };


    /**
     * @enum {number}
     */
    DistanceMeter.dimensions = {
        WIDTH: 10,
        HEIGHT: 13,
        DEST_WIDTH: 11
    };


    /**
     * Y positioning of the digits in the sprite sheet.
     * X position is always 0.
     * @type {Array<number>}
     */
    DistanceMeter.yPos = [0, 13, 27, 40, 53, 67, 80, 93, 107, 120];


    /**
     * Distance meter config.
     * @enum {number}
     */
    DistanceMeter.config = {
        // Number of digits.
        MAX_DISTANCE_UNITS: 5,

        // Distance that causes achievement animation.
        ACHIEVEMENT_DISTANCE: 100,

        // Used for conversion from pixel distance to a scaled unit.
        COEFFICIENT: 0.025,

        // Flash duration in milliseconds.
        FLASH_DURATION: 1000 / 4,

        // Flash iterations for achievement animation.
        FLASH_ITERATIONS: 3
    };


    DistanceMeter.prototype = {
        /**
         * Initialise the distance meter to '00000'.
         * @param {number} width Canvas width in px.
         */
        init: function (width) {
            var maxDistanceStr = '';

            this.calcXPos(width);
            this.maxScore = this.maxScoreUnits;
            for (var i = 0; i < this.maxScoreUnits; i++) {
                this.draw(i, 0);
                this.defaultString += '0';
                maxDistanceStr += '9';
            }

            this.maxScore = parseInt(maxDistanceStr);
        },

        /**
         * Calculate the xPos in the canvas.
         * @param {number} canvasWidth
         */
        calcXPos: function (canvasWidth) {
            this.x = canvasWidth - (DistanceMeter.dimensions.DEST_WIDTH *
                (this.maxScoreUnits + 1));
        },

        /**
         * Draw a digit to canvas.
         * @param {number} digitPos Position of the digit.
         * @param {number} value Digit value 0-9.
         * @param {boolean} opt_highScore Whether drawing the high score.
         */
        draw: function (digitPos, value, opt_highScore) {
            var sourceWidth = DistanceMeter.dimensions.WIDTH;
            var sourceHeight = DistanceMeter.dimensions.HEIGHT;
            var sourceX = DistanceMeter.dimensions.WIDTH * value;
            var sourceY = 0;

            var targetX = digitPos * DistanceMeter.dimensions.DEST_WIDTH;
            var targetY = this.y;
            var targetWidth = DistanceMeter.dimensions.WIDTH;
            var targetHeight = DistanceMeter.dimensions.HEIGHT;

            // For high DPI we 2x source values.
            if (IS_HIDPI) {
                sourceWidth *= 2;
                sourceHeight *= 2;
                sourceX *= 2;
            }

            sourceX += this.spritePos.x;
            sourceY += this.spritePos.y;

            this.canvasCtx.save();

            if (opt_highScore) {
                // Left of the current score.
                var highScoreX = this.x - (this.maxScoreUnits * 2) *
                    DistanceMeter.dimensions.WIDTH;
                this.canvasCtx.translate(highScoreX, this.y);
            } else {
                this.canvasCtx.translate(this.x, this.y);
            }

            this.canvasCtx.drawImage(this.image, sourceX, sourceY,
                sourceWidth, sourceHeight,
                targetX, targetY,
                targetWidth, targetHeight
            );

            this.canvasCtx.restore();
        },

        /**
         * Covert pixel distance to a 'real' distance.
         * @param {number} distance Pixel distance ran.
         * @return {number} The 'real' distance ran.
         */
        getActualDistance: function (distance) {
            return distance ? Math.round(distance * this.config.COEFFICIENT) : 0;
        },

        /**
         * Update the distance meter.
         * @param {number} distance
         * @param {number} deltaTime
         * @return {boolean} Whether the acheivement sound fx should be played.
         */
        update: function (deltaTime, distance) {
            var paint = true;
            var playSound = false;

            if (!this.acheivement) {
                distance = this.getActualDistance(distance);
                // Score has gone beyond the initial digit count.
                if (distance > this.maxScore && this.maxScoreUnits ==
                    this.config.MAX_DISTANCE_UNITS) {
                    this.maxScoreUnits++;
                    this.maxScore = parseInt(this.maxScore + '9');
                } else {
                    this.distance = 0;
                }

                if (distance > 0) {
                    // Acheivement unlocked
                    if (distance % this.config.ACHIEVEMENT_DISTANCE == 0) {
                        // Flash score and play sound.
                        this.acheivement = true;
                        this.flashTimer = 0;
                        playSound = true;
                    }

                    // Create a string representation of the distance with leading 0.
                    var distanceStr = (this.defaultString +
                        distance).substr(-this.maxScoreUnits);
                    this.digits = distanceStr.split('');
                } else {
                    this.digits = this.defaultString.split('');
                }
            } else {
                // Control flashing of the score on reaching acheivement.
                if (this.flashIterations <= this.config.FLASH_ITERATIONS) {
                    this.flashTimer += deltaTime;

                    if (this.flashTimer < this.config.FLASH_DURATION) {
                        paint = false;
                    } else if (this.flashTimer >
                        this.config.FLASH_DURATION * 2) {
                        this.flashTimer = 0;
                        this.flashIterations++;
                    }
                } else {
                    this.acheivement = false;
                    this.flashIterations = 0;
                    this.flashTimer = 0;
                }
            }

            // Draw the digits if not flashing.
            if (paint) {
                for (var i = this.digits.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    this.draw(i, parseInt(this.digits[i]));
                }
            }

            this.drawHighScore();
            return playSound;
        },

        /**
         * Draw the high score.
         */
        drawHighScore: function () {
            this.canvasCtx.save();
            this.canvasCtx.globalAlpha = .8;
            for (var i = this.highScore.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                this.draw(i, parseInt(this.highScore[i], 10), true);
            }
            this.canvasCtx.restore();
        },

        /**
         * Set the highscore as a array string.
         * Position of char in the sprite: H - 10, I - 11.
         * @param {number} distance Distance ran in pixels.
         */
        setHighScore: function (distance) {
            distance = this.getActualDistance(distance);
            var highScoreStr = (this.defaultString +
                distance).substr(-this.maxScoreUnits);

            this.highScore = ['10', '11', ''].concat(highScoreStr.split(''));
        },

        /**
         * Reset the distance meter back to '00000'.
         */
        reset: function () {
            this.update(0);
            this.acheivement = false;
        }
    };


    //******************************************************************************

    /**
     * Cloud background item.
     * Similar to an obstacle object but without collision boxes.
     * @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas Canvas element.
     * @param {Object} spritePos Position of image in sprite.
     * @param {number} containerWidth
     */
    function Cloud(canvas, spritePos, containerWidth) {
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.canvasCtx = this.canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.spritePos = spritePos;
        this.containerWidth = containerWidth;
        this.xPos = containerWidth;
        this.yPos = 0;
        this.remove = false;
        this.cloudGap = getRandomNum(Cloud.config.MIN_CLOUD_GAP,
            Cloud.config.MAX_CLOUD_GAP);

        this.init();
    };


    /**
     * Cloud object config.
     * @enum {number}
     */
    Cloud.config = {
        HEIGHT: 14,
        MAX_CLOUD_GAP: 400,
        MAX_SKY_LEVEL: 30,
        MIN_CLOUD_GAP: 100,
        MIN_SKY_LEVEL: 71,
        WIDTH: 46
    };


    Cloud.prototype = {
        /**
         * Initialise the cloud. Sets the Cloud height.
         */
        init: function () {
            this.yPos = getRandomNum(Cloud.config.MAX_SKY_LEVEL,
                Cloud.config.MIN_SKY_LEVEL);
            this.draw();
        },

        /**
         * Draw the cloud.
         */
        draw: function () {
            this.canvasCtx.save();
            var sourceWidth = Cloud.config.WIDTH;
            var sourceHeight = Cloud.config.HEIGHT;

            if (IS_HIDPI) {
                sourceWidth = sourceWidth * 2;
                sourceHeight = sourceHeight * 2;
            }

            this.canvasCtx.drawImage(Runner.imageSprite, this.spritePos.x,
                this.spritePos.y,
                sourceWidth, sourceHeight,
                this.xPos, this.yPos,
                Cloud.config.WIDTH, Cloud.config.HEIGHT);

            this.canvasCtx.restore();
        },

        /**
         * Update the cloud position.
         * @param {number} speed
         */
        update: function (speed) {
            if (!this.remove) {
                this.xPos -= Math.ceil(speed);
                this.draw();

                // Mark as removeable if no longer in the canvas.
                if (!this.isVisible()) {
                    this.remove = true;
                }
            }
        },

        /**
         * Check if the cloud is visible on the stage.
         * @return {boolean}
         */
        isVisible: function () {
            return this.xPos + Cloud.config.WIDTH > 0;
        }
    };


    //******************************************************************************

    /**
     * Nightmode shows a moon and stars on the horizon.
     */
    function NightMode(canvas, spritePos, containerWidth) {
        this.spritePos = spritePos;
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.canvasCtx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.xPos = containerWidth - 50;
        this.yPos = 30;
        this.currentPhase = 0;
        this.opacity = 0;
        this.containerWidth = containerWidth;
        this.stars = [];
        this.drawStars = false;
        this.placeStars();
    };

    /**
     * @enum {number}
     */
    NightMode.config = {
        FADE_SPEED: 0.035,
        HEIGHT: 40,
        MOON_SPEED: 0.25,
        NUM_STARS: 2,
        STAR_SIZE: 9,
        STAR_SPEED: 0.3,
        STAR_MAX_Y: 70,
        WIDTH: 20
    };

    NightMode.phases = [140, 120, 100, 60, 40, 20, 0];

    NightMode.prototype = {
        /**
         * Update moving moon, changing phases.
         * @param {boolean} activated Whether night mode is activated.
         * @param {number} delta
         */
        update: function (activated, delta) {
            // Moon phase.
            if (activated && this.opacity == 0) {
                this.currentPhase++;

                if (this.currentPhase >= NightMode.phases.length) {
                    this.currentPhase = 0;
                }
            }

            // Fade in / out.
            if (activated && (this.opacity < 1 || this.opacity == 0)) {
                this.opacity += NightMode.config.FADE_SPEED;
            } else if (this.opacity > 0) {
                this.opacity -= NightMode.config.FADE_SPEED;
            }

            // Set moon positioning.
            if (this.opacity > 0) {
                this.xPos = this.updateXPos(this.xPos, NightMode.config.MOON_SPEED);

                // Update stars.
                if (this.drawStars) {
                    for (var i = 0; i < NightMode.config.NUM_STARS; i++) {
                        this.stars[i].x = this.updateXPos(this.stars[i].x,
                            NightMode.config.STAR_SPEED);
                    }
                }
                this.draw();
            } else {
                this.opacity = 0;
                this.placeStars();
            }
            this.drawStars = true;
        },

        updateXPos: function (currentPos, speed) {
            if (currentPos < -NightMode.config.WIDTH) {
                currentPos = this.containerWidth;
            } else {
                currentPos -= speed;
            }
            return currentPos;
        },

        draw: function () {
            var moonSourceWidth = this.currentPhase == 3 ? NightMode.config.WIDTH * 2 :
                NightMode.config.WIDTH;
            var moonSourceHeight = NightMode.config.HEIGHT;
            var moonSourceX = this.spritePos.x + NightMode.phases[this.currentPhase];
            var moonOutputWidth = moonSourceWidth;
            var starSize = NightMode.config.STAR_SIZE;
            var starSourceX = Runner.spriteDefinition.LDPI.STAR.x;

            if (IS_HIDPI) {
                moonSourceWidth *= 2;
                moonSourceHeight *= 2;
                moonSourceX = this.spritePos.x +
                    (NightMode.phases[this.currentPhase] * 2);
                starSize *= 2;
                starSourceX = Runner.spriteDefinition.HDPI.STAR.x;
            }

            this.canvasCtx.save();
            this.canvasCtx.globalAlpha = this.opacity;

            // Stars.
            if (this.drawStars) {
                for (var i = 0; i < NightMode.config.NUM_STARS; i++) {
                    this.canvasCtx.drawImage(Runner.imageSprite,
                        starSourceX, this.stars[i].sourceY, starSize, starSize,
                        Math.round(this.stars[i].x), this.stars[i].y,
                        NightMode.config.STAR_SIZE, NightMode.config.STAR_SIZE);
                }
            }

            // Moon.
            this.canvasCtx.drawImage(Runner.imageSprite, moonSourceX,
                this.spritePos.y, moonSourceWidth, moonSourceHeight,
                Math.round(this.xPos), this.yPos,
                moonOutputWidth, NightMode.config.HEIGHT);

            this.canvasCtx.globalAlpha = 1;
            this.canvasCtx.restore();
        },

        // Do star placement.
        placeStars: function () {
            var segmentSize = Math.round(this.containerWidth /
                NightMode.config.NUM_STARS);

            for (var i = 0; i < NightMode.config.NUM_STARS; i++) {
                this.stars[i] = {};
                this.stars[i].x = getRandomNum(segmentSize * i, segmentSize * (i + 1));
                this.stars[i].y = getRandomNum(0, NightMode.config.STAR_MAX_Y);

                if (IS_HIDPI) {
                    this.stars[i].sourceY = Runner.spriteDefinition.HDPI.STAR.y +
                        NightMode.config.STAR_SIZE * 2 * i;
                } else {
                    this.stars[i].sourceY = Runner.spriteDefinition.LDPI.STAR.y +
                        NightMode.config.STAR_SIZE * i;
                }
            }
        },

        reset: function () {
            this.currentPhase = 0;
            this.opacity = 0;
            this.update(false);
        }

    };


    //******************************************************************************

    /**
     * Horizon Line.
     * Consists of two connecting lines. Randomly assigns a flat / bumpy horizon.
     * @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas
     * @param {Object} spritePos Horizon position in sprite.
     * @constructor
     */
    function HorizonLine(canvas, spritePos) {
        this.spritePos = spritePos;
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.canvasCtx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.sourceDimensions = {};
        this.dimensions = HorizonLine.dimensions;
        this.sourceXPos = [this.spritePos.x, this.spritePos.x +
            this.dimensions.WIDTH];
        this.xPos = [];
        this.yPos = 0;
        this.bumpThreshold = 0.5;

        this.setSourceDimensions();
        this.draw();
    };


    /**
     * Horizon line dimensions.
     * @enum {number}
     */
    HorizonLine.dimensions = {
        WIDTH: 600,
        HEIGHT: 12,
        YPOS: 127
    };


    HorizonLine.prototype = {
        /**
         * Set the source dimensions of the horizon line.
         */
        setSourceDimensions: function () {

            for (var dimension in HorizonLine.dimensions) {
                if (IS_HIDPI) {
                    if (dimension != 'YPOS') {
                        this.sourceDimensions[dimension] =
                            HorizonLine.dimensions[dimension] * 2;
                    }
                } else {
                    this.sourceDimensions[dimension] =
                        HorizonLine.dimensions[dimension];
                }
                this.dimensions[dimension] = HorizonLine.dimensions[dimension];
            }

            this.xPos = [0, HorizonLine.dimensions.WIDTH];
            this.yPos = HorizonLine.dimensions.YPOS;
        },

        /**
         * Return the crop x position of a type.
         */
        getRandomType: function () {
            return Math.random() > this.bumpThreshold ? this.dimensions.WIDTH : 0;
        },

        /**
         * Draw the horizon line.
         */
        draw: function () {
            this.canvasCtx.drawImage(Runner.imageSprite, this.sourceXPos[0],
                this.spritePos.y,
                this.sourceDimensions.WIDTH, this.sourceDimensions.HEIGHT,
                this.xPos[0], this.yPos,
                this.dimensions.WIDTH, this.dimensions.HEIGHT);

            this.canvasCtx.drawImage(Runner.imageSprite, this.sourceXPos[1],
                this.spritePos.y,
                this.sourceDimensions.WIDTH, this.sourceDimensions.HEIGHT,
                this.xPos[1], this.yPos,
                this.dimensions.WIDTH, this.dimensions.HEIGHT);
        },

        /**
         * Update the x position of an indivdual piece of the line.
         * @param {number} pos Line position.
         * @param {number} increment
         */
        updateXPos: function (pos, increment) {
            var line1 = pos;
            var line2 = pos == 0 ? 1 : 0;

            this.xPos[line1] -= increment;
            this.xPos[line2] = this.xPos[line1] + this.dimensions.WIDTH;

            if (this.xPos[line1] <= -this.dimensions.WIDTH) {
                this.xPos[line1] += this.dimensions.WIDTH * 2;
                this.xPos[line2] = this.xPos[line1] - this.dimensions.WIDTH;
                this.sourceXPos[line1] = this.getRandomType() + this.spritePos.x;
            }
        },

        /**
         * Update the horizon line.
         * @param {number} deltaTime
         * @param {number} speed
         */
        update: function (deltaTime, speed) {
            var increment = Math.floor(speed * (FPS / 1000) * deltaTime);

            if (this.xPos[0] <= 0) {
                this.updateXPos(0, increment);
            } else {
                this.updateXPos(1, increment);
            }
            this.draw();
        },

        /**
         * Reset horizon to the starting position.
         */
        reset: function () {
            this.xPos[0] = 0;
            this.xPos[1] = HorizonLine.dimensions.WIDTH;
        }
    };


    //******************************************************************************

    /**
     * Horizon background class.
     * @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas
     * @param {Object} spritePos Sprite positioning.
     * @param {Object} dimensions Canvas dimensions.
     * @param {number} gapCoefficient
     * @constructor
     */
    function Horizon(canvas, spritePos, dimensions, gapCoefficient) {
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.canvasCtx = this.canvas.getContext('2d');
        this.config = Horizon.config;
        this.dimensions = dimensions;
        this.gapCoefficient = gapCoefficient;
        this.obstacles = [];
        this.obstacleHistory = [];
        this.horizonOffsets = [0, 0];
        this.cloudFrequency = this.config.CLOUD_FREQUENCY;
        this.spritePos = spritePos;
        this.nightMode = null;

        // Cloud
        this.clouds = [];
        this.cloudSpeed = this.config.BG_CLOUD_SPEED;

        // Horizon
        this.horizonLine = null;
        this.init();
    };


    /**
     * Horizon config.
     * @enum {number}
     */
    Horizon.config = {
        BG_CLOUD_SPEED: 0.2,
        BUMPY_THRESHOLD: .3,
        CLOUD_FREQUENCY: .5,
        HORIZON_HEIGHT: 16,
        MAX_CLOUDS: 6
    };


    Horizon.prototype = {
        /**
         * Initialise the horizon. Just add the line and a cloud. No obstacles.
         */
        init: function () {
            this.addCloud();
            this.horizonLine = new HorizonLine(this.canvas, this.spritePos.HORIZON);
            this.nightMode = new NightMode(this.canvas, this.spritePos.MOON,
                this.dimensions.WIDTH);
        },

        /**
         * @param {number} deltaTime
         * @param {number} currentSpeed
         * @param {boolean} updateObstacles Used as an override to prevent
         *     the obstacles from being updated / added. This happens in the
         *     ease in section.
         * @param {boolean} showNightMode Night mode activated.
         */
        update: function (deltaTime, currentSpeed, updateObstacles, showNightMode) {
            this.runningTime += deltaTime;
            this.horizonLine.update(deltaTime, currentSpeed);
            this.nightMode.update(showNightMode);
            this.updateClouds(deltaTime, currentSpeed);

            if (updateObstacles) {
                this.updateObstacles(deltaTime, currentSpeed);
            }
        },

        /**
         * Update the cloud positions.
         * @param {number} deltaTime
         * @param {number} currentSpeed
         */
        updateClouds: function (deltaTime, speed) {
            var cloudSpeed = this.cloudSpeed / 1000 * deltaTime * speed;
            var numClouds = this.clouds.length;

            if (numClouds) {
                for (var i = numClouds - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    this.clouds[i].update(cloudSpeed);
                }

                var lastCloud = this.clouds[numClouds - 1];

                // Check for adding a new cloud.
                if (numClouds < this.config.MAX_CLOUDS &&
                    (this.dimensions.WIDTH - lastCloud.xPos) > lastCloud.cloudGap &&
                    this.cloudFrequency > Math.random()) {
                    this.addCloud();
                }

                // Remove expired clouds.
                this.clouds = this.clouds.filter(function (obj) {
                    return !obj.remove;
                });
            } else {
                this.addCloud();
            }
        },

        /**
         * Update the obstacle positions.
         * @param {number} deltaTime
         * @param {number} currentSpeed
         */
        updateObstacles: function (deltaTime, currentSpeed) {
            // Obstacles, move to Horizon layer.
            var updatedObstacles = this.obstacles.slice(0);

            for (var i = 0; i < this.obstacles.length; i++) {
                var obstacle = this.obstacles[i];
                obstacle.update(deltaTime, currentSpeed);

                // Clean up existing obstacles.
                if (obstacle.remove) {
                    updatedObstacles.shift();
                }
            }
            this.obstacles = updatedObstacles;

            if (this.obstacles.length > 0) {
                var lastObstacle = this.obstacles[this.obstacles.length - 1];

                if (lastObstacle && !lastObstacle.followingObstacleCreated &&
                    lastObstacle.isVisible() &&
                    (lastObstacle.xPos + lastObstacle.width + lastObstacle.gap) <
                    this.dimensions.WIDTH) {
                    this.addNewObstacle(currentSpeed);
                    lastObstacle.followingObstacleCreated = true;
                }
            } else {
                // Create new obstacles.
                this.addNewObstacle(currentSpeed);
            }
        },

        removeFirstObstacle: function () {
            this.obstacles.shift();
        },

        /**
         * Add a new obstacle.
         * @param {number} currentSpeed
         */
        addNewObstacle: function (currentSpeed) {
            var obstacleTypeIndex = getRandomNum(0, Obstacle.types.length - 1);
            var obstacleType = Obstacle.types[obstacleTypeIndex];

            // Check for multiples of the same type of obstacle.
            // Also check obstacle is available at current speed.
            if (this.duplicateObstacleCheck(obstacleType.type) ||
                currentSpeed < obstacleType.minSpeed) {
                this.addNewObstacle(currentSpeed);
            } else {
                var obstacleSpritePos = this.spritePos[obstacleType.type];

                this.obstacles.push(new Obstacle(this.canvasCtx, obstacleType,
                    obstacleSpritePos, this.dimensions,
                    this.gapCoefficient, currentSpeed, obstacleType.width));

                this.obstacleHistory.unshift(obstacleType.type);

                if (this.obstacleHistory.length > 1) {
                    this.obstacleHistory.splice(Runner.config.MAX_OBSTACLE_DUPLICATION);
                }
            }
        },

        /**
         * Returns whether the previous two obstacles are the same as the next one.
         * Maximum duplication is set in config value MAX_OBSTACLE_DUPLICATION.
         * @return {boolean}
         */
        duplicateObstacleCheck: function (nextObstacleType) {
            var duplicateCount = 0;

            for (var i = 0; i < this.obstacleHistory.length; i++) {
                duplicateCount = this.obstacleHistory[i] == nextObstacleType ?
                    duplicateCount + 1 : 0;
            }
            return duplicateCount >= Runner.config.MAX_OBSTACLE_DUPLICATION;
        },

        /**
         * Reset the horizon layer.
         * Remove existing obstacles and reposition the horizon line.
         */
        reset: function () {
            this.obstacles = [];
            this.horizonLine.reset();
            this.nightMode.reset();
        },

        /**
         * Update the canvas width and scaling.
         * @param {number} width Canvas width.
         * @param {number} height Canvas height.
         */
        resize: function (width, height) {
            this.canvas.width = width;
            this.canvas.height = height;
        },

        /**
         * Add a new cloud to the horizon.
         */
        addCloud: function () {
            this.clouds.push(new Cloud(this.canvas, this.spritePos.CLOUD,
                this.dimensions.WIDTH));
        }
    };
})();


function onDocumentLoad() {
    new Runner('.interstitial-wrapper');
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', onDocumentLoad);
```

`scripts/bundle.mjs`:

```mjs
// Turns each game's playable port into ONE html file (docs/play/<game>.html) that works from file:// and GitHub Pages.
// Module imports are inlined, `export` is dropped. Only relative "./x.mjs" imports are supported.
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { listGames, loadGame } from "../lib/verify.mjs";

const root = path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const modules = new Map();
const IMPORT = /^import\s*\{([^}]*)\}\s*from\s*["'](\.\/[^"']+)["'];?\s*$/gm;
// Each module runs in its own function scope and hands back its named exports, so two files may
// both declare the same top-level name (the page and its logic module often both define W and H).
function inline(dir, file, out) {
  const full = path.join(dir, file);
  if (modules.has(full)) return modules.get(full);
  const id = `__mod${modules.size}`;
  modules.set(full, id);
  const src = fs.readFileSync(full, "utf8");
  const names = [...src.matchAll(/^export\s+(?:async\s+)?(?:const|let|var|function\*?|class)\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)/gm)].map((m) => m[1]);
  const body = imports(src, path.dirname(full), out).replace(/^export\s+/gm, "");
  out.push(`const ${id} = (() => {\n${body}\nreturn { ${names.join(", ")} };\n})();\n`);
  return id;
}
function imports(src, dir, out) {
  return src.replace(IMPORT, (_, list, rel) => {
    const id = inline(dir, rel, out);
    const binds = list.split(",").map((x) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean).map((x) => x.replace(/\s+as\s+/, ": "));
    return `const { ${binds.join(", ")} } = ${id};`;
  });
}
fs.mkdirSync(path.join(root, "docs/play"), { recursive: true });
for (const g of listGames(root)) {
  const { dir, meta } = loadGame(root, g);
  const play = Object.values(meta.ports).find((p) => p.play)?.play;
  if (!play) continue;
  const htmlPath = path.join(dir, play);
  const html = fs.readFileSync(htmlPath, "utf8");
  const out = html.replace(/<script type="module">([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/, (_, body) => {
    const mods = [];
    const rest = imports(body, path.dirname(htmlPath), mods);
    return `<script>\n(() => {\n${mods.join("")}${rest}\n})();\n</script>`;
  });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, "docs/play", `${g}.html`), out);
  console.log("wrote docs/play/" + g + ".html", out.length, "bytes");
  modules.clear();
}
```

`scripts/compose.py`:

```py
"""Puts the original's frames next to the rebuild's and writes a GIF: compose.py <frames dir> <out.gif> <left title> <right title> <unit>"""
import json, sys, subprocess, os, glob
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

d, out, lt, rt, unit = sys.argv[1:6]
labels = json.load(open(os.path.join(d, "labels.json")))
def font(sz, bold=False):
    for p in ["/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf" if bold else "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"]:
        if os.path.exists(p): return ImageFont.truetype(p, sz)
    return ImageFont.load_default()
BG = (20, 22, 28)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, "out"), exist_ok=True)
for L in labels:
    i = L["i"]
    l = Image.open(os.path.join(d, f"l{i:04d}.png")).convert("RGB")
    r = Image.open(os.path.join(d, f"r{i:04d}.png")).convert("RGB")
    W, H = l.width + r.width + 30, l.height + 110
    im = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG); dr = ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    dr.text((20, 14), lt, font=font(22, True), fill=(232, 234, 240))
    dr.text((l.width + 30 + 10, 14), rt, font=font(22, True), fill=(255, 122, 69))
    im.paste(l, (0, 50)); im.paste(r, (l.width + 30, 50))
    msg = f"{unit} {i}   " + ("identical ✓" if L["same"] else "DIFFERENT")
    dr.text((20, H - 48), msg, font=font(24, True), fill=(120, 220, 140) if L["same"] else (255, 90, 90))
    if L.get("extra"):  # optional second caption line, e.g. what was compared
        dr.text((20, H - 18), L["extra"], font=font(14), fill=(139, 147, 167))
    dr.text((W - 330, H - 44), "rea-games", font=font(18), fill=(139, 147, 167))
    im.save(os.path.join(d, "out", f"f{i:04d}.png"))
frames = os.path.join(d, "out", "f%04d.png")
pal = os.path.join(d, "pal.png")
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(out)), exist_ok=True)
fps = os.environ.get("FPS", "8")
W = os.environ.get("WIDTH", "900")
subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-framerate", fps, "-i", frames, "-vf", f"scale={W}:trunc(ih*{W}/iw/2)*2:flags=lanczos,palettegen=max_colors=96", pal], check=True)
subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-framerate", fps, "-i", frames, "-i", pal, "-lavfi", f"scale={W}:trunc(ih*{W}/iw/2)*2:flags=lanczos[x];[x][1:v]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=4", out], check=True)
print(os.path.getsize(out) // 1024, "KB")
```

```mjs
// Renders the hero GIF for 2048: the ORIGINAL page next to the rebuild, same moves, same random numbers.
// Usage: node scripts/demo-2048.mjs <out.gif> [moves]
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import http from "node:http";
import os from "node:os";
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { mulberry32 } from "../lib/rng.mjs";
import { Game2048 } from "../games/2048/ports/web/game2048.mjs";

const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);
const { chromium } = require("playwright");
const root = path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const out = path.resolve(process.argv[2] ?? "docs/assets/2048.gif");
const MOVES = Number(process.argv[3] ?? 140);
const SEED = 20481;

// a small look-ahead bot, so the demo shows a real game
function pickMove(g) {
  let best = -1, bestScore = -Infinity;
  for (let d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
    const c = new Game2048({ rng: () => 0.5 });
    c.cells = g.cells.map((x) => x.slice()); c.score = g.score; c.over = g.over; c.won = g.won; c.kept = g.kept;
    const before = c.score;
    if (!c.move(d)) continue;
    const cornerBonus = c.cells[0][3] ? Math.log2(c.cells[0][3]) * 4 : 0;
    const s = (c.score - before) + c.empty().length * 12 + cornerBonus;
    if (s > bestScore) { bestScore = s; best = d; }
  }
  return best;
}
const rng = mulberry32(SEED);
const bot = new Game2048({ rng });
const moves = [];
while (moves.length < MOVES && !bot.terminated) { const m = pickMove(bot); if (m < 0) break; bot.move(m); moves.push(m); }

const seedScript = `(() => { let a = ${SEED} >>> 0; Math.random = function () { a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0; let t = a; t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1); t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61); return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; }; })();`;
const serve = (dir) => new Promise((res) => {
  const s = http.createServer((q, r) => {
    const f = path.join(dir, q.url === "/" ? "index.html" : decodeURIComponent(q.url.split("?")[0]));
    try { const b = fs.readFileSync(f); r.setHeader("content-type", f.endsWith(".html") ? "text/html" : f.endsWith(".css") ? "text/css" : "text/javascript"); r.end(b); } catch { r.statusCode = 404; r.end(); }
  }).listen(0, () => res(s));
});

const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "rea-2048-"));
const sOrig = await serve(path.join(root, "originals/2048/page"));
const sPort = await serve(path.join(root, "games/2048/ports/web"));
const browser = await chromium.launch();
const mk = async (s, w, h) => { const p = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: w, height: h }, deviceScaleFactor: 1 }); await p.addInitScript(seedScript); await p.goto(`http://localhost:${s.address().port}/`); return p; };
const left = await mk(sOrig, 540, 700), right = await mk(sPort, 540, 700);
await left.addStyleTag({ content: "body{margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}.heading{margin-bottom:10px}.above-game,.game-explanation,hr,.container>p{display:none!important}" });
await right.addStyleTag({ content: "main>p,#restart{display:none}" });
await left.waitForTimeout(300); await right.waitForTimeout(300);

const origGrid = () => left.evaluate(() => {
  const g = Array.from({ length: 4 }, () => Array(4).fill(0));
  document.querySelectorAll(".tile-container .tile").forEach((t) => {
    const m = t.className.match(/tile-position-(\d)-(\d)/), v = t.className.match(/tile-(\d+)\b/);
    if (m && v && !t.className.includes("tile-merged") === !t.className.includes("tile-merged")) g[m[1] - 1][m[2] - 1] = Math.max(g[m[1] - 1][m[2] - 1], Number(v[1]));
  });
  return g;
});
const key = ["ArrowUp", "ArrowRight", "ArrowDown", "ArrowLeft"];
let identical = 0;
const labels = [];
async function frame(i, move) {
  await left.waitForTimeout(140);
  const og = await origGrid(); const pg = (await right.evaluate(() => window.__game.snapshot().grid));
  const same = JSON.stringify(og) === JSON.stringify(pg);
  if (same) identical++;
  await left.screenshot({ path: path.join(tmp, `l${String(i).padStart(4, "0")}.png`), clip: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 540, height: 640 } });
  await right.screenshot({ path: path.join(tmp, `r${String(i).padStart(4, "0")}.png`), clip: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 540, height: 640 } });
  labels.push({ i, same, move });
}
await frame(0, null);
for (let i = 0; i < moves.length; i++) {
  await left.keyboard.press(key[moves[i]]);
  await right.keyboard.press(key[moves[i]]);
  await frame(i + 1, moves[i]);
}
await browser.close(); sOrig.close(); sPort.close();
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmp, "labels.json"), JSON.stringify(labels));
console.log(`moves ${moves.length}, boards identical in ${identical}/${labels.length} frames`);
if (identical !== labels.length) { console.error("original and rebuild differ: not rendering"); process.exit(1); }
execFileSync("python3", [path.join(root, "scripts/compose.py"), tmp, out, "Original 2048 (MIT)", "Rebuild, checked by rea-games", "move"], { stdio: "inherit" });
console.log("wrote", out);
```

`scripts/demo-blocks.mjs`:

```mjs
// Renders the hero GIF for Blocks: the ORIGINAL (originals/blocks, driven by games/blocks/driver.mjs) next to the
// rebuild (games/blocks/ports/web/index.html in the same Chromium), same recorded keys, dt and random numbers.
// Usage: node scripts/demo-blocks.mjs [out.gif] [case] [every-Nth-step] [steps]
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import http from "node:http";
import os from "node:os";
import zlib from "node:zlib";
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { openOriginal } from "../games/blocks/driver.mjs";

const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);
const pw = (() => { for (const t of ["playwright", process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH, "/opt/node22/lib/node_modules/playwright", "/opt/node-tools/node_modules/playwright"].filter(Boolean)) { try { return require(t); } catch {} } throw new Error("playwright not found"); })();
const root = path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const out = path.resolve(process.argv[2] ?? "docs/assets/blocks.gif");
const name = process.argv[3] ?? "bot-quads-33ms";
const EVERY = Number(process.argv[4] ?? 5);
// cases are stored gzipped; read in memory, nothing is written to games/blocks/cases
const c = JSON.parse(zlib.gunzipSync(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, "games/blocks/cases", name + ".json.gz"))).toString("utf8"));
const STEPS = Math.min(c.inputs.length, Number(process.argv[5] ?? 760));

const serve = (dir) => new Promise((res) => {
  const s = http.createServer((q, r) => {
    const f = path.join(dir, q.url === "/" ? "index.html" : decodeURIComponent(q.url.split("?")[0]));
    try { r.setHeader("content-type", f.endsWith(".html") ? "text/html" : "text/javascript"); r.end(fs.readFileSync(f)); } catch { r.statusCode = 404; r.end(); }
  }).listen(0, () => res(s));
});

const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "rea-blocks-"));
const orig = await openOriginal({ seed: c.seed });
const sPort = await serve(path.join(root, "games/blocks/ports/web"));
const browser = await pw.chromium.launch();
const right = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 520, height: 720 }, deviceScaleFactor: 1 });
await right.addInitScript((tape) => { window.__tape = tape; }, c.tape); // the recorded random numbers
await right.goto(`http://localhost:${sPort.address().port}/`);
await right.waitForFunction(() => window.__rea);
await right.addStyleTag({ content: "header,p.keys{display:none}main{width:420px}" });
const box = await orig.page.locator("#tetris").boundingBox(); // a clip, not an element screenshot: that one made the page resize and blank its canvas
const portShot = right.locator("#stage");

// the page state: grid, current piece, next piece, bag, score, rows, step, gravity accumulator, queue
const same = (a, b) => JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);
const labels = [];
let stepsSame = 0, shownSame = 0, windowOk = true, k = 0, maxClear = 0, prevRows = 0;
if (!same(orig.initial, await right.evaluate(() => window.__rea.snapshot()))) windowOk = false;
for (let n = 0; n < STEPS; n++) {
  const inp = c.inputs[n];
  const fo = await orig.step(inp);
  const fp = await right.evaluate(([dt, keys]) => window.__rea.step(dt, keys), [inp.dt, inp.keys ?? []]);
  if (same(fo, fp)) stepsSame++; else windowOk = false;
  maxClear = Math.max(maxClear, fo.rows - prevRows); prevRows = fo.rows;
  if ((n + 1) % EVERY === 0 || n === STEPS - 1) {
    const f = String(k).padStart(4, "0");
    await orig.page.screenshot({ path: path.join(tmp, `l${f}.png`), clip: box });
    await portShot.screenshot({ path: path.join(tmp, `r${f}.png`) });
    labels.push({ i: k++, same: windowOk, move: n + 1, extra: `step ${n + 1} of ${STEPS}  ·  score ${fo.score} (shown ${fo.vscore})  ·  rows ${fo.rows}  ·  compared: grid, piece, next, bag, score, rows, gravity timer, key queue` });
    if (windowOk) shownSame++;
    windowOk = true;
  }
}
const tapeOrig = await orig.tape();
const tapeUsed = await right.evaluate(() => window.__rea.tapeUsed());
await browser.close(); sPort.close(); await orig.close();
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmp, "labels.json"), JSON.stringify(labels));
console.log(`case ${name}: ${STEPS} steps, ${labels.length} frames shown (every ${EVERY}th), biggest clear in one step: ${maxClear} rows`);
console.log(`shown frames identical ${shownSame}/${labels.length}; every step's full state identical ${stepsSame}/${STEPS}`);
console.log(`tape: original drew ${tapeOrig.length}, port used ${tapeUsed}, recording has ${c.tape.length}`);
execFileSync("python3", [path.join(root, "scripts/compose.py"), tmp, out, "Original Blocks (MIT)", "Rebuild, checked by rea-games", "frame"], { stdio: "inherit", env: { ...process.env, FPS: process.env.FPS ?? "14", WIDTH: process.env.WIDTH ?? "760" } });
```

```mjs
// Renders the hero GIF for Canvas Bird: the ORIGINAL (originals/canvas-bird, driven by games/canvas-bird/driver.mjs)
// next to the rebuild (games/canvas-bird/ports/web/index.html in the same Chromium), same recorded clicks, dt and
// random numbers. Usage: node scripts/demo-canvas-bird.mjs [out.gif] [case] [every-Nth-step] [steps]
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import http from "node:http";
import os from "node:os";
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { openOriginal } from "../games/canvas-bird/driver.mjs";

const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);
const { chromium } = require("playwright");
const root = path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const out = path.resolve(process.argv[2] ?? "docs/assets/canvas-bird.gif");
const name = process.argv[3] ?? "bot-aims-low";
const EVERY = Number(process.argv[4] ?? 12);
const c = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, "games/canvas-bird/cases", name + ".json"), "utf8"));
const STEPS = Math.min(c.inputs.length, Number(process.argv[5] ?? 1140));

const serve = (dir) => new Promise((res) => {
  const s = http.createServer((q, r) => {
    const f = path.join(dir, q.url === "/" ? "index.html" : decodeURIComponent(q.url.split("?")[0]));
    try { r.setHeader("content-type", f.endsWith(".html") ? "text/html" : "text/javascript"); r.end(fs.readFileSync(f)); } catch { r.statusCode = 404; r.end(); }
  }).listen(0, () => res(s));
});

const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "rea-bird-"));
const orig = await openOriginal({ seed: c.seed });
const sPort = await serve(path.join(root, "games/canvas-bird/ports/web"));
const browser = await chromium.launch();
const right = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 672, height: 540 }, deviceScaleFactor: 1 }); // canvas 640x480
await right.addInitScript((tape) => { window.__tape = tape; }, c.tape);
await right.clock.install({ time: 0 }); // fake time for the page; its own frame loop only draws
await right.goto(`http://localhost:${sPort.address().port}/`);
await right.waitForFunction(() => window.__rea);
await right.addStyleTag({ content: "p{display:none}body{padding:0;justify-content:flex-start}#wrap{border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;width:640px}" });

const portCanvas = right.locator("#c");

// what a viewer sees: the whole draw list of the frame (every image, sprite, text and sound call, exact numbers)
const info = (f) => {
  const score = f.filter((s) => s.startsWith("t:fill") && s.endsWith(":white")).map((s) => s.split(":")[2])[0];
  const bird = f.find((s) => s.startsWith("s:player:"));
  const pipes = f.filter((s) => s.startsWith("i:enemy_up:")).length;
  return { score: score ?? "-", y: bird ? Number(bird.split(":")[7]) : null, pipes };
};
const labels = [];
let stepsSame = 0, shownSame = 0, windowOk = true, k = 0;
for (let n = 0; n < STEPS; n++) {
  const inp = c.inputs[n];
  const fo = await orig.step(inp);
  if (inp.click) await right.keyboard.press("Space");
  await right.clock.runFor(Math.max(1, Math.round(inp.dt)));
  const fp = await right.evaluate((dt) => window.__rea.step(dt), inp.dt);
  const ok = JSON.stringify(fo) === JSON.stringify(fp);
  if (ok) stepsSame++; else windowOk = false;
  if ((n + 1) % EVERY === 0 || n === STEPS - 1) {
    const f = String(k).padStart(4, "0");
    await origCanvas.screenshot({ path: path.join(tmp, `l${f}.png`) });
    await portCanvas.screenshot({ path: path.join(tmp, `r${f}.png`) });
    const o = info(fo);
    labels.push({ i: k++, same: windowOk, move: n + 1, extra: `step ${n + 1} of ${STEPS}  ·  score ${o.score}  ·  bird y ${o.y === null ? "-" : o.y.toFixed(1)}  ·  compared: every draw call of the frame (${fo.length} calls)` });
    if (windowOk) shownSame++;
    windowOk = true;
  }
}
const tapeOrig = await orig.tape();
const tapeUsed = await right.evaluate(() => window.__rea.tapeUsed());
await browser.close(); sPort.close(); await orig.close();
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmp, "labels.json"), JSON.stringify(labels));
console.log(`case ${name}: ${STEPS} steps, ${labels.length} frames shown (every ${EVERY}th)`);
console.log(`shown frames identical ${shownSame}/${labels.length}; every step's draw list identical ${stepsSame}/${STEPS}`);
console.log(`tape: original drew ${tapeOrig.length} (first ${tapeUsed} are the ones the port used, recording has ${c.tape.length})`);
execFileSync("python3", [path.join(root, "scripts/compose.py"), tmp, out, "Original Canvas Bird (MIT)", "Rebuild, checked by rea-games", "frame"], { stdio: "inherit", env: { ...process.env, FPS: process.env.FPS ?? "12", WIDTH: process.env.WIDTH ?? "760" } });
```

```mjs
// Renders the hero GIF for Chrome Dino: the ORIGINAL (originals/dino, driven by games/dino/driver.mjs) next to the

// Usage: node scripts/demo-dino.mjs [out.gif] [case] [every-Nth-step]
import fs from "node:fs";

  const s = http.createServer((q, r) => {
    const f = path.join(dir, q.url === "/" ? "index.html" : decodeURIComponent(q.url.split("?")[0]));
    try { r.setHeader("content-type", f.endsWith(".html") ? "text/html" : "text/javascript"); r.end(fs.readFileSync(f)); } catch { r.statusCode = 404; r.end(); }
  }).listen(0, () => res(s));

// the original zooms its container to the window width once it runs (arcade mode); keep it at its own 600x150 so every frame has one size

const origCanvas = orig.page.locator("canvas.runner-canvas");
const portCanvas = right.locator("#c");

const press = async (i) => {
  if (i.jump) await right.keyboard.down("Space");
  if (i.duck) await right.keyboard.down("ArrowDown");
  if (i.jumpUp) await right.keyboard.up("Space");
  if (i.duckUp) await right.keyboard.up("ArrowDown");
  if (i.enter) await right.keyboard.up("Enter");
};
// what a viewer can compare: obstacles (type, x, y), the dino's y, crash flag, score
const view = (s) => JSON.stringify([s.obstacles.map((o) => [o.type, o.xPos, o.yPos]), s.tRex.yPos, s.crashed, s.score]);

const labels = [];
let shown = 0, shownSame = 0, stepsSame = 0, fullSame = 0, windowOk = true, k = 0;
const shoot = async (idx, s, same) => {
  const n = String(k).padStart(4, "0");
  await origCanvas.screenshot({ path: path.join(tmp, `l${n}.png`) });
  await portCanvas.screenshot({ path: path.join(tmp, `r${n}.png`) });
  labels.push({ i: k++, same, move: idx, extra: `step ${idx} of ${c.inputs.length}  ·  score ${s.score}  ·  ${s.obstacles.length} obstacle(s)  ·  compared: obstacle x/y, dino y, crash, score` });
  shown++; if (same) shownSame++;
};
await shoot(0, await orig.initial(), true);
const first = await right.evaluate(() => window.__rea.snapshot());
if (view(first) !== view(await orig.initial())) labels[0].same = false;
for (let n = 0; n < c.inputs.length; n++) {
  const inp = c.inputs[n];
  const { state } = await orig.step(inp);
  await press(inp);
  await right.clock.runFor(Math.max(1, Math.round(inp.dt)));
  const ps = await right.evaluate((dt) => window.__rea.step(dt), inp.dt);
  const ok = view(state) === view(ps);
  if (ok) stepsSame++; else windowOk = false;
  if (JSON.stringify(state) === JSON.stringify(ps)) fullSame++;
  if ((n + 1) % EVERY === 0 || n === c.inputs.length - 1) { await shoot(n + 1, state, windowOk); windowOk = true; }
}
const tapeOrig = await orig.tape();

console.log(`shown frames identical ${shownSame}/${shown}; every step identical on the compared view ${stepsSame}/${c.inputs.length}; whole snapshot equal ${fullSame}/${c.inputs.length}`);
console.log(`tape: original drew ${tapeOrig.length}, recording ${c.tape.length}, port used ${tapeUsed}`);
if (orig.errors.length) console.log("page errors:", orig.errors);
```

```py
"""Writes the rea-games brand SVGs: a pixel gamepad with a faint twin (the original and its rebuild) and the wordmark.
Needs fontTools (pip install fonttools) and Inter ExtraBold. Usage: python3 scripts/make-logo.py"""
import sys
from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
from fontTools.pens.svgPathPen import SVGPathPen
from fontTools.pens.transformPen import TransformPen

FONT = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/inter/Inter-ExtraBold.otf"
ORANGE, CREAM, INK = "#E2560F", "#F6EBDD", "#1F1209"

ICON = [
    "......OOOOOO......................OOOOOO......",
    "....OOssssssO....................OssssssOO....",
    "...OhhhhhhhssO..................OsshhhhhhhO...",
    "..OhhhhhhhhhOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOhhGghhhhhO..",
    ".OhhbbbbbbbhhhhhhhhTTTTTTTThhhhhhhhGgggbbbhhO.",
    ".OhbbbbbKKKbhhhhhhhtttttttthhhhhhhbggg1bbbbhO.",
    ".Odbbbbbkkkbbbbbkkbttttttttbkkbbbbbb11bbbbbdO.",
    ".OdbbbbbkkkbbbbbbbbttttttttbbbbbPpbbbbbbRrbdO.",
    "..OhbKkkkkkkkjbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbPpppbbbbRrrrO..",
    "..Ohbkkkkmkkkjbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbppp3bbbbrrr2O..",
    "..Ohbkkkkkkkkjbbboobbbbbbbboobbb33bbbbbb22dO..",
    ".OhbbbbbkkkbbbboooooobbbboooooobbbbbUubbbbbhO.",
    ".OhbbbbbkkkbbbboCCccobbbboCCccobbbbUuuubbbbhO.",
    "OhbbbbbbjjjbbbooCcccoobbooCcccoobbbuuu4bbbbbhO",
    "Ohbbbbbbbbbbbbooccccoobbooccccoobbbb44bbbbbbhO",
    "OhbbbbbbbbbbbbboccccobbbboccccobbbbbbbbbbbbbdO",
    "OhbbbbbbbbbbbbbooooooddddoooooobbbbbbbbbbbbbdO",
    "OhbbbbbbbbbbbbbddooddddddddooddbbbbbbbbbbbbbdO",
    "OhbbbbbbbbbbbbdOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOhbbbbbbbbbbbbdO",
    "OdbbbbbbbbbbbbdO..............OdbbbbbbbbbbbbdO",
    "OdbbbbbbbbbbbbdO..............OdbbbbbbbbbbbbdO",
    ".OdbbbbbbbbbbdO................OdbbbbbbbbbbdO.",
    ".OdddbbbbbbdddO................OdddbbbbbbdddO.",
    "..OddddddddddO..................OddddddddddO..",
    "...OOddddddOO....................OOddddddOO...",
    ".....OOOOOO........................OOOOOO.....",
]

PALETTE = {
    "O": "#1F1209",
    "b": "#F1E4D2",
    "h": "#FBF4EA",
    "d": "#D9C5AC",
    "s": "#3A2E28",
    "k": "#2A1E16",
    "K": "#4D3D33",
    "m": "#3A2C23",
    "g": "#2BB673",
    "G": "#7FE0AE",
    "r": "#E8434B",
    "R": "#FF8A8F",
    "p": "#E879B9",
    "P": "#F7B3DA",
    "u": "#3F7BF2",
    "U": "#93B6FF",
    "o": "#2A1E16",
    "c": "#4D3D33",
    "C": "#7A685C",
    "t": "#E6D6C1",
    "T": "#D3BFA5",
    "j": "#140C08",
    "1": "#1C8A55",
    "2": "#B82D35",
    "3": "#C25596",
    "4": "#2B5BC4",
}

def pixels(cell, fill, dx=0, dy=0, opacity=None, swap=None):
    """One group per color. fill=None paints each pixel from PALETTE (with swap overrides); a color paints them all (the twin)."""
    pal = {**PALETTE, **(swap or {})}
    groups = {}
    for y, row in enumerate(ICON):
        x = 0
        while x < len(row):
            ch = row[x]
            if ch == ".":
                x += 1
                continue
            color = fill or pal[ch]
            x0 = x
            while x < len(row) and row[x] != "." and (fill or pal[row[x]]) == color:
                x += 1
            groups.setdefault(color, []).append(
                f'<rect x="{dx + x0 * cell:g}" y="{dy + y * cell:g}" width="{(x - x0) * cell:g}" height="{cell:g}"/>')
    op = f' opacity="{opacity}"' if opacity else ""
    return "".join(f'<g fill="{c}"{op} shape-rendering="crispEdges">' + "".join(r) + "</g>" for c, r in groups.items())

def text_path(s, size, spacing, x, y, dot_x_out=None):
    f = TTFont(FONT); gs = f.getGlyphSet(); cmap = f.getBestCmap(); upm = f["head"].unitsPerEm
    k = size / upm; cx = x; out = []
    for ch in s:
        g = gs[cmap[ord(ch)]]
        pen = SVGPathPen(gs)
        g.draw(TransformPen(pen, (k, 0, 0, -k, cx, y)))
        out.append((ch, pen.getCommands()))
        cx += g.width * k + spacing
    return out, cx

def wordmark(text_color, dot_color, x=136, y=84):
    glyphs, end = text_path("rea-games", 64, -2.4, x, y)
    dot, end2 = text_path(".", 64, 0, end, y)
    body = "".join(f'<path d="{d}"/>' for _, d in glyphs)
    return f'<g fill="{text_color}">{body}</g><g fill="{dot_color}"><path d="{dot[0][1]}"/></g>', end2

ON_DARK = {}
ON_LIGHT = {}

def logo(text_color, swap):
    mark = pixels(2.3, None, 10, 34, None, swap)
    ghost = pixels(2.3, ORANGE, 10 + 4, 34 + 4, 0.35)
    wm, end = wordmark(text_color, ORANGE)
    w = round(end + 18)
    return (f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 {w} 128" fill="none" role="img" aria-label="rea-games">'
            f'{ghost}{mark}{wm}</svg>\n')

def tile():
    cell = 9.5; w = len(ICON[0]) * cell; h = len(ICON) * cell
    ox = (512 - w) / 2 - 6; oy = (512 - h) / 2 - 6
    return ('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 512 512" role="img" aria-label="rea-games: a pixel gamepad and its twin">'
            f'<rect width="512" height="512" rx="112" fill="{ORANGE}"/>'
            + pixels(cell, "#7A2A05", ox + 10, oy + 10, 0.55) + pixels(cell, None, ox, oy) + '</svg>\n')

open("docs/brand/logo-dark.svg", "w").write(logo(CREAM, ON_DARK))   # for dark backgrounds
open("docs/brand/logo-light.svg", "w").write(logo(INK, ON_LIGHT))    # for light backgrounds
open("docs/assets/logo.svg", "w").write(tile())
print("wrote docs/brand/logo-dark.svg, docs/brand/logo-light.svg, docs/assets/logo.svg")
```

`skills/rea-games/SKILL.md`:

```md
---
name: rea-games
description: Reverse-engineer a game's behavior and rebuild it in another engine (web, Godot, Bevy, Unity) with proof it matches. Use when the user wants to clone, port, remake or understand how a game works, or says "rea this game". Records the original's inputs and state, writes a GAME.md spec, builds the port, and checks it frame by frame.
---

# rea-games

You rebuild a game from what it **does**, and prove it. The loop is: record the original, write the spec, build the
port, verify, fix, repeat. Never call a port done until `rea-games verify` says every case is identical.

## Before you start

1. Find out **what the original is and what licence it has**. A clean-room rebuild of behavior is fine; copying
   its art, music, names, or code is not, unless the licence allows it. Open source or permissive originals are
   the ones to start with (see `games/*/game.json` for the three that ship). If the licence is unclear, say so and
   ask before going on. Never use a trademarked name for the rebuild.
2. Check the tools: `node -v` (22+), and for a browser game `require('playwright')` and a Chromium.

## The loop

1. **Scaffold**: `rea-games new <game>` makes `games/<game>/` with `game.json`, `record.mjs`, `GAME.md` and a port stub.
2. **Make the original deterministic.** Three things vary between runs: time, random numbers, and input timing.
   - Replace the clock and `requestAnimationFrame` with a fake you step by hand (`dt` per step is an input).
   - Replace `Math.random` with a seeded generator and **save every value it returns** in the case as `tape`. The
     port reads those numbers back in the same order. If the original draws random numbers for things that do not
     change play (clouds, particles), give those a separate stream and say so in `GAME.md`.
   - Never edit the original. Wrap the browser, not the game.
3. **Record cases** (`rea-games record <game>`): each case is `{tape, inputs, trace}`. A trace entry is the state
   after one input or frame. Read it from the live game, or, when the state is private, from what it draws.
   Cover: every kind of enemy/obstacle/item, win, lose, restart, the edges (empty, full, maximum speed), odd frame
   times, and at least one saved state that is one step from each ending. Look at what the cases really contain.
4. **Write `GAME.md`** from the recording: constants, the order of operations inside one step, formulas, quirks
   (including bugs the original has: keep them, the port must match), and what is **not** modelled and why that
   cannot change the trace.
5. **Write the port** as pure logic: no DOM, no clock, an injected `rng`. A runner reads a case on stdin and prints
   `{trace, tapeUsed}`. Do not translate the original line by line; write from `GAME.md`, then check.
6. **Verify**: `rea-games verify <game> --port <name>`. The first difference is printed with its path
   (`trace[412].tRex.yPos: 46 != 45.5`). Fix the port, not the case. Use the number, not a guess.
7. **Break it on purpose** once (change a constant, an offset, an off-by-one) and see `verify` fail. A check that
   cannot fail proves nothing.
8. **Play it** in the engine: a web page with your own art, then Godot/Bevy/Unity ports that run the same cases.
   An engine port counts as verified only when it runs the cases through a runner; otherwise label it "not verified".

## Rules

- Traces come only from running the original. Never write a trace by hand.
- Do not loosen a comparison to get green (no rounding, no tolerance) unless `GAME.md` says why and how much.
- Report honestly: cases, inputs, what is covered, what is not, what fails.
- New game licences go in `NOTICE`.

```
